name: Spooks Gotta Whiz
_performance_summary: Spooks Gotta Whiz -- 2006 Blue Roan Stallion. By Spooks Gotta Gun (Colonels Smoking Gun x Miss Silver Spook/Smart Spook -- LTE $130,694; NRHA $1 Million Sire; leading reining sire; Colonels Smoking Gun sire line also produced Gunnatrashya osw001, Americasnexttopgun osw004, and Colonels Dancing Gun osw009 in this database -- the Colonels Smoking Gun dynasty is the backbone of the Oswood Stallion Station reining program) out of Prettywhizprettydoes (Topsail Whiz x -- Topsail Whiz is a foundational NRHA sire and Hall of Fame inductee with PE $5M+; dam of Spooks Gotta Whiz contributes elite Topsail Whiz athleticism, stop power, and the famous Whiz-line trainability to the pedigree, creating a dual sire-line pedigree that combines the Colonel Freckles/Colonels Smoking Gun foundation with the Topsail Whiz movement and athleticism). Owned by Ariat International. Oswood Stallion Station, Weatherford TX. LTE $346,715 confirmed Oswood roster. Transported cooled and frozen semen available. Source: https://www.oswood.com/stallions/spooks-gotta-whiz/ Confirmed show record from Oswood Stallion Station and NRHA records: 2010 NRHA Open Futurity Champion; 2012 NRBC Open Derby Champion; 2012 NRHA Open Derby Champion; World Equestrian Games Triple Crown Champion; NRHA Hall of Fame inductee. Sire earnings $14M+ confirmed Oswood roster. Spooks Gotta Whiz compiled one of the most decorated show records in modern reining history. The 2010 NRHA Open Futurity Championship established him as an elite performer from the start of his competitive career. His 2012 season was exceptional -- winning both the NRBC Open Derby and the NRHA Open Derby in the same year, then capping the performance with the WEG Triple Crown Championship. The World Equestrian Games Triple Crown is one of the most prestigious achievements in international reining, requiring a horse to win all three phases of competition against the top reining horses in the world. His NRHA Hall of Fame induction recognizes a career that placed him among the sport's all-time elite performers. As a sire, Spooks Gotta Whiz has built a significant produce record with $14M+ in offspring earnings spanning reining, reined cow horse, and ranch horse disciplines. The cross of Spooks Gotta Gun's Colonels Smoking Gun foundation with Topsail Whiz athleticism through Prettywhizprettydoes creates a pedigree that stamps offspring with powerful stops, fluid spins, and the mental trainability that defines elite reining bloodlines. His offspring compete at the highest levels of the NRHA and NRCHA, carrying forward the dual sire-line legacy of both Colonels Smoking Gun (through Spooks Gotta Gun) and Topsail Whiz (through the dam) -- two of the most influential reining sire lines of the modern era. Standing at Oswood Stallion Station alongside multiple Colonels Smoking Gun descendants makes this one of the premier reining stallion rosters in the industry. The consistent production of $14M+ in offspring earnings across multiple disciplines including reining, cow horse, and ranch horse confirms that the Spooks Gotta Whiz cross is a proven, commercially successful option for breeders seeking elite western performance genetics.

name: Wimpys Little Step
_performance_summary: Wimpys Little Step -- 1999 Palomino Stallion. AQHA. 14.3H. ICSI only. By Nu Chex To Cash (Nu Chex x Candy Chex by Poco Enterprise -- NRHA Three Million Dollar Sire; LTE $185,757; 2000 NRHA Non-Pro Futurity Champion; NRHA Intermediate Open World Champion; NRHA Limited Open World Champion; Supreme Reining Horse; sire also of Big Chex To Cash ss002, Lil Joe Cash osw026 and multiple other champions in this database; the Nu Chex line carries the King foundation genetics through Nu Chex that paired exceptionally with the Leolita Step dam side to produce the most commercially successful individual reining sire in NRHA history) out of Leolita Step (Forty Seven x -- Forty Seven is a foundation AQHA performance stallion; Leolita Step is an NRHA producer whose son Wimpys Little Step confirmed her status as one of the most significant broodmares in modern reining history by producing the sport's #1 All-Time Living Sire during his peak years; the Nu Chex To Cash x Leolita Step cross is unique in that it produced an individual who eclipsed both his sire (Nu Chex To Cash at $3M PE) and his sire's all-time competitors to become the leading NRHA sire of his era). Owned by Silver Spurs Equine / Xtra Quarter Horses LLC, Purcell OK. ICSI only. Stud fee $6,500 (balance due only after live foal is confirmed on ground). Silver Spurs Breeders Futurity enrolled. Source: https://www.silverspursequine.com/wimpys-little-step LTE $185,757 confirmed NRHA. PE $15,165,000+ confirmed Silver Spurs Equine -- NRHA $15 Million Sire. The #1 NRHA All-Time Living Sire during his peak years; #1 or #2 Leading Sire of Reining Money-Earners for 8 out of 10 years his foals showed. The first NRHA Open Futurity Champion to sire an NRHA Open Futurity Champion in his first foal crop. 1,988+ Wimpy foals on the ground with 50% money-earning rate and average earnings of $11,000+ per performer. Confirmed career: 2002 NRHA Open Futurity Champion (score 233 ridden by Shawn Flarida -- a standing ovation run); All American Quarter Horse Congress Futurity Champion; Tradition Open Reining Futurity Reserve Champion. His 2002 NRHA Open Futurity Championship run was historic. Ridden by NRHA Hall of Famer and Five Million Dollar Rider Shawn Flarida, Wimpys Little Step scored a 233 at the Futurity -- a near-perfect score that earned a standing ovation from the crowd and established the palomino as one of the most celebrated Futurity Champions in NRHA history. The NRHA Hall of Fame citation recognized Wimpy as the first Futurity Champion sire whose first foal crop immediately produced another Futurity Champion -- an achievement without precedent in NRHA breeding history. Top offspring include Wimpys Little Chic (LTE $516,556; NRHA Open Futurity Champion; NRHA Open Derby Champion; NRBC Champion; Triple Crown; NRHA Hall of Fame; #1 All-Time NRHA Money-Earner); RC Fancy Step (LTE $364,937; NRHA Open Derby Champion; NRBC Reserve Champion; #5 All-Time NRHA Money-Earner); Wimpys Little Buddy (LTE $285,358; 5th NRHA Open Futurity; AQHA World Senior Reining); Wimpyneedsacocktail (LTE $281,804; 2013 NRBC Open Champion -- Silver Spurs' own stallion); SHESOUTTAYOURLEAGUE (LTE $185,764; 2015 NRHA Open Futurity Champion x Walla Walla Whiz osw002's mate). With 50% of 1,988+ foals earning money in the show pen, Wimpys Little Step is the most productive reining stallion in history measured by offspring money-earning consistency. His ICSI at $6,500 with live foal payment policy gives breeders access to NRHA's all-time benchmark sire at Silver Spurs Equine Oklahoma.

name: Lil Joe Cash
_performance_summary: Lil Joe Cash -- 2008 Sorrel Stallion. AQHA. 14.3H. By Nu Chex To Cash (Nu Chex x -- Nu Chex To Cash is a leading NRHA reining sire, PE $3M+; 1999 AQHA Palomino stallion standing at Silver Spurs Equine; LTE $185,757+; 2000 NRHA Futurity Non-Pro Champion; his sons and daughters are consistent NRHA money-earners including Lil Joe Cash as his highest-profile open performer; Nu Chex To Cash's sire Nu Chex carries the Nu Bar speed foundation that blends well with the Peppy San Badger athleticism on the dam side) out of RS Lilly Starlight (Grays Starlight x -- Grays Starlight deceased October 2002; PE $10M+ confirmed in both NRHA reining and NCHA cutting simultaneously -- the only stallion in history to achieve Million Dollar Sire status in both disciplines; by Peppy San Badger x Doc's Starlight; RS Lilly Starlight's produce record confirms Lil Joe Cash as her standout performer with LTE $279,268 and an NRHA Futurity Open Championship). Oswood Stallion Station, 1400 Old Garner Road, Weatherford TX 76088. (817) 599-4560. 2026 Stud fee $3,000. Cooled and frozen semen available. Source: https://oswoodstallionstation.com/lil-joe-cash/ LTE $279,268 confirmed NRHA. PE $4,000,000+ confirmed NRHA. NRHA $3 Million Sire confirmed. Confirmed career: 2011 NRHA Open Futurity Champion; 2012 AQHA World Champion Junior Reining; over 300 money-producing offspring confirmed. Top earner Joes Genes (out of Electric Genes by Jacs Electric Spark; owned by Andrea and Tish Fappani; bred by Rancho Oso Rio LLC; $180,797 NRHA LTE) confirms elite professional-level offspring performance. Winning the 2011 NRHA Open Futurity Championship is one of the most coveted titles in professional reining. The NRHA Open Futurity brings together the world's best three-year-old horses and most accomplished open professionals competing for a championship that defines the future of the sport. The 2012 AQHA World Champion Junior Reining adds a second major championship credential confirming that Lil Joe Cash's talent and trainability carried through his fourth year at the highest AQHA level -- a horse that can win at both the NRHA Futurity Open and AQHA World Championship level demonstrates the breadth of ability that defines truly elite individuals. His progression from NRHA Futurity Open Champion (2011) through AQHA World Champion Junior Reining (2012) to NRHA $3 Million Sire to $4M+ PE confirms a stallion whose impact on the sport spans the complete arc from performance career to breeding legacy. The Nu Chex To Cash x Grays Starlight dam cross pairs two complementary reining sire lines -- Nu Chex's speed and natural lope with Grays Starlight's Peppy San Badger cow sense and athleticism -- creating offspring with broad competitive appeal. His 300+ money-producing offspring and top earner at $180,797 demonstrate consistent genetic transmission across a large population of foals rather than relying on one or two exceptional performers. Breeders crossing Shining Spark daughters or Gunnatrashya daughters on Lil Joe Cash access a proven $4M PE sire at an accessible $3,000 stud fee. The Nu Chex To Cash x Grays Starlight genetics offer a pedigree combination that does not appear elsewhere in the Oswood roster, making Lil Joe Cash a unique outcross option for breeders seeking pedigree diversity from the dominant Colonels Smoking Gun and Topsail Whiz lines that define the majority of the station's breeding program.

name: Metallic Cat
_performance_summary: Metallic Cat 'Denver' -- 2005 Red Roan Stallion. By High Brow Cat (High Brow Hickory x Smart Little Kitty/Smart Little Lena -- LTE $110,784; AQHA/NCHA #1 All-Time Leading Sire 2011-2020; EquiStat #1 Leading Cutting Sire 2003-2020; EquiStat #1 All-Time Leading Cutting Sire 2009-2020; NRCHA All-Time Leading Sire; PE $97M+; sire of a record 8 NCHA Open Futurity Champions and 56 AQHA Champions across five disciplines; inducted into AQHA Quarter Horse Hall of Fame 2023) out of Chers Shadow (Peptoboonsmal x Shesa Smarty Lena/Smart Little Lena -- LTE $1,675, Abilene Spectacular Open Derby finalist). Peptoboonsmal (Chers Shadow's sire): LTE $180,487, 1995 NCHA Futurity Open Champion, PE $20M+, sire of Once In A Blu Boon and Badboonarising's sire. Shesa Smarty Lena (Chers Shadow's dam, by Smart Little Lena -- NCHA Triple Crown Champion and #2 All-Time NCHA Sire) produced Patera Cat ($87,440 -- Breeders Invitational Non-Pro Classic Champion, NCHA Super Stakes Non-Pro Classic Co-Champion), Cherrey by Dual Rey ($27,646), and Dual Cher by Dual Pep ($27,038). Bred by the Roan Rangers (Alvin and Becky Fults, Fults Ranch). Shown by Beau Galyean (NCHA Hall of Fame earner, $3M+ rider) who piloted Denver to every title. Purchased by Bobby Patton, Rocking P Ranch, Weatherford TX in 2017. Presenting sponsor of the NRCHA Snaffle Bit Futurity. Owned and managed through Rocking P Ranch with semen available at Valley Equine, Stephenville TX -- ICSI and frozen only. LTE $637,711 -- highest money earner of all High Brow Cat offspring and the highest money-earning aged event stallion in a 32-year history at time of documentation. Made exactly 12 trips to the show pen -- never missed a finals, never lost a cow in the cutting pen. Confirmed show record: 2008 NCHA Open Futurity Champion; 2009 NCHA Open Horse of the Year; NCHA Open Super Stakes Reserve Champion; NCHA Hall of Fame inducted 2010. PE $83,631,404 (Valley Equine confirmed 2026). Led NCHA sire standings every year 2016 through 2024 -- 9 consecutive years. Led NRCHA sire standings 2018 through 2024 -- 7 consecutive years. 2024 QData #1 Leading Cutting Sire. QData and NCHA #2 All-Time Leading Cutting Sire. QData and NRCHA #1 All-Time Leading Reined Cow Horse Sire. 2016, 2017, 2019 NRCHA Sire of the Year; 2016 and 2017 NCHA Sire of the Year. 720+ money-earning offspring holding 2,350+ event championships and 1,852+ reserve championships across 14 disciplines (2018 figure -- substantially higher in 2026). Offspring span cutting, reined cow horse, reining, barrel racing, halter, ranch horse, and roping. Top confirmed offspring: Metallic Rebel (Sweet Abra/Abrakadabracre, LTE $438K+, 2017 NCHA HoY, NCHA HoF, PE $16.6M+, NRCHA Million Dollar Sire -- sire of 2023 NCHA Futurity Champion Lone Woolf LTE $668,310); Stevie Rey Von (Miss Ella Rey/Dual Rey, LTE $420,559, 2015 NCHA Futurity Champion, NCHA HoF, PE $20M+, #1 QData Leading Sire 2025); Check Yer Metal (Checkers Live Oak/Im Countin Checks, LTE $449,312, standing at Valley Equine); Swing Wide (Dually Noted/Dual Pep, LTE $353K+, standing at Valley Equine); Fiddle And Steel (Lil Bit Wreckless/CD Royal, LTE $203K+, 2020 NCHA Futurity Non-Pro Champion, 2021 NCHA Super Stakes 4YO Non-Pro Champion scored 225.5); Audeycious (2026 NCHA Super Stakes Non-Pro Co-Reserve Champion, scored 218 with Kristen Galyean); Aristotallic (2026 NCHA Super Stakes Limited Amateur Co-Reserve Champion, scored 214). NRHA top performers include Call Me Mitch, Cats Picasso, Ricato Suave, Hazardouz Material, and Moonshineandtwoadvil -- each with over $100,000 in NRCHA earnings. Clayton Edsall (NRCHA Million Dollar Rider): 'They're attractive but the biggest thing is that you have a trainable mind. One of the reasons you see so many Metallic Cats in the show pen, the winner's circle and the sale is that they have the ability to be trained and be successful. I've found that even if one doesn't make a cutting horse, it makes a cow horse or a rope horse. He checks a lot of boxes as a breeder -- color, size and bone, athleticism and mind.' The depth of the Metallic Cat legacy is confirmed by the successor generation -- Stevie Rey Von, Metallic Rebel, Rollz Royce, Swing Wide, and Fiddle And Steel are all Metallic Cat sons now standing as leading sires -- an unprecedented generational depth in Western performance horse history.

name: Dual Rey
_performance_summary: Dual Rey -- 1994 Sorrel Stallion, 14.2H. By Dual Pep (Peppy San Badger x Miss Dual Doc/Doc's Remedy -- PE $26,181,194 confirmed, all-time leading cutting sire; Dual Pep and Peptoboonsmal are three-quarter brothers in blood, two of the most influential sires in performance horse history; Dual Pep's sons include Dual Rey and his half-brothers by the same dam) out of Nurse Rey (Wyoming Doc x -- LTE $65,587; half-sister to Rey Lynx and Smartolena). Bred and owned by Linda Holmes, Holmes Cutting/Performance Horses, Longmont Colorado. Shown by Lloyd Cox (who also showed Nurse Rey and many of her offspring for Linda and sister Gail Holmes). Euthanized May 2018 due to complications of age at approximately 24 years old. ICSI only. HERDA N/N confirmed. Owned by Linda Holmes. Stud fee $5,625 ICSI. Valley Equine, Stephenville TX. LTE $105,038. Show record: 1997 NCHA Futurity -- tied 6th in Open finals with Lloyd Cox. Multiple additional aged event placings in Open and Non-Pro competition. Linda Holmes: 'Dual Rey wasn't a very big horse, about 14-2 hands. He had a deep heart girth. Dual Rey was really quick, he really wanted to be low-headed, have that freedom of head and neck when he came through turns. He wasn't a mechanical horse. He really wanted to do it naturally. He was very sound and we never shod him. He went barefoot. He had great feet. The other amazing thing about him is how smart he was.' AQHA Hall of Fame inductee. PE $57,893,606 (Valley Equine 2026). QData and NCHA #3 All-Time Leading Cutting Sire. QData #7 and NRCHA #6 All-Time Leading Sire. 65 World or Reserve World Champions. 1,144 NCHA money earners with a near-record average of $31,292. 16 AQHA World Champions and 18 AQHA Reserve World Champions. SallyHarrison.com: 'From his first crop (32 AQHA foals of 1999), Dual Rey lit the boards with TR Dual Rey -- from that crop on there was no stopping the Dual Reys, as performers and producers.' Top confirmed direct offspring: Special Nu Baby ($481,197); Rey Down Sally ($404,170); Dont Stopp Believin ($463,962 -- 2011 Sorrel, Dual Rey x Dont Look Twice/High Brow Cat, 2025 QData Top 12 Leading Cutting Sire, PE $5,941,502, 3 NCHA Non-Pro Horses of the Year, standing at Valley Equine); Reys Dual Badger ($312,179); TR Dual Rey ($291,111 -- NCHA Super Stakes Open Reserve Champion, NCHA Derby Reserve Champion, himself a sire with $3.7M+ in NCHA earners); A Smart Little Rey ($204,868); Cat A Rey ($230,360); Reys Desire ($400,000+). As maternal grandsire through elite daughters: Miss Ella Rey (Dual Rey daughter) produced 2015 NCHA Futurity Champion Stevie Rey Von ($420,559 LTE, PE $20M+, NRCHA $3M+ sire); Dual Rey Tag (Dual Rey daughter, LTE $57,251) produced 2018 NCHA World Champion Hashtags ($485,293 LTE, PE $5.3M+); A Little Reylena (Dual Rey daughter, LTE $126,608, QData/NCHA Top 15 All-Time Leading Dam) produced 2017 NCHA Open Futurity Champion Dual Reyish ($452,687 LTE, PE $2.5M+) and 2023 NCHA Open Futurity Champion Lone Woolf ($668,310 LTE). Dual Rey daughters' produce earnings confirmed at more than $10 million in the arena -- making him one of the most dominant maternal grandsires in NCHA history. He stands as the ultimate cross for mares across the board with championship titles spanning multiple disciplines including cutting, reined cow horse, reining, and roping.

name: High Brow Cat
_performance_summary: High Brow Cat 'Cat' -- 1988 Chestnut Stallion. By High Brow Hickory (1983 Dun, Doc's Hickory x Missy Copper x Poco Lena -- 1986 NCHA Futurity Reserve Champion; Bill Freeman who trained HBH said: 'whatever you did to that horse yesterday, it won't work tomorrow'; 347 money earners, avg offspring earnings $13,362) out of Smart Little Kitty (Smart Little Lena x Doc's Kitty/Doc Bar -- eye injured as yearling, never shown; Jack Waggoner: 'maybe the best Doc Bar daughter that there ever was'; produced 14 foals, 12 performers earning $336,257 including High Brow Cat, Smart Lil Highbrow $99,099, Smart Bronze $72,347, High Class Kitty $29,133). Bred by Hanes Chatham and Stewart Sewell. Purchased as 2-month-old colt by Jack Waggoner and Susan Ferguson. Shown by Faron Hightower (NCHA Hall of Fame, $3M+ rider), then Jody Galyean, Olan Hightower, Jack Waggoner, and Bill Freeman. Sold in 2013 to Colt Ventures (Darren and Julie Blanton, Dallas TX) for reportedly just under $9 million. Partial co-ownership with Madison Smith, Beechfork Ranch, Weatherford TX from March 2019. Died October 2019. ICSI only. HERDA N/H -- HERDA guarantee offered with proof of mare's test results. GBED, HYPP, MH, PSSM1, IMM/MYHM all N/N. AQHA Hall of Fame Class of 2023. Valley Equine, Stephenville TX. LTE $110,784. Retired 1995. Show record: 1991 Will Rogers Futurity tied 13th (first check, shown by Faron Hightower); 1993 Augusta Futurity Classic Open Champion; multiple additional aged event placings through 1995. Faron Hightower: 'Cat had a whole lot of cow about him, but he was a tough little son of a gun.' Jack Waggoner: 'Every once in a while a horse will come along that whatever you breed him to, it will cut.' From 1998 through 2010 never bred fewer than 100 mares in a single season -- bred 205 in 2003 and 208 in 2006. Estimated 3,100+ registered AQHA foals, two-thirds performers. In six years from first crop 1996 through 2002, placed at least one offspring in five NCHA Futurity Open Finals. Became a leading sire in 1997 with his second crop. Top 10 leading cutting sire by 1999; #1 on the list by 2003. PE $97M+ (EquiStat Stallion Register, reported as of February 3, 2026 -- most current confirmed figure). AQHA All-Time Leading Sire in offspring earnings. EquiStat Elite All-Time Leading Sire. AQHA/NCHA #1 All-Time Leading Sire 2011-2022. EquiStat #1 Leading Cutting Sire 2003-2022. EquiStat #1 All-Time Leading Cutting Sire 2009-2022. NRCHA All-Time Leading Sire. Remained #1 or #2 on NCHA and Cutting Leading Sire lists since 2003 -- confirmed Valley Equine 2026. Record 8 NCHA Open Futurity Champions. 56 AQHA Champions across five disciplines. In 2021, 12 of the top 25 cutting horse sires were sons or grandsons of High Brow Cat. #2 All-Time Broodmare Sire by performance money earned -- progeny earnings in cutting alone from his daughters' foals nearly $63 million. AQHA: 'On the all-time list of sires by performance money earned, Cat is joined in the top five by his sons Metallic Cat and Smooth As A Cat; their progeny alone have combined earnings of nearly $94 million.' Top confirmed offspring: Dont Look Twice ($843,096 LTE, 2011 NCHA HoY -- dam producing $950K+); Metallic Cat ($637,711 LTE, 2008 NCHA Futurity Champion, 2009 NCHA HoY, PE $83.6M+, NCHA/NRCHA #1 All-Time Leading Sire); Little Pepto Cat ($577,430); Boon San Kitty ($565,504); Smooth As A Cat (PE ~$43M+ as sire, NCHA leading sire in own right); Bet Hesa Cat ($272,151, 2011 NCHA World Champion, 2011 NCHA HoF); Classy CD Cat (2014 NCHA Open Futurity Champion); Shiftin Gears (2026 NCHA Super Stakes Amateur Champion, scored 223.5 with Blake Heid for Mike Heid, $15,605 -- confirmed Valley Equine April 2026, proving HBC offspring still winning at major events posthumously). Elite producing daughters: Dont Look Twice (dam of Dont Stopp Believin PE $5.9M+), Show Biz Kitty (dam of Badboonarising LTE $367K), Highbrow Supercat. Madison Smith (Beechfork Ranch): 'Metallic Cat is first to mind -- a Futurity champion, Horse of the Year, and now an incredible producing sire. Several great daughters of High Brow Cat who have made an incredible mark on the industry include Dont Look Twice, Highbrow Supercat, and Show Biz Kitty.'

name: Dual Smart Rey
_performance_summary: Dual Smart Rey 'Lloyd' -- 2002 Sorrel Stallion. By Dual Rey (LTE $105,038; PE $46M+; AQHA Hall of Fame; EquiStat 2nd All-Time Leading Cutting Sire; full profile bvss001) out of The Smart Look (Smart Little Lena x -- LTE $48,723; producer of $1.9M+ confirmed Issuu; granddam of performers exceeding $23M confirmed Issuu; also dam of WR This Cats Smart LTE $236,514 2017 EquiStat Leading Reined Cow Horse Sire PE $13.5M+, One Smart Lookin Cat LTE $226,310 2003 NCHA Futurity 3YO Open Champion, SVR Reyl Smart LTE $276,623 2011 NCHA Super Stakes 4YO Open Co-Reserve Champion). 4-Panel N/N, GBED N/G. Owned by Strawn Valley Ranch, Don and Michelle Horton, Strawn TX. Valley Equine (formerly Brazos Valley Stallion Station), Stephenville TX. Foals eligible: Valley Equine Super Stallion Incentive, Breeders Invitational, NCHA Super Stakes, NRCHA Cow Horse Incentive. LTE $330,436 (confirmed multiple sources). PE $16M+ (Stallion Register Directory most current: 'offspring earnings well over $16 Million'). Confirmed full show record from Issuu black type: 2005 NCHA Open Futurity 3YO Open Semi-Finalist; 2006 NCHA Super Stakes 4YO Open Champion; 2006 Bonanza 4YO Open Champion; 2006 AQHA World Show Junior Cutting Champion; 2006 Super Stallion Incentive Fund 4YO Open Champion; 2007 Abilene Spectacular 5/6YO Open Reserve Champion; 2007 Augusta Futurity 5/6YO Open Reserve Champion. 2021 NRCHA Million Dollar Sire -- only the 22nd sire in NRCHA history to achieve this milestone confirmed NRCHA.com: 'The NRCHA Million Dollar Sire accolade has only been earned by 22 sires since the association's inception in 1949.' 2017 NCHA Top 10 Leading Sire and 2017 NRCHA Leading Sire confirmed Performance Horse Central. One of only six stallions in 49 years of NCHA history to sire an NCHA Open Futurity Champion, an NCHA Futurity Non-Pro Champion, and an NRCHA Open Snaffle Bit Futurity Champion in three separate events -- confirmed RCHTO and NCHA. In 2019 the only stallion in 39 years to sire the Open and Non-Pro champions in both age divisions of the same NCHA Super Stakes in one year -- confirmed RCHTO. Top offspring: Rollz Royce (Dual Smart Rey x Show Biz Kitty -- LTE $354,032; bvss007 full profile); Hiss N Vinegar ($391,588 -- Stallion Register Directory #1 earner); Dual Smart Kitty ($317,758 -- 2013 NCHA Open Futurity Champion); Duals Lucky Charm ($273,753 -- 2016 NRCHA Open Snaffle Bit Futurity Champion and 2020 NRCHA World's Greatest Horseman Champion); Stuffin My Pockets (2016 NCHA Non-Pro Futurity Champion); Hit Tha Flo (major earner). NCHA 2022: 'offspring earnings surpassing 11 million dollars in 2022... He has produced champions at all levels in cutting, reining and reined cowhorse, including Rollz Royce, Dual Smart Kitty, Hit Tha Flo and Duals Lucky Charm.' Michelle Horton: 'We were counting it down! It's not easy to be a reined cow horse million-dollar stud.'

name: Blazin Jetolena
_performance_summary: Blazin Jetolena -- 1999 Sorrel, 14.3H. AQHA 4459515. By Lenas Sugar Daddy (1978 Doc O'Lena son -- born at Shorty Freeman's operation, the trainer who showed Doc O'Lena to the 1970 NCHA Futurity Championship; purchased from Freeman by Wayland and Elaine Heatley of Marana, Arizona; injured as a 2-year-old which limited his show career; offspring won roping, barrel, cutting, and reining titles across multiple disciplines) out of Blazin Jennie Jet (Jet Of Honor -- a local Pacific Northwest stallion with documented NFR-qualifying get; purchased as a 3-year-old by Randy Rist in 1986 in Snohomish, Washington; shown by Sue Rist; set multiple local arena records in barrel racing and gymkhana; earned over $20,000 at open jackpots and amateur rodeos; won a go-round at the Puyallup Pro Rodeo under PRCA conditions; died 2001). Bred and raised by Randy and Sue Rist. Acquired by Jeff and Andrea Busby of Busby Quarter Horses, Millsap, Texas in 2013 -- their cornerstone stallion. Died January 17, 2023 of a sudden cardiac event at age 24. ICSI only. Valley Equine, Stephenville TX. LTE $95,201 EquiStat -- $190,000 total lifetime barrel earnings (AQHA). AQHA Register of Merit in barrel racing and pole bending. No. 1 Barrel Futurity Horse in the nation in 2003 under trainer Ryan Lovendahl -- winning seven futurities and $76,208 in his 4-year-old year alone. Qualified for the 2005 Wrangler National Finals Rodeo with Melanie Southard. Andrea Busby: 'I felt like Blazin Jetolena took us on a magic carpet ride I never even dreamed we'd go on. Blazin Jetolena legitimately changed the course of my life, and not many people get to say a horse did that.' PE $10,415,538 (EquiStat All-Time Barrel Racing Leaders -- 395 money-earning offspring, $26,368 average). Lenas Sugar Daddy (his sire line) ranks identically with $10,416,869 confirming the full genetic contribution. Blazin Jetolena ranked No. 1 sire in 2024 EquiStat barrel racing leaders with $675,752 in a single year from 33 offspring -- posthumously. Top confirmed offspring: Jets Top Gun 'Benny' ($1,084,294 -- 2024 NFR Average Champion, set the all-time record for fastest aggregate time across all 10 NFR runs; 2023 WPRA World Champion with Brittany Pozzi Tonozzi; 2023 Calgary Stampede, Salt Lake City, Reno Rodeo, and Dodge City Round-Up Champion; 2025 WNFR Average Champion; owned and bred by Busby Quarter Horses); Blingolena ($554,644 -- 2024 NFR Reserve Champion or Co-Reserve Champion of 5 barrel rounds, Patriot Vegas World Open 1D Finals Champion, Old Fort Days Champion, multiple NBHA and rodeo titles, 2024 Ruby Buckle East Open 1D Reserve Champion); Sheza Blazin Move ($385,029 -- 3x NFR qualifier, 3rd and 5th NFR barrel rounds, AQHA Reserve World Champion Junior Barrel Horse, All American Finals Reserve Champion); Jets Letters Ta Abby ($277,915); JR Naughty Jet ($250,266 -- Cheyenne Frontier Days and Pendleton short round qualifiers); Jets Heart N Soul ($235,880); Blazin Babe Olena ($204,970); KG Jukebox Hero ($195,304); Blazin Sugar Daddy ($190,752). As maternal grandsire: Famous Lil Jet by Dash Ta Fame out of Blazin Black Beauty (Blazin Jetolena daughter) -- LTE $1,324,495, 2022 WPRA World Champion with Jordon Briggs, 4th highest-earning barrel horse of all time. No. 15 all-time leading maternal grandsire for barrel horses at $2.8M+ in grandget earnings. Described in his own promotional material: 'The speed of Jet Deck, the mind of Doc O'Lena, and the ability of both these legendary sires have come together in Blazin Jetolena to achieve the ultimate barrel horse.' Offspring described as 'quick footed, want to work, and have great minds which make them incredibly trainable.' ICSI dose available at Valley Equine.

name: Bet Hesa Cat
_performance_summary: Bet Hesa Cat — 2006 Red Roan, 14.2H, 1050 lbs. By High Brow Cat (High Brow Hickory x Smart Little Kitty/Smart Little Lena — NCHA and AQHA #1 All-Time Leading Sire with PE $98.7M+, sire of a record 8 NCHA Open Futurity Champions, QData All-Time #1 Cutting Sire, also #1 Leading Sire of Sires and #1 Leading Sire of Dams — inducted into the AQHA Quarter Horse Hall of Fame 2023; High Brow Cat's offspring are described as producing horses with elite cow sense, athleticism, and pure trainability and intelligence across all western performance disciplines) out of Bet Yer Blue Boons (Freckles Playboy x Royal Blue Boon/Boon Bar — LTE $350,615, 2000 NCHA Open World Champion, 1997 NCHA Open Reserve World Champion, NCHA Hall of Fame, dam of foals earning nearly $6M). Bet Yer Blue Boons is a half-sibling to Im Countin Checks ($514,757, PE $5.6M+, NCHA Hall of Fame) making Autumn Boon's Boon Bar female family one of the most productive in cutting history. LTE $272,151. 2011 NCHA Open World Champion, shown by Austin Shepard (NCHA Hall of Fame earner $8.4M — nine-time NCHA Eastern Nationals Open Champion and one of the most decorated cutting horse riders of his generation). NCHA Hall of Fame. The only NCHA World Champion Stallion in history whose dam is also an NCHA World Champion. The first horse to win the NCHA Open World Championship Stallion title at age 5. NRCHA Million Dollar Sire. One of only four stallions in history to sire an NRCHA Open Snaffle Bit Futurity Champion and Reserve Champion in the same year. PE $4M+. Top offspring: Bet He Sparks (2024 American Performance Horseman Team Champion Working Cow Horse, 2023 World's Greatest Horseman, NRCHA SBF Intermediate Open Reserve Champion, LTE $298K+), Plain Catty (2017 NRCHA SBF Open Champion, LTE $183K), Bet Hes Black (2017 NRCHA SBF Open Reserve Champion), Bet Hesa Boon (2025 NRCHA World's Greatest Horseman Herd Work Champion), Bet Hes Blu (NSHA RCH Open Futurity Finalist, NRCHA Open Futurity Finalist). High Brow Cat passes elite cow sense, athleticism, and trainable intelligence — his offspring are consistent across all western performance disciplines from cutting to reined cow horse to ranch versatility. Bet Yer Blue Boons adds world-champion competitive drive and the proven Boon Bar/Royal Blue Boon dam-line athleticism. The combination of High Brow Cat's dominant gene pool with a World Champion dam who is herself a proven producer creates offspring with exceptional range across cutting, cow horse, and ranch disciplines. Described at 6666 Ranch as an all-around type stallion equally suited to cutting and cow horse programs. 6-Panel Negative — all genetic tests clean. An ideal cross for High Brow Cat and Metallic Cat mares seeking Peptoboonsmal-line genetics without HERDA risk. Stud fee $4,000. Standing at 6666 Ranch, Guthrie TX.

name: Stevie Rey Von
_performance_summary: Stevie Rey Von — 2012 Red Roan, 14.2H. By Metallic Cat (High Brow Cat x Chers Shadow/Peptoboonsmal — LTE $637,711, 2008 NCHA Open Futurity Champion, 2009 NCHA Horse of the Year, NCHA Hall of Fame, NRCHA Hall of Fame, PE $83M+, QData and NCHA #2 All-Time Leading Sire, QData and NRCHA #1 All-Time Leading Sire — led NCHA sire standings every year 2016-2024) out of Miss Ella Rey (Dual Rey x Huggs Olena/Smart Chic Olena). Miss Ella Rey was bred by LKC Ranch in Longmont, Colorado. She earned $209,491 in competition: 2011 NCHA Super Stakes Limited Non-Pro Champion, 2013 and 2014 AQHA Amateur Cutting World Champion. Huggs Olena, Miss Ella Rey's dam, is by Smart Chic Olena — the #1 All-Time Leading NRCHA Sire with PE $11M+. LTE $420,559. PE $20M+ (2025). 2015 NCHA Open Futurity Champion. NCHA Hall of Fame. #1 QData Leading Sire 2025 across all disciplines. The only living stallion in NCHA Open Futurity history to be an NCHA Open Futurity Champion, sired by an NCHA Open Futurity Champion, and to have sired an NCHA Open Futurity Champion. In 2022 was leading sire at both the NCHA Futurity AND the NRCHA Snaffle Bit Futurity in the same year — the only stallion other than Metallic Cat to accomplish this. NRCHA $3M+ sire. Offspring PE average $14,244 per horse — 40% higher than sire Metallic Cat. 56 NCHA Futurity earners from 31 different dam sires confirms he crosses on everything. 365 foals born in 2023 alone — full book with waiting list into 2027. HERDA negative (6 Panel N/N) — can cross safely on all High Brow Cat and Metallic Cat mares. Offspring consistently described as: "incredibly gentle and effortless to handle," "requires minimal riding and training," "so accurate and never takes a foot out of place," "incredibly smart." Trainer Beau Galyean: "The other thing that Stevie offers that's so huge is that he's negative for HERDA. So all the mares out there that have HERDA, they now have a Cat-related stud to go to that doesn't carry the HERDA gene." Top offspring: Janie Wood (2021 NCHA Futurity Open Champion, $311K), Swing Wide ($353K, standing at Valley Equine), Tornado Jonez (2022 NRCHA SBF Open + Intermediate Open Champion, $266K), Hottie Rey Von (2024 BI Derby Open Champion, $224K), Smart Von Lena ($454K). Now owned by Jason and Kisha Itkin of Theorem Ranch. Stud fee $10,000. Beau Galyean Stallion Services, Weatherford TX.

name: Hashtags
_performance_summary: Hashtags 'Tag' -- 2013 Blue Roan Stallion. By Metallic Cat (QData/NCHA #2 All-Time Leading Cutting Sire, NRCHA #1 All-Time Leading Sire, PE $83.6M+, 2008 NCHA Futurity Champion, 2009 NCHA HoY, NCHA HoF -- full profile separate entry) out of Dual Rey Tag (Dual Rey x Playin Tag/Playgun -- LTE $57,251; 2009 NCHA Futurity 3YO Open semifinalist; 2010 NCHA Summer Spectacular 4YO Open semifinalist; dam produce confirmed $1.1M+ across 9 earners including Hashtags $485K, Tagging $268,992 NCHA Open Futurity Reserve Champion, Stag $121,891 2023 PCCHA Amateur Classic/Challenge Gelding Champion, Taggline $65,013 NCHA Open Futurity finalist and 2023 AQHA World L2 Senior WCH Champion, Pound Sign $56,694 AQHA World Champion Junior Cutting Horse, Tagging It $44,474 top 10 NRCHA Open Futurity). Playin Tag (Dual Rey Tag's dam): by Playgun (Freckles Playboy x Gay Jay/Rey Jay x Peponita dam line) -- the pedigree carries documented Super Stakes affinity traced through this lineage. Dual Rey (dam's sire): LTE $105,038, AQHA Hall of Fame, PE $51M+, NCHA #3 All-Time Leading Cutting Sire, top 25 All-Time Leading Maternal Grandsire -- daughters have produced earners of more than $10 million in the arena including Super Stakes Champions Reys Desire, TR Dual Rey, Dual Smart Rey, and SVL Reyl Smart. QHN 'In the Blood' analysis confirms the pedigree carries a collateral linebreeding to Peptoboonsmal and Dual Pep -- confirmed three-quarter brothers in blood through Metallic Cat's dam line and Dual Rey's sire Dual Pep. Bred by Jim Haworth, Southwest City, Missouri. Owned by Hashtag Ventures LP, Bluff Dale TX. Shown throughout career by Tatum Rice. Genetic panel: 4-Panel N/N, HERDA N/N, GBED N/G (one-copy carrier -- mare owners should test). Standing at Valley Equine, Stephenville TX. LTE $485,293. Described as 'a Navy SEAL in the cutting pen for the way he won everything regardless of footing.' Confirmed full show record: 2016 NCHA Futurity 3YO Open finalist; 2017 NCHA Super Stakes 4YO Open Champion (scored 220, $74,095); 2017 West Texas Futurity 4YO Open Champion; 2017 Idaho Futurity Derby 4YO Open Champion; 2017 NCHA Summer Spectacular 3rd (tie) 4YO Open; 2017 Breeders Invitational 4th 4YO Open; 2017 PCCHA Derby, The Ike, and Cattlemens Derby 4YO Open finalist; 2018 Bonanza Cutting 5/6YO Open Champion; 2018 Idaho Futurity 5/6YO Open Champion; 2018 Augusta Futurity 5/6YO Open Reserve Champion; 2018 Breeders Invitational 5/6YO Open Champion; 2018 El Rancho Futurity 5/6YO Open Champion; 2018 NCHA World Championship Finals Open Reserve Champion; 2018 NCHA Open World Champion. NCHA Hall of Fame. PE $5,327,661 (EquiStat Stallion Register). 2022 NCHA Leading Freshman Sire. 2024 NCHA #7 Leading Cutting Sire. 2025 QData Top 15 Leading Cutting Sire. Top confirmed offspring: Too Hot To Tagg (x Too Hot/Hottish, LTE $721,000+, 2025 NCHA Open Reserve Horse of the Year, 2024 NCHA Open Futurity Champion, 2024 NCHA Open Derby Champion, 2024 PCCHA Open Derby Co-Champion, 2026 NCHA Super Stakes 5/6YO Open Reserve Champion scored 223 with Kenny Platt for JH Nail Ranch); Jazlyn (x MK Cats Kitty/Spots Hot, 2024 NCHA Open Horse of the Year, 2024 NCHA Super Stakes 4YO Open Champion scored 228 with James Payne for Kathleen Moore, 2025 NCHA Reserve Horse of the Year -- bred by Slate River Ranch); FS Fine Lil Hashtag (2026 NCHA Super Stakes 4YO Amateur Derby Champion, scored 225 with Sawyer McWilliams for Brittinee McWilliams, $8,416); Price Tagg (2026 NCHA Super Stakes Amateur Reserve Champion, scored 219, $5,414, Reagan Glenn); Ms Milania (x Little Miss One Time/One Time Pepto, LTE $191,609); Purposely Tagged (2025 ARHFA Sun Circuit heading winner with Joseph Harrison for $11,473 -- 'winningest futurity heeler in America'). Three-time PRCA World Champion Junior Nogueira (bred his $750K+ ProRodeo mare Apache R Hali to Hashtags): 'She's absolutely beautiful, and she moves so effortlessly. Everything has been easy for her, and she's been gentle and kind since day one.' Wes Ashlock on Ms Milania: 'This has been the best cross so far. She's extremely smart. I've had several Hashtags I've sold through the 2-year-old sales, and I've had a great experience with them. I wish I had more.' NRCHA trainer Corey Cushing: 'The few I have rode have been trainable, willing and talented. He offers a lot that way.'

name: Dual Reyish
_performance_summary: Dual Reyish 'Dre' -- 2014 Chestnut Stallion. By Hottish (Spots Hot x Shes Hott/Smart Little Lena -- LTE $301,843; 2012 NCHA Super Stakes 4YO Non-Pro Champion; 2012 Breeders Invitational 4YO Open Champion; 2012 NCHA Summer Spectacular 4YO Open Champion; 2012 South Point Futurity 4YO Open Champion; 2012 Wrangler Futurity 4YO Open Reserve Champion; 2012 Idaho Futurity 4YO Open Reserve Champion; 2014 NCHA Summer Spectacular 5/6YO Non-Pro Champion; PE $4.1M+ at time of death; ranked #4 among 2020s leading cutting sires at time of death -- behind only Metallic Cat, Dual Rey, and High Brow Cat; humanely euthanized February 7 at Springtown TX ranch of Dustin and Deena Adams) out of A Little Reylena (Dual Rey x Katie Little Lena/Smart Little Lena -- LTE $126,608; confirmed show record: 2006 Utah Futurity 3rd 3YO Open, 2006 Idaho Futurity 3YO Open finalist, 2008 NCHA Summer Spectacular 5/6YO Non-Pro 50K Champion, 2008 Utah Futurity 5/6YO Non-Pro Co-Champion, 2009 NCHA Super Stakes 5/6YO Non-Pro Reserve Champion, 2009 The Mane Event 5/6YO Non-Pro Reserve Champion; QData and NCHA Top 15 All-Time Leading Dam; confirmed produce earnings $1.5M+ including Dual Reyish $452K, Lone Woolf $668,310 2023 NCHA Open Futurity Champion and NCHA Horse of the Year, Hay U $200,245 multiple Non-Pro champion, Rey To Sly $103,208). Dual Rey (A Little Reylena's sire): LTE $105,038, AQHA Hall of Fame, QData and NCHA #3 All-Time Leading Cutting Sire, PE $57.9M+, 65 World or Reserve World Champion offspring. 6-Panel N/N. Owned by Billy Wolf, Wolf Livestock, Whitesboro TX. ICSI Only. Highest money-earning son of Hottish. Valley Equine, Stephenville TX. LTE $452,687. 2017 NCHA Open Futurity Champion. NCHA Hall of Fame. Described as the perfect outcross for conformation, athleticism, cow smarts, great mind, and perfect disposition. Multiple Aged Event Champion. Confirmed full show record: 2017 NCHA Open Futurity Champion; 2018 Cotton Stakes Open Derby Reserve Champion; 2018 Southern Futurity Open Derby Reserve Champion; 2018 AQHA Congress Open Derby Champion; 2018 Brazos Bash Open Derby Top 5 finalist; 2018 NCHA Super Stakes Open Derby finalist; 2018 Augusta Futurity Open Derby finalist; 2018 Bonanza Cutting Open Derby finalist; 2019 NCHA Eastern Nationals Classic Open Champion; 2019 NCHA Summer Spectacular Open Classic finalist; 2019 Cotton Stakes Open Classic finalist. PE $2,517,756 (Valley Equine 2026). 2025 QData Top 20 Leading Cutting Sire. Top confirmed offspring: LBR Hangem (2025 NCHA Open Classic/Challenge Co-Champion, scored 228 with Kenny Platt for Solo Select Horses, NCHA Hall of Fame inductee at this event, $32,696 earned -- confirmed Valley Equine April 2026 Super Stakes recap); Weezy F Baby (2025 NCHA Non-Pro Futurity Champion -- confirmed Valley Equine 2026 lineup); Xxplosive (2026 NCHA Super Stakes Non-Pro Co-Reserve Champion, scored 218 with Kristen Galyean for Glover/Galyean Partnership LLC, $38,937). The combination of Hottish speed and athleticism over the deep Dual Rey dam line -- A Little Reylena is a confirmed QData/NCHA Top 15 All-Time Leading Dam -- creates a cross with two generations of elite NCHA titleholders on both sides. Dual Reyish's sire Hottish and his dam's sire Dual Rey were both leading NCHA sires in their own right, making this a convergence of two of the most productive cutting bloodlines of the modern era. His own production is accelerating: LBR Hangem's 228 score at the 2026 Super Stakes placed him among the elite performances of the year and added an NCHA Hall of Fame induction to Dual Reyish's sire report.

name: CD Son Of Magnolia
_performance_summary: CD Son Of Magnolia — 2003 Sorrel, 14.2H, 1050 lbs. By CD Olena (LTE $170,706 — 1994 NCHA Open Futurity Champion shown by Todd Schlup; 1995 NCHA Horse of the Year; QData and NCHA #5 All-Time Leading Sire with 535 money-earners and PE $14.1M; he was described by trainers as a bright-lights horse who elevated his performance when championship money was on the line — stepping up in go-rounds and finals that mattered most) out of Eye Of The Magnolia (by Smell The Magnolias). CD Olena traces directly to two of the industry's most foundational stallions. His sire Doc O'Lena (Doc Bar x Poco Lena/Poco Bueno — AQHA and NCHA Hall of Fame, 1970 NCHA Futurity Champion under Shorty Freeman) sired Smart Little Lena — the first NCHA Triple Crown winner, #2 All-Time Leading NCHA Sire with $39M+ in offspring, who was syndicated for $2.1 million in 1978, a record at that time for the cutting horse industry. Doc O'Lena's own trainer Shorty Freeman described him as "a thinking horse with a natural connection with the cow." CD Olena's dam is CD Chica San Badger by Peppy San Badger (LTE $279,341 — King Ranch bred, first NCHA World Champion to sire another World Champion, PE $28M+; his get include Little Pepto Gal $526K NCHA HoY, Copaspepto $480K NCHA HoY, Peptoboonsmal $180K NCHA Futurity Champion). This gives CD Olena direct access to both the Doc Bar (via Doc O'Lena) and King Ranch Peppy San Badger (via CD Chica San Badger) lines — two of the pillars of foundation cutting genetics. CD Olena daughters confirmed elite producers: they produced High Brow CD (2007 NCHA Futurity Champion under Beau Galyean, 2008 NCHA Horse of the Year, PE $14.1M+) confirming the line's generational elite production continues. LTE $69,963. Owned by Beggs Cattle Company. The value of CD Son Of Magnolia is concentrated on the top side of his pedigree. The Doc O'Lena tail-male line through CD Olena is rare in the modern cutting horse gene pool — most contemporary horses trace Doc O'Lena through daughters rather than sons, making this stallion a genuine outcross for the dominant Metallic Cat, High Brow Cat, and Dual Rey bloodlines that saturate today's cutting industry. Breeders seeking authentic Doc Bar and Doc O'Lena tail-male genetics — while crossing on modern dominant dam-side bloodlines — find this stallion an unusual and biologically legitimate option. The dam line through Smell The Magnolias is not a documented elite performance sire, placing this breeding value firmly in the top half of the pedigree. Peppy San Badger on the second cross adds additional foundation King Ranch genetics that many modern breeders actively seek to reintroduce. Standing at 6666 Ranch, Guthrie TX.

name: Smart Chic Olena
_performance_summary: Smart Chic Olena 'Chic' -- 1985 Sorrel Stallion. By Smart Little Lena (Doc O'Lena x Smart Peppy/Peppy San -- NCHA Triple Crown winner; #2 All-Time Leading Cutting Sire PE $42M+; Doc O'Lena 1970 NCHA Futurity Champion; Peppy San 1967 NCHA World Champion Cutting Horse, AQHA Hall of Fame; Smart Little Lena himself was the NCHA Triple Crown winner earning $743,275 -- first horse ever to achieve it) out of Gay Sugar Chic (Gay Bar King x Gay Widow -- Gay Bar King by Three Bars TB, AQHA Hall of Fame sire of 5 AQHA Champions, offspring NCHA earnings $732K+; Gay Widow AQHA Champion, superior in halter; Gay Sugar Chic produce earnings $401,895, full sister to winner of 1981 NCHA Non-Pro Derby; TRJ confirms Three Bars and Chicaro TB ancestors on bottom side bring speed genetics). Bred by Emily Woodall, New Caney TX. Purchased for $25,000 by Bill Glass during the recession. Then purchased by Jim Babcock of Texas. Trainers in cutting: Bill Glass, Bill Freeman, Dell Bell, Randy Butler. Reining trainer: Craig Johnson. Jim Babcock: 'I paid $25,000 for him during the recession -- so I gambled on Chic, but he never made me sorry for it.' Died June 24, 2012, at age 27, owned by Bill Richardson, Whitesboro TX. Semen and breeding rights acquired October 2015 by Dr. Trevor and Tiffiny Bond, Smokin Gun Performance Horses, Mound Valley KS. 5-Panel Negative. Extremely limited -- ICSI only, with rare frozen semen available; all breeding managed through Valley Equine. AQHA Hall of Fame. NRHA Hall of Fame (2004). NRCHA Hall of Fame. Valley Equine, Stephenville TX. LTE $167,472. The ONLY horse in history to win AQHA World Championships in both cutting and reining. Full confirmed show record: 1988 NCHA Futurity Open -- advanced to semifinals (lost a cow in semis, shown by Bill Glass); 1989 NCHA Super Stakes Open 3rd place (scored 220, earned $32,000+, shown by both Bill Glass and Bill Freeman); 1990 AQHA World Champion Senior Cutting Horse; 1990 The Non-Pro Open Cutting Co-Champion; 1990 Bonanza Open Classic 5th; 1990 NCHA Open Finals top 10; 1991 Congress Open Cutting Champion; 1991 AQHA World Champion Senior Reining (after retiring from cutting); 1993 AQHA World Champion Senior Reining; 1993 NRHA Open Reserve World Champion; 1993 Congress NRHA Open Champion; 1993 NRHA Derby Open Champion. Breeding fee: started at $750 as an unknown quantity; rose to $25,000 by age 20 -- entirely on the merit of his offspring. H&R: 'He's just an awfully smart, awfully good horse.' His foals were predominantly sorrels and chestnuts, many with blaze faces and characteristic roaning patterns -- Babcock: 'Chic proved a dominant sire from the start. His foals all looked alike.' PE $15,449,532 (Valley Equine 2026). First appeared on leading sire list in 1995 with just two foal crops showing. Became the #1 All-Time Leading Sire. QData Top 5 All-Time Leading Reined Cow Horse Sire. Top 10 All-Time Leading Reining Sire. Top 10 All-Time Leading Ranch Riding Sire -- confirmed Valley Equine 2026. 26 confirmed earners of more than $100,000. NRCHA Million Dollar Sire (2004). 2,077 registered AQHA foals, 1,037 money earners. Prepotency stretched nearly 3 decades from 1991 through 2019. Top confirmed offspring: Smart Spook ($405,650 LTE -- 2004 NRHA Futurity Open Champion with Shawn Flarida; EquiStat Elite $6 Million Sire himself); Olena Oak ($381,390 LTE, NRCHA portion $346,398 -- highest-earning NRCHA horse at time of documentation, also earning in cutting and reining); Chics Magic Potion ($246,705 NRCHA LTE); A Chic In Time ($300K+ earner); Smart Crackin Chic ($191,375 NRCHA); Travelin Jonez ($174,785 NRCHA). QHN: 'There is no doubt Chic made a lasting impact on the Western performance industry when he showed that competing at a high level in multiple disciplines was possible.' TRJ: 'Some stallions win. A rare few transform the direction of an entire industry. Smart Chic Olena did both. He remains the only horse in history to win AQHA world championships in both cutting and reining.' His significance as a maternal grandsire is equally confirmed: his daughters have produced elite performers across cutting, reining, cow horse, barrel racing, and team roping.

name: Metallic Rebel
_performance_summary: Metallic Rebel -- 2012 Red Roan Stallion. By Metallic Cat (QData/NCHA #2 All-Time Leading Cutting Sire, NRCHA #1 All-Time Leading Sire, PE $83.6M+, 2008 NCHA Futurity Champion, 2009 NCHA HoY, NCHA HoF -- full profile bvss002) out of Sweet Abra (Abrakadabracre x The Better Choice/SR Instant Choice -- LTE $120,151; Battle In The Saddle World Series Open Champion; NCHA Super Stakes Open Classic finalist; AQHA World Amateur Cutting 3rd; Breeders Invitational Amateur Derby 4th; AQHA ROM 18.5 points; dam produce $1,048,799+ including Metallic Rebel $438K, Magistic Moon $177,729, Sweet Metallic $157,607, Magic Metallic $139,204, Magic Metalman $57,375, Abra Cat $31,554). Abrakadabracre (Sweet Abra's sire): notable daughter My Little Abra ($64,220) produced Ichis My Choice -- LTE $402,186, 2015 NCHA Horse of the Year, 2016 Breeders Invitational Open Derby Champion, 2016 NCHA Open Super Stakes Reserve Champion -- confirming the Abrakadabracre maternal line's elite production capacity. Bred by Fults Ranch Ltd, Amarillo TX. Owned by Thomas and Lisa Guinn, Philadelphia MS. 13 Championship titles and 3 Reserve Championships in show career per metallicrebel.com. Stud fee $10,000. Valley Equine, Stephenville TX. LTE $438,315. 2017 NCHA Open Horse of the Year. NCHA World Champion Stallion. NCHA Hall of Fame inductee. Confirmed show titles include 2016 PCCHA Open Derby Champion. Total career record: 13 Championships and 3 Reserve Championships. metallicrebel.com: 'He has an amazing mind and is so cowy.' First son of Metallic Cat to reach EquiStat Elite $1 Million Sire status -- hit the milestone in April of his offspring's 4-year-old year, one month faster than his own sire Metallic Cat achieved it. First crop: 162 AQHA-registered foals born 2018. 2022 NCHA Leading Freshman Sire. PE $16,638,605 (Valley Equine 2026 -- most current confirmed figure). 2024 QData and NCHA #3 Leading Sire. 2024 NRCHA #4 Leading Sire. QData #2 Leading Reined Cow Horse Sire (confirmed Valley Equine Armour announcement Dec 2025). Average $44,000 per performer. QHN 5-Year Stats (2019-2024): 222 money earners, $6,540,069. Top confirmed offspring: Lone Woolf (x A Little Reylena/Dual Rey, LTE $668,310, 2023 NCHA Open Futurity Champion, NCHA Reserve Horse of the Year, NCHA Hall of Fame -- confirmed highest-earning Metallic Rebel offspring); Armour (x Coureygous/Dual Rey, LTE $379,775, Breeders Invitational Open Derby Champion, standing Valley Equine 2026); Third Edge (x Lil Rattler/Dual Rey, $342,253, 2022 NCHA Super Stakes Open Co-Champion scored 229); Reybels Cause (x Twice As Reycy/Dual Rey, 2022 NCHA Super Stakes Open Co-Champion scored 229, $220,659); A Reyl Rebel (x Never Reylinquish, $185,981 NRCHA, 2024 NRCHA Western Derby Open Champion -- defended title back-to-back with Nick Dowers); Spanish Nights (NRCHA Stallion Stakes Open Champion with Veronica Swales -- confirmed metallicrebel.com/news); Poccahontas (x Daisy Poochanan/Smooth As A Cat, 2025 NCHA Reserve Amateur Horse of the Year, 2024 NCHA Amateur Futurity Champion and Intermediate Amateur Futurity Champion, owned/shown by Marcos Chacron-Arocha); Midnight In Harlem (2026 NCHA Super Stakes Non-Pro Champion, scored 219 with Ashley Galyean for Beau and Ashley Galyean, $8,453 -- confirmed Valley Equine April 2026); Phantomm (2026 NCHA Super Stakes Amateur Reserve Champion, scored 218.5 with German Lugo, $8,695). Valley Equine Armour release: 'Metallic Rebel is currently the QData #2 Leading Reined Cow Horse Sire. His progeny earnings already exceed $15 million.' The Metallic Rebel cross on Dual Rey daughters has proven exceptionally productive -- Third Edge, Reybels Cause, Lone Woolf, Reybels Cause all carry Dual Rey on the dam side.

name: Hottish
_performance_summary: Hottish -- 2008 Sorrel Stallion. By Spots Hot (2004 NCHA Futurity Open Champion -- confirmed from QHN; Spots Hot standing at Valley Equine, his offspring produce confirmed in the cutting horse industry) out of Stylish Play Lena (Docs Stylish Oak x -- LTE $289,623; QData #4 All-Time Leading Cutting Dam -- confirmed Valley Equine 2026; produce earnings $1.6M+ including Hottish as leading earner, Smooth Talkin Style, and Pepto Boom; dam page confirms exceptional production capacity across multiple elite performers). Bred by Double Dove Ranch. Owned by Dustin and Deena Adams, Springtown TX. Passed away 2020. ICSI only. NRCHA Million Dollar Sire (milestone July 2025 -- confirmed NRCHA announcement). Valley Equine, Stephenville TX. LTE $301,843. 2012 NCHA Reserve Horse of the Year. Confirmed full show record: 2011 NCHA Open Futurity finalist; 2012 NCHA Open Derby Champion; 2012 Breeders Invitational 4YO Open Champion; 2012 NCHA Super Stakes 4YO Non-Pro Champion; 2012 NCHA Summer Spectacular 4YO Open Champion; 2012 South Point Futurity 4YO Open Champion; 2012 Idaho Futurity 4YO Open Reserve Champion; 2012 Wrangler Futurity 4YO Open Reserve Champion; 2012 Calgary Stampede Wrangler Open Derby Reserve Champion; 2012 NCHA Reserve Horse of the Year; 2013 Bonanza Open Classic finalist; 2014 NCHA Non-Pro Classic/Challenge Champion; 2014 NCHA Summer Spectacular 5/6YO Non-Pro Champion; 2014 Bonanza Open Classic top 10; 2014 NCHA Super Stakes Open Classic finalist. Dustin Adams (owner): 'He is the most trainable horse that I have ever ridden. I see that in his babies. A lot of different styles of trainers are getting along with him. Everyone talked about how much of a freak athlete Hottish was, and he absolutely was, but my favorite part about that horse was the fact that he was like a big teddy bear. He was a lover. You could hurt his feelings, and he loved his job. He had charisma on a cow, and I see that in some of his babies a lot.' Deena Adams (NRCHA Million Dollar Sire milestone): 'Hottish becoming an NRCHA Million Dollar Sire is huge for us. It's very rewarding to watch his legacy grow. We're grateful for the advances in science that allow us to continue his breeding career, and we love how Hottie continues to bless our family and so many others.' PE $23,842,560 (Valley Equine Hottish page -- most current confirmed). 2025 QData #3 Leading Sire. 2024 NCHA #4 Leading Sire. QData and NCHA Top 12 All-Time Leading Cutting Sire. NRCHA Million Dollar Sire milestone confirmed July 2025. At time of death in 2020, ranked #4 among leading cutting sires behind only Metallic Cat, Dual Rey, and High Brow Cat. Top confirmed offspring: Kittennish (million-dollar mare, NCHA Horse of the Year -- confirmed Valley Equine Hottish page as leading female earner); Phil N Dangerous (x Lil Maddy Rey/Dual Smart Rey, LTE $575,979, NCHA Open Futurity Champion, 2025 NCHA Open Classic/Challenge Co-Champion, standing Valley Equine 2026); Hottish Metal (x Show Me The Rey/Metallic Cat, LTE $497,370, NCHA Horse of the Year, NCHA Hall of Fame, standing Valley Equine 2026); Dual Reyish (x A Little Reylena/Dual Rey, LTE $452,687, 2017 NCHA Open Futurity Champion, NCHA Hall of Fame, standing Valley Equine 2026); Cool N Hot (x Donas Cool Cat/High Brow Cat, LTE $435,069, 2018 NCHA Horse of the Year, NCHA Hall of Fame, standing Valley Equine 2026); Countin Hot Checks (x Cat Countin Checks/Im Countin Checks, LTE $296,780, 2023 NCHA Open World Champion, standing Valley Equine 2026); Hott Rod (NRCHA World's Greatest Horseman Champion -- confirmed Valley Equine Hottish page); Blackish (x SS Blacks Lil Kitty/Bayou Boon, 4YO Open Champion at The Ike with Lloyd Cox -- confirmed QHN 2018); Swish (2026 NCHA Super Stakes 5/6YO Open Champion, scored 221.5 with Clayton Carter for Carol Anderson Ward, $12,132 -- confirmed Valley Equine April 2026); Sneakish (x Smooth Sneakin/Smooth As A Cat, 2017 NCHA Futurity Limited Non-Pro Co-Champion -- confirmed QHN 2018). QHN: 'Mare owners can really breed anything to him' -- confirmed as a genuine outcross for the dominant bloodlines of the era.

name: Rollz Royce
_performance_summary: Rollz Royce -- 2014 Sorrel Stallion, 14.1H. By Dual Smart Rey (Dual Rey x The Smart Look -- LTE $330,436; 2006 NCHA Super Stakes 4YO Open Champion; 2006 Bonanza 4YO Open Champion; 2006 AQHA World Champion Junior Cutting Horse; 2005 NCHA Futurity 3YO Open semifinalist; 2007 Abilene Spectacular 5/6YO Open Reserve Champion; 2007 Augusta Futurity 5/6YO Open Reserve Champion; PE $11M+ by 2022, confirmed NCHA 2022 announcement; sire of Rollz Royce, Dual Smart Kitty $317,758 NCHA Open Futurity Champion, Carolena Reyn $275,587 NCHA Non-Pro Super Stakes Co-Champion) out of Show Biz Kitty (High Brow Cat x Show Biz Sandy/Son Ofa Doc -- confirmed QData/NCHA #1 All-Time Leading Dam -- Valley Equine 2026 lineup states 'Show Biz Kitty, the industry's #1 All-Time Leading Dam'; suffered serious hock injury in 2005 before planned 2006 NCHA Futurity debut, never shown; purchased by Royce Stallcup in 2013 after seeing her potential as a broodmare; confirmed produce: Kittennish $729,112 NCHA HoY by Hottish, Rollz Royce by Dual Smart Rey, Badboonarising $367,101 NCHA Open Futurity Reserve Champion by Once In A Blu Boon, Storyteller $381,604 by Smooth Talkin Style, SS Blacks Lil Kitty $188,241 by Blue Bayou Boon; dam produce earnings $970,000+ at earlier count, now substantially higher). Show Biz Sandy (Show Biz Kitty's dam by Son Ofa Doc): LTE $91,889; produce $370,000+; grandget $1.7M+. 4-Panel N/N, GBED N/G. Bred by Starkey Smith. Owned by Tom and Lisa Guinn, Philadelphia MS -- same ownership as Metallic Rebel. Retired to stallion barn 2021 after claiming full books since first standing. Stud fee $7,500, booked full for 2026. Valley Equine, Stephenville TX. LTE $354,032. In-foal partners: 'Rollz Royce could dance in the show pen like no other, his ability to mirror a cow left his fans in awe.' EquiStat Leading Cutting Freshman Sire. Full confirmed show record: 2019 NCHA Super Stakes Open Classic Champion; 2019 NCHA Open Classic/Challenge Champion; 2019 NCHA Summer Spectacular Open Classic Champion; 2019 Bonanza Open Classic Champion; 2019 Arbuckle Mountain Open Classic Co-Reserve Champion; 2019 Southern Open Classic 4th; 2020 Cattlemens Classic Open Champion; 2020 The Ike Open Classic Champion; 2020 Brazos Bash Open Classic 3rd; 2020 West Texas Open Classic Reserve Champion; 2020 Cotton Stakes Open Classic Reserve Champion; 2020 Southern Open Classic split 3rd; 2020 Arbuckle Mountain Open Classic Reserve Champion; 2020 Bonanza Open Classic 6th. PE $4,979,851 (Valley Equine 2026). 2025 QData #6 Leading Cutting Sire. Top confirmed offspring: Rollz Eh (x This Cats Smilen/WR This Cats Smart, LTE $720,000+, 2025 NCHA Open Horse of the Year, NCHA Open Futurity Reserve Champion, NCHA Super Stakes Open Derby Champion, PCCHA Open Derby Co-Champion, shown by Austin Shepard for owner Billy Wolf -- confirmed Valley Equine Dec 2025); Nu Rollz Royce (2026 NCHA Super Stakes Amateur Reserve Champion, scored 221.5 with Elle Elizabeth Martin for Nancy and Steve Martin, $14,065 -- confirmed Valley Equine April 2026); Rollz (2026 NCHA Super Stakes 5/6YO Open Reserve Champion, scored 216 with Paul Wasyln for Harold Bailey, $6,680 -- confirmed Valley Equine April 2026); NCHA Non-Pro Futurity Champion (confirmed Valley Equine 2026 lineup). Stallion Register: 'Rollz Royce should be your consideration on all your Cat breed mares' -- the Dual Smart Rey x High Brow Cat cross creates an exceptional complement to Metallic Cat and High Brow Cat mares. Tom Guinn, owner: 'This is all still sinking in. Rollz Royce sired the 2025 NCHA Open Horse of the Year. We followed Rollz Eh and Austin Shepard all year -- every run, every show -- and it truly was a race to the finish. We could not be prouder. Austin has such a gift for bringing out the best in a horse, and she gave him her heart every single time.' With contracts booked full for 2026, demand for Rollz Royce has outpaced supply from the first crop forward.

name: Cool N Hot
_performance_summary: Cool N Hot 'Trigger' -- 2014 Chestnut Stallion, 14.1H, 1022 lbs. By Hottish (Spots Hot x Stylish Play Lena/Docs Stylish Oak -- PE $23.8M+, 2025 QData #3 Leading Sire, 2024 NCHA #4 Leading Sire, NRCHA Million Dollar Sire, deceased 2020 ICSI only -- full profile bvss005) out of Donas Cool Cat (High Brow Cat x Sweet Peppy Again/Peppy San Badger -- LTE $318,908; 2007 NCHA World Finals Non-Pro 3rd place; NCHA Youth World Championship with Lane Wood; confirmed QData and NCHA Top 15 All-Time Leading Dam of cutting money-earners per Valley Equine 2026; dam produce nearly $900,000 including Cool N Hot and Donas Suen Boon -- 2013 NCHA Futurity Non-Pro Champion, 2014 NCHA Super Stakes Classic Non-Pro Champion, and 2x AQHA World Champion in cutting with Kobie). Sweet Peppy Again (Donas Cool Cat's dam, Peppy San Badger x Sweet Sugar Again/Sugar Again): LTE $13,602, dam produce $442,179 including Scat Daddy $62,295 full brother to Donas Cool Cat. QHN pedigree analysis confirms linebreeding pattern in this pedigree: 'three-quarter brothers' pattern through Sugar Bars and Leo cross with Doc O'Lena blood, the same collateral linebreeding found in elite cutting producers. Bred and owned by Kobie Wood (NCHA Elite $5 Million Rider, trainer/rider) and Paula Wood (registered owner/breeder, NCHA Elite $2 Million Rider, non-pro competitor). NCHA Hall of Fame inductee. Stud fee $3,000. Valley Equine, Stephenville TX. LTE $435,069. 2018 NCHA Open Horse of the Year. NCHA Hall of Fame. Confirmed show record: 2018 NCHA Super Stakes Open Champion (scored 227 with Kobie Wood, $69,076 -- QHN: 'they set the arena abuzz when they marked a 227 for the title'); 2018 NCHA Open Horse of the Year; 2018 NCHA Super Stakes Non-Pro finals with Paula Wood (tied 12th, $13,337 earned); 2018 Brazos Bash Open Derby Co-Champion. The Super Stakes Open Championship win was historic within the Hottish sire record -- it made Hottish the sire of the winners of two consecutive NCHA Triple Crown events: Dual Reyish won the 2017 NCHA Futurity and Cool N Hot won the 2018 Super Stakes. Kobie Wood had been in the winner's circle many times as an Elite $5 Million Rider, but this was his first NCHA Super Stakes Open Championship. PE $526,820 (Valley Equine 2026 -- early stage sire with first foals just now showing). Valley Equine 2026: 'Cool N Hot is proving to be the kind of sire breeders can build around. His offspring are showing up as earners in both cutting and cow horse in multiple divisions, fitting a variety of programs. That comes as no surprise given his foundation. He is out of Donas Cool Cat, a QData and NCHA Top 15 All-Time Leading Dam of cutting money-earners, and that production strength is carrying forward.' Gold Buckle Futurities: 'Cool N Hot, a NCHA Horse of the Year and Hall of Fame inductee, earned over $435,000 in the show pen. Now standing at Valley Equine Reproduction, his offspring are proving just as competitive in the show pen.' The convergence of Hottish (elite athleticism and trainability sire) over a High Brow Cat daughter from one of the industry's top producing families creates a cross with generational production depth on both sides -- Hottish's dam Stylish Play Lena is QData #4 All-Time Leading Cutting Dam, and Donas Cool Cat is QData/NCHA Top 15 All-Time Leading Dam -- giving Cool N Hot perhaps the strongest dam-line pedigree of any active Valley Equine stallion.

name: Spots Hot
_performance_summary: Spots Hot -- 2001 Sorrel Stallion. By Chula Dual (Dual Pep x Smart Fancy Lena/Smart Little Lena -- LTE $171,134; 1998 NCHA Futurity 4th (tie) 3YO Open; 1999 Polo Ranch Classic 4YO Open Champion; 1999 Royal Santana Futurity 4YO Open Co-Champion; 1999 El Cid Futurity 4YO Open Reserve Champion; sire of offspring $2M+, Spots Hot his leading money-winner; by Dual Pep -- PE $26M+, three-quarter brother to Peptoboonsmal, both foundational sires of the modern cutting horse) out of Sweet Shorty Lena (Shorty Lena x -- LTE $114,276; 2000 Steamboat Springs Derby 4YO NP Reserve Champion; 2002 Wyoming Futurity 5/6YO NP Reserve Champion; dam of 11 money-earners, produce $1.1M+ including Spots Hot, Innovation Time $195,686, His Reyflection $134,652; Shorty Lena is a son of Doc O'Lena and sire of mares that have produced $13M+ including NCHA Futurity Open Champions Spots Hot, Oh Cay Felix, One Time Royalty, and Oh Miss Caroline -- all four sired by stallions out of Smart Little Lena mares, confirming a powerful linebreeding pattern to Doc O'Lena). NCHA Hall of Fame 2009. Owned by Bobby Patton, Rocking P Ranch, Weatherford TX -- same ownership as Metallic Cat. Laid to rest 2022. ICSI only. Ranks top 20 of EquiStat's All-Time Cutting Horses. Valley Equine, Stephenville TX. LTE $527,682. 2004 NCHA Open Futurity Champion. 7 Major Event Championships. NCHA: 'With his superior athleticism, he could toy with and trap a cow like no other, making him a force to be reckoned with in the show pen.' Full confirmed show record: 2004 NCHA Open Futurity 3YO Open Champion; 2004 NCHA Non-Pro Futurity 4th; 2005 South Point Futurity 4YO Open Champion; 2005 Memphis Futurity 4YO Open Champion; 2005 Great American Competition 4YO Open Champion; 2005 Augusta Futurity 4YO NP Reserve Champion; 2005 NCHA Summer Spectacular 3rd 4YO Open; 2005 PCCHA Futurity 4YO Open finalist; 2005 Abilene Spectacular 4YO NP finalist; 2005 NCHA Super Stakes 4YO Open semifinalist; 2006 NCHA Summer Spectacular 5/6YO NP Champion; 2007 Memphis Futurity 5/6YO NP Champion; 2007 NCHA Super Stakes 5/6YO NP Reserve Champion; 2007 NCHA Summer Spectacular 3rd 5/6YO NP; 2007 Brazos Bash 5/6YO NP finalist. The pedigree carries a significant linebreeding to Doc O'Lena through both Chula Dual (Smart Little Lena on dam side) and Sweet Shorty Lena (Shorty Lena, direct Doc O'Lena son). QHN In The Blood on Dual Reyish: 'This cross returns the blood of Doc O'Lena through the foal's dam and the sire's dam -- that increases the influence of the sire's dam on the foal.' PE $9,419,211 (Valley Equine 2026 -- most current). As sire: became an NCHA Futurity Open winning sire in 2016 when Second Spot won the title, giving him NCHA Futurity wins as both a performer and a sire. NCHA announcement at time of death: 'With just shy of seven million, eight hundred thousand dollars in progeny earnings, he sired household names such as Second Spot, Hottish, and Cinca Im Hot.' PE has grown posthumously to $9.4M+ as of 2025. Top confirmed offspring: Hottish ($301,843, 2012 NCHA Reserve Horse of the Year, PE $23.8M+, 2025 QData #3 Leading Sire -- Spots Hot's greatest legacy); Second Spot ($449,607, 2016 NCHA Open Futurity Champion); Cinca Im Hot ($265,969); Tattoos On This Town ($194,130, 2013 Breeders Invitational 4YO NP Reserve Champion); Innovation Time ($195,686); Harley ($205,168, 2014 AQHA Amateur Cutting World Champion, 2010 NCHA Summer Spectacular 4YO NP Champion, 2010 Breeders Invitational 4YO NP Champion); Some Like It Hott ($183,223, 2010 NCHA Futurity Open Reserve Champion); High Classed Hottie ($158,412); His Reyflection ($134,652). Spots Hot's legacy lives most powerfully through Hottish, whose 26 offspring earnings of $100K+ and PE $23.8M+ are a direct extension of the athleticism, cow sense, and trainability that Spots Hot established as a performer and passed on as a sire.

name: Reyzin The Cash
_performance_summary: Reyzin The Cash -- 2011 Sorrel Stallion. AQHA/APHA. By Dual Rey (QData and NCHA #3 All-Time Leading Cutting Sire, AQHA Hall of Fame, PE $57.9M+, 1,642 money-earners at $51M+ per reyzinthecash.com pedigree page -- full profile bvss001) out of Spookys Cash (Miss N Cash -- LTE $284,410; 4th NCHA Open Futurity; NCHA Super Stakes Non-Pro Reserve Champion; Suncoast Fall 5/6YO Open Classic Reserve Champion; PCCHA Winter Roundup Open Derby Champion; split 3rd PCCHA 4-Year-Old Open and Non-Pro Stakes; 17+ money-earners earning $807,175-$910,465+; top produce beyond Reyzin The Cash: Spooky Smooth $100,100, Spookys Catchin Reys $92,759 Calgary Stampede W-Series Open Reserve Champion, Mean Bean $84,600 Cattlemens Non-Pro Classic Champion, Catamini $84,262 Utah CHA Open Futurity Champion). San Starlight (Spookys Cash's dam by Grays Starlight): NCHA Super Stakes finalist; dam of $1.5M+ in produce including Spookys Smarty Pants $258,027 NCHA Futurity Open Reserve Champion. NRCHA Million Dollar Sire. Owned by Iron Rose Ranch. Previously at Brazos Valley Stallion Station / Valley Equine, Stephenville TX. Moved to 6666 Ranch, Guthrie TX for 2026 breeding season -- confirmed 6666 Ranch announcement September 8, 2025. 6666 Ranch, Guthrie TX. LTE $287,381. 2015 NCHA Open Derby Champion. 2016 NCHA Open Classic/Challenge Champion. QStallions confirms these as his two premier title wins. QHN (In The Blood on Catolena Cashin In) confirms Reyzin The Cash 'earned $287,381 in his career.' Reyzin The Cash carries a documented 2x3 linebreeding to Dual Pep -- his sire Dual Rey is by Dual Pep, and Spookys Cash has Dual Pep influence through the dam line -- a pattern QHN confirms is shared with NCHA Futurity winners Dual Reyish (4x3), Crey Zee (2x3), CR Gotcha Covered (3x4), Chexy Louella (3x3), and Countin Hot Checks (4x4x4). PE $11M+ (confirmed 6666 Ranch September 2025 announcement). NRCHA Million Dollar Sire. 6666 Ranch: 'His offspring have earned more than $11 million, excelling across cutting, reined cow horse, roping, ranch versatility, and even barrel racing competitions.' Valley Equine Super Stallion Incentive: foals eligible through 2026 NCHA Summer Spectacular. Top confirmed offspring from Valley Equine black type PDF: Catolena Cashin In (x Dual Catolena/High Brow Cat, LTE $436,150, NCHA Super Stakes Open Derby Champion, The Ike Open Derby Champion, West Texas Open Derby Champion, Brazos Bash Open Classic Champion, NCHA Hall of Fame, 2x Reyzin The Cash Incentive Champion, standing Valley Equine 2026 at $4,500 stud fee); Reyzin The Limit (x Metallistic/Metallic Cat, LTE $400,109, split 5th 2024 NCHA Open Futurity, 2025 NCHA Super Stakes Open Derby Reserve Champion, 2025 Cattlemens Derby Reserve Champion); Reyckoning (x That Catomine/High Brow Cat, LTE $268,322, NCHA Super Stakes Open Classic Reserve Champion twice, Brazos Bash Open Derby Champion, Breeders Invitational $10,000 Non-Pro Derby Champion); Reyzin Jewels (x My Jewels Missin/Lenas Jewel Bars, LTE $237,436, 4th 2024 NCHA Super Stakes Open Derby, 2025 Augusta Open Classic Champion); Reydneck Woman (x Xquizit Cat/High Brow Cat, LTE $144,446, 3rd NCHA Super Stakes Non-Pro Derby); Cricket Reyzin Cash (listed in top offspring black type). 6666 Ranch: 'Among them is his standout son Reyzin The Limit, who has carried forward his sire's legacy in the show pen.' The move to 6666 Ranch marks a major step for the stallion's breeding program, joining one of the most prestigious establishments in the cutting horse world.

name: Dont Stopp Believin
_performance_summary: Dont Stopp Believin 'Grundy' -- 2011 Sorrel Stallion. By Dual Rey (QData and NCHA #3 All-Time Leading Cutting Sire, AQHA Hall of Fame, PE $57.9M+ -- full profile bvss001) out of Dont Look Twice (High Brow Cat x Tapt Twice/Dual Pep -- LTE $843,096; 2011 NCHA Open Horse of the Year; 2012 NCHA Open World Champion and World Champion Mare; NCHA Hall of Fame; NCHA Super Stakes Open Classic Co-Champion; NCHA Open Derby Reserve Champion; AQHA World Champion Senior Cutting Horse; AQHA Junior World Champion; NCHA Open Finals Champion; 51 AQHA points; Superior Cutting designation; cutting's all-time leading mare -- QHN 2023: 'Few horses in any discipline ever reached the heights that Dont Look Twice did in the competition arena. The winningest cutting mare in history'; millionaire dam status confirmed QHN 2023 when produce reached $1,032,218; 9+ money-earners averaging $86,018 each including Dont Stopp Believin $463,962, Dont Look For Troubl $108,287, Dontt Happen Twice $91,055). Tapt Twice (Dont Look Twice's dam by Dual Pep): LTE $285,226 -- NCHA Super Stakes Non-Pro Classic Reserve Champion; Breeders Invitational Open Derby Reserve Champion; PCCHA Non-Pro Classic/Challenge Champion; dam of 29 performers earning $1,716,306. Tap O Lena (Tapt Twice's dam): LTE $450,639 -- won 15 major events with Phil Rapp; 1997 NCHA Non-Pro World Finals Champion for Mary Ann Rapp. Bred and owned by Phil and Mary Ann Rapp, Rapp Ranch, Weatherford TX -- three generations of the Rapp family riding this horse: Phil Rapp (EquiStat $10M+ rider) in Open, Mary Ann Rapp in Non-Pro, and their son Ryan Rapp in Youth. Phil Rapp bred and rode Dont Look Twice for 26 major event wins and has continued that family cutting legacy with Dont Stopp Believin. NCHA Hall of Fame. 2025 QData Top 10 Leading Cutting Sire. Stud fee $3,500 plus chute fee (2025 confirmed). Valley Equine, Stephenville TX. LTE $463,962. Confirmed show record: 2015 NCHA Super Stakes Open Derby Co-Champion (confirmed YouTube); 2017 Houston Livestock Show and Rodeo NCHA Mercuria Open Champion (confirmed YouTube); 2018 AQHA Senior Cutting Reserve Champion (confirmed QHN); multiple additional NCHA Open and Non-Pro Champion and Reserve Champion titles throughout career. Valley Equine 2026 confirms 'multiple NCHA Open and Non-Pro Champions, Reserve Champions.' PE $5,941,502 (Valley Equine 2026). 2025 QData Top 12 Leading Cutting Sire -- Valley Equine 2026 lineup. Valley Equine: 'His blacktype includes multiple NCHA Open and Non-Pro Champions, Reserve Champions, and three NCHA Non-Pro Horses of the Year.' Top confirmed offspring: Red Lights (x Bet On Red/Bet Hesa Cat, 2025 NCHA Non-Pro Horse of the Year, 2025 NCHA Super Stakes Non-Pro Derby Champion, Southern Cutting Futurity 4YO Non-Pro Champion -- ridden by Ryan Rapp for Philip and Mary Ann Rapp, confirming the third generation of Rapp family riding champions from this bloodline); Dragon It (2026 NCHA Super Stakes Non-Pro Champion, scored 219 with Emma Grace Rapp for Philip and Mary Ann Rapp, $48,883 -- confirmed Valley Equine April 2026, the fourth member of the Rapp family now competing on Dont Stopp Believin offspring); Tippicanoe (2026 NCHA Super Stakes Amateur Champion, scored 219 with Joe Thomas Pounds for Kory and Jessica Pounds, $4,954 -- confirmed Valley Equine April 2026); Dont Stop Swingin (2024 NCHA Summer Spectacular Open Derby Reserve Champion, scored 229 with Ryan Rapp -- confirmed BVSS arrival announcement). The Rapp family's ownership and active competition on Dont Stopp Believin's offspring at the highest levels of cutting -- from the 2025 Non-Pro HoY to 2026 Super Stakes wins -- reflects an unbroken chain of family commitment to this horse and his bloodline.

name: NRR Cat King Cole
_performance_summary: NRR Cat King Cole 'Cole' -- 2007 Bay Stallion. By High Brow Cat (QData/NCHA #2 All-Time Leading Cutting Sire, PE $97M+, AQHA Hall of Fame 2023 -- full profile bvss002) out of Uno Del Rey (Smart Little Uno/Smart Little Lena lineage -- bred at North Ridge Ranch, Pierre SD; dam produce $730,000+ confirmed Beechfork Ranch 2025; full brothers all High Brow Cat sons: Cats High Noon $146,240 multiple futurity champion, NRR Ollie Tom Cat $117,000 2016 Augusta Futurity Reserve Open Champion and multiple World Top Ten Open and Limited, NRR Al Cat Capone $110,000 multiple World Top Ten; The Cophagen Cat $48,844; Black Cadillac Cat $26,126). Smart Little Uno (Uno Del Rey's sire): son of Smart Little Lena, NCHA Triple Crown winner and #2 All-Time Leading Cutting Sire. 5-Panel N/N, HERDA N/N. Bred and owned by North Ridge Ranch (Greg and Cindy Ward), Pierre SD. Shown by Tracy Barton, NCHA Hall of Fame Rider. Retired to stud 2016 completely sound. NCHA Hall of Fame 2017. Stud fee $4,500. Valley Equine, Stephenville TX. Foals eligible starting at 2026 NRCHA Snaffle Bit Futurity. LTE $230,918 -- all earned in Open contests. First horse in history of NCHA to achieve all four simultaneously: Affiliate Open Champion, Area Open Champion, National Open Champion, AND World Open Champion -- confirmed multiple primary sources. 2011-2016 South Dakota Horse Association Open Champion. Confirmed full show record from Issuu black type and primary sources: 2011 Western States LAE 4YO Open finalist; 2011 State of Missouri Cutting Futurity 4YO Open finalist; 2012 Western States LAE 5/6YO Open Champion; 2012 CHAN Futurity 4th (tie) 5/6YO Open; 2012 Utah Futurity 5/6YO Open finalist; 2013 NCHA Western National Championships Open Champion (scored 225 with Tracy Barton in Reno Nevada, presented by 6666 Ranch); 2013 Western States LAE 5/6YO Open Champion; 2013 Iowa Breeders Futurity 5/6YO Open Champion; 2013 CHAN Futurity 5/6YO Open Co-Champion; 2013 Wyoming Futurity 4th 5/6YO Open; 2014 NCHA World Championship Finals Open money earner; 2014 NCHA Reserve World Champion Stallion (scored 232.5 Open run, Will Rogers Arena); 2016 NCHA World Champion Stallion; 2016 NCHA Reserve World Open Champion; 2016 NCHA Western Championships Open finalist. 21 Limited Age Event Open Championships across 10-state area (AZ, CO, ID, IA, MN, MT, NE, SD, UT, WY). Weatherford Equine: 'An extraordinary horse for his consistency, quick-footedness, range of movement, and great disposition.' His YouTube videos went viral with millions of views as testament to his unique showmanship and heart. PE $2,205,165 (Valley Equine 2026 -- most current confirmed). 2 of 24 finalists at 2021 NCHA Open Futurity. 2022 NCHA Australian Open Futurity Champion. 2022 Rope Horse Futurity Heading Champion. 2023 NCHA Amateur Futurity Reserve Champion. Top confirmed offspring: Cats Lightning Rey ($163,376 -- 2019 NCHA Western Championships NP Champion; 2019 NCHA Summer Spectacular 5/6YO NP Champion; 2018 Western States LAE 4YO Open Co-Champion; 2020 The Non-Pro 5/6YO NP Reserve Champion); NRR Coles Scootn Cat ($85,055 -- 2019 Augusta Futurity Int. Amateur Co-Reserve Champion; 2019 All American Congress Futurity 5/6YO UNL AM Reserve Champion). Valley Equine 2026 lineup: 'A true competitor, NRR Cat King Cole made his mark in the Open arena and now does the same in the breeding shed -- siring horses that compete and win at the highest levels, including Futurity finalists and international champions. His elite pedigree, balanced athleticism, and longstanding consistency make him an exceptional choice for breeders.' International influence confirmed through Australian futurity champions and Australian-based offspring including Lethal King Cole.

name: CR Gotcha Covered
_performance_summary: CR Gotcha Covered 'Gotcha' -- 2012 Sorrel Stallion.
