By Dualin Boon (Once In A Blu Boon -- LTE $115,153; 2005 Abilene Spectacular 4YO Open finalist; 2005 Music City Futurity 4YO Open finalist; 2006 Breeders Invitational 4th 5/6YO Open; 2006 Augusta Futurity 5/6YO Open finalist; 2007 Southern Cutting Futurity 5/6YO Open Reserve Champion; 2007 NCHA Super Stakes 4th 5/6YO Open; 2007 NCHA Summer Spectacular 5/6YO Open finalist; sire of offspring $800,000+) out of The Catattac (High Brow Cat x Sprats Dualin Jewel/Lenas Jewel Bars -- Sprats Dualin Jewel LTE $134,535: 2003 Heartland Futurity 4YO Open finalist and 50K Open Champion; 2003 Oklahoma Early Bird Futurity 4YO Open Reserve Champion; 2005 NCHA Super Stakes 5/6YO Open finalist; dam of offspring $350,000+, granddam of $470,000+; The Catattac's additional produce includes Jewel Bars Cat by High Brow Cat $218,275 [2011 NCHA Futurity 3YO Open Reserve Champion, 2012 Bonanza Cutting 4YO Open Gelding Champion and Open Reserve Champion], Rios Jewel $51,397 [2012 NCHA Futurity 3YO Limited Open Champion], Jeweled Cat $28,865, Wood You See by Woody Be Tuff $46,688 [2018 NCHA Futurity 3YO Int. NP Champion]). 5-Panel N/N. Owned by Joel Colgrove Sr., Boligee AL. Primary trainer and rider: Tarin Rice. Stud fee $4,500. Valley Equine, Stephenville TX. LTE $302,756. 2019 NCHA Open World Champion and 2019 NCHA Open World Champion Stallion. Full confirmed show record: 2015 NCHA Open Futurity 3YO top 12 finalist; 2016 NCHA Open Derby finalist, West Texas Open Derby 6th, Abilene Spectacular Open Derby split 8th, Cattlemens Open Derby split 7th, Brazos Bash Open Derby finalist; 2017 NCHA Super Stakes Open Classic top 12, PCCHA Summer Open Classic/Challenge Reserve Champion, The Ike Open Classic split 3rd, Bonanza Open Classic split 3rd, South Point Mane Event World Series Open Co-Reserve Champion; 2018 NCHA Super Stakes Open Classic split 6th, Brazos Bash Open Classic Reserve Champion, Cattlemens Open Classic 5th, Western States Fall Open Classic Champion, The Non-Pro Open Classic Reserve Champion, NCHA Open Classic/Challenge finalist, The Ike Open Classic split 6th, West Texas Open Classic 7th, Cotton Stakes Open Classic split 7th; 2019 NCHA Open World Champion; 2019 NCHA Open World Champion Stallion. Additional confirmed: Reserve Champion at Brazos Bash, Pacific Coast Derby, and The Non-Pro; NCHA World Series of Cutting finalist twice; finalist at Bonanza, The Ike, Cattlemens Derby, Abilene Spectacular, West Texas Futurity, and Cotton Stakes. Gold Buckle Futurities: 'Gotcha's strength, personality and cow sense set him apart, and are what we are now seeing through his offspring.' PE $2,224,713 (Valley Equine 2026 -- most current confirmed). 2023 NRCHA AND NCHA Freshman Leading Sire -- confirmed Stallion Register Directory and Gold Buckle Futurities. Top confirmed offspring: Gottii (2026 NCHA Super Stakes 5/6YO Open Classic Reserve Champion, scored 222 with Tarin Rice for owner Todd Carpenter, earned $67,121.97 -- Valley Equine April 2026); Gotcha To Sin (2026 NCHA Super Stakes Amateur Champion, scored 218 with Jack Bell for owner Darrell Parsons, earned $7,396.28 -- Valley Equine April 2026). Valley Equine 2026 lineup: 'A proven athlete and a proven sire, CR Gotcha Covered continues to influence the cutting and cow horse industry with offspring known for their expression, grit, and ability to stay correct while doing the job right -- inside and outside the show pen.' As 2023 NRCHA and NCHA dual Freshman Leading Sire, CR Gotcha Covered demonstrated immediate production value in his very first competitive foal crop, an achievement that placed him among the most impactful debut sires in recent industry history.

name: Badboonarising
_performance_summary: Badboonarising 'BBR' -- 2015 Black Stallion, 15H, 1,024 lbs. AQHA/APHA. By Once In A Blu Boon (Peptoboonsmal x Autumn Boon/Dual Pep -- LTE $316,564; bred by legendary horseman Bill Freeman who passed just months after the horse's birth, never seeing him show; shown by James Payne; 14 major limited age event championship titles, 2 reserve titles, 29 trips to finals; confirmed titles: 2012 Arbuckle Futurity 4YO Open Champion, 2012 The Non-Pro 4YO Open Champion, 2012 West Texas Futurity 4YO Open Reserve Champion, 2013 Cattlemens Derby 5/6YO Open Champion, 2013 Arbuckle Futurity 5/6YO Open Champion, 2014 NCHA Summer Spectacular 5/6YO Open Champion, 2014 West Texas Futurity 5/6YO Open Champion, 2014 Cattlemens Derby 5/6YO Open Champion, 2014 The Non-Pro 5/6YO Open Champion; PE $12M+, 2025 QHN Stallion Register Cover Stallion; confirmed top offspring: All Spice $556,049 [2021 NCHA Open Horse of the Year], Baylenciaga $307,683 [NCHA Futurity Open finalist], Twice In Santiago $276,587 [2020 NCHA Open Horse of the Year], Here Comes The Boon $250,069 [2019 NRCHA Snaffle Bit Futurity Open and Intermediate Open Champion], Badboonarising $367,101 [2018 NCHA Futurity Open Reserve Champion]) out of Show Biz Kitty (High Brow Cat x Show Biz Sandy/Son Ofa Doc -- confirmed QData and NCHA #1 All-Time Leading Dam; suffered serious hock injury in 2005 before planned 2006 NCHA Futurity, never shown; produce includes Kittennish $729,112 NCHA Horse of the Year by Hottish, Rollz Royce by Dual Smart Rey, Badboonarising, Storyteller $381,604 by Smooth Talkin Style; dam also of SS Blacks Lil Kitty $187,137). Autumn Boon (Once In A Blu Boon's dam, by Dual Pep): daughter of Royal Blue Boon -- confirmed all-time leading dam in cutting AND leading EquiStat Western performance horse dam; Autumn Boon's produce includes Im Countin Checks $514,757, Once In A Blu Boon $316,564, A Tale Of The Cat $123,818. Royal Blue Boon is one of the most influential dams in cutting horse history. 6-Panel N/N confirmed. Bred by Plantation Farms LLC. Owned by Plantation Farms LLC. Shown by Adan Banuelos. Full book for 2026 breeding season. Jill Freeman: 'He was blessed with a great breeder, which was my husband, Bill Freeman. He was blessed with a royal pedigree and he was blessed with a great trainer, James Payne.' Valley Equine, Stephenville TX. LTE $367,101. 2018 NCHA Open Futurity 3YO Reserve Champion. Confirmed show record: 2018 NCHA Open Futurity Reserve Champion; 2019 Idaho CHA 4YO Open Champion; 2019 West Texas Futurity 4YO Open Champion; 2020 West Texas Futurity Open Classic Champion; 2020 NCHA Summer Spectacular Open Classic 5th. In-foal partners and Gold Buckle on BBR: 'This young stallion exudes sheer athleticism, natural intent on a cow and the force to run and stop. His humility and desire to please put him in a league of his own.' PE $3,811,012 (Valley Equine 2026 -- most current). 2024 NCHA Freshman Sire of the Year -- confirmed Gold Buckle Futurities. 2025 QData #7 Leading Cutting Sire -- with only two foal crops performing, confirmed Valley Equine page and Gold Buckle Futurities. Full book for 2026. Top confirmed offspring: Wood She B Arising (2025 NCHA Open Futurity Co-Reserve Champion -- confirmed Valley Equine 2026 lineup); Conundrum Rising (2025 APHA World Champion Junior Cutting Horse -- confirmed Valley Equine 2026 lineup). Stallion Register: 'BadBoonaRising's 2nd foal crop are living up to their expectations; to say they are carrying on BBR's best traits would be an understatement.' The pedigree convergence of Once In A Blu Boon -- whose dam Autumn Boon descends from the all-time leading cutting dam Royal Blue Boon -- crossed on Show Biz Kitty, the #1 All-Time Leading Dam, represents one of the most elite double-dam-side crosses in modern cutting horse breeding history. Both maternal lines are confirmed as the greatest producers the industry has ever recorded.

name: Hottish Metal
_performance_summary: Hottish Metal 'Mike' -- 2018 Sorrel Stallion. By Hottish (Spots Hot x Stylish Play Lena/Docs Stylish Oak -- PE $23.8M+, 2025 QData #3 and 2024 NCHA #4 Leading Sire, NCHA Top 12 All-Time Leading Cutting Sire, Equi-Stat Leading Cutting Junior Sire when first foals showed, died February 2020 -- full profile bvss005) out of Show Me The Rey (Metallic Cat x Nurse Moss/Dual Pep -- NCHA money-earner confirmed 7ranch.com; dam of Hottish Metal; Nurse Moss [Show Me The Rey's dam by Dual Pep] LTE $20,954: South Point Winter Limited Open Derby Reserve Champion, Rocky Mountain Non-Pro Derby Reserve Champion; Jay Moss [Nurse Moss granddam]: dam of 16 money-earners $681,028+ including High Brows Nurse $138,460 [NCHA Non-Pro Futurity Reserve Champion, NCHA Open Super Stakes Reserve Champion], Rey Dual $123,449, Dual Rey $105,038 [QData/NCHA #3 All-Time Leading Sire]). Valley Equine 2026 lineup describes Hottish as 'NCHA Reserve Horse of the Year Hottish Metal' confirming that distinction. NCHA Hall of Fame 2023. Owned by Jim Good. Open rider: Adan Banuelos. Non-Pro rider: Ali Good (Jim's daughter) -- QHN: 'I've been the only one to ride him since he was 2 years-old, as far as getting him ready for whoever to work. I've done that my whole life with every one of my horses.' Retired 2024 completely sound. ICSI Only. Stud fee $5,500. Valley Equine, Stephenville TX. LTE $497,370 (Valley Equine 2026 -- most current confirmed). Became the highest-earning son of Hottish, surpassing Dual Reyish's previously held record. QHN retirement article (April 2024): Ali Good marked 225 at 2024 NCHA Super Stakes Non-Pro Classic finals, earning $20,417 and pushing LTE to $472,809 at that moment -- surpassing Dual Reyish by almost $20,000. Continued earning to reach $497,370 per Valley Equine 2026 listing. QHN: 'Their most recent goal has been to make Hottish Metal the highest earning son of the late $16 Million Sire Hottish. Dual Reyish has held that title for the seven years since Hottish's first foal crop. Now, after marking a 225 score in the finals and taking home a check for $20,417, Hottish Metal's total lifetime earnings came to $472,809. That is almost $20,000 over Dual Reyish's show record.' NCHA Reserve Horse of the Year. Stallion Register: 'His power, quickness and sensitivity to a cow set him apart.' Full confirmed show record: 2021 NCHA Open Futurity 3rd; 2022 Breeders Invitational Open Derby Champion; 2022 The Ike Open Derby Champion; 2022 NCHA Super Stakes Open Derby 3rd; 2022 PCCHA Open Derby 3rd; 2022 ICHA Open Derby Reserve Champion; Cattlemens Derby Open finalist; West Texas Derby Open finalist; Brazos Bash Open Derby Reserve Champion; Cotton Stakes Open Champion; Idaho Futurity Open Champion; 2024 NCHA Super Stakes Classic Non-Pro Champion (scored 225 with Ali Good, $20,417 -- retirement run). QHN: 'We weren't going to push him to do something that he wasn't capable or healthy enough for. And we weren't going to keep showing him until she's seven or eight years old to get that, it just worked out well enough that we were able to get it early on.' No confirmed PE yet -- first foals not yet of showing age as of 2026. Hottish Metal stands as one of the most decorated sons of the late Hottish and one of the most accomplished Hottish x Metallic Cat cross performers in the modern NCHA era, a pedigree combination that concentrates Spots Hot athleticism with Metallic Cat cow sense and intelligence.

name: Areybe
_performance_summary: Areybe — 2020 Red Roan. By Stevie Rey Von (#1 QData Leading Sire 2025, 2015 NCHA Futurity Champion, NCHA Hall of Fame, PE $20M+, NRCHA $3M+ sire, full book with waiting list into 2027 — his offspring consistently described as "incredibly gentle and effortless to handle," "requires minimal riding and training," "so accurate and never takes a foot out of place," "incredibly smart"; Beau Galyean on Stevie: "The reason there's such a demand for the horse is that he's trainable and people like them") out of Stylish Play Lena (Docs Stylish Oak x Play Lena/Freckles Playboy) — QData #4 All-Time Leading Cutting Dam and EquiStat Elite $2 Million Dam. Stylish Play Lena earned $289,624 in her own career: 2001 South Point Futurity 4-Year-Old Open Reserve Champion, 2003 NCHA Summer Spectacular 5&6YO Open Champion, 2003 Abilene Spectacular 5&6YO Open Champion. Her influence on the cutting horse industry is so significant that a life-sized bronze sculpture of Stylish Play Lena stands at the National Cowgirl Museum and Hall of Fame in Fort Worth — an honor shared by only the most exceptional mares in western performance history. Her produce record defines elite production: Hottish (Spots Hot, LTE $301,843, 2012 NCHA Open Derby Champion, 2012 NCHA Reserve HoY, PE $23.8M+, 2025 QData #4 Leading Cutting Sire — ICSI only as deceased 2020; NRCHA Million Dollar Sire), Smooth Talkin Style (Smooth As A Cat, LTE $305,284, 2015 NCHA Open Horse of the Year, PE $2.68M; $96,698 earnings average per offspring — the highest per-offspring average of any dam at the time of reporting), Pepto Boom (Peptoboonsmal, $316,324 — multiple aged event champion), Copperish (Metallic Cat, $281,552 — multiple aged event champion), Halreycious (Dual Rey, $271K — sire of earners), and Areybe himself ($160K). The dam's grandget exceed $9M. LTE $160,250. Made the 2023 NCHA Futurity Open Finals alongside Cat — both are Stylish Play Lena offspring confirmed in the same Finals field by Quarter Horse News. Valley Equine describes Areybe as offering breeders "a consistent Open-level performance record and one of the strongest female families in the cutting industry" and notes his "presence and athleticism that make you take notice" (Jeremy Barwick, Valley Equine owner). The cross of Stevie Rey Von on a Stylish Play Lena daughter is one of the most powerful combinations available in modern cutting — the #1 current sire on the #4 All-Time Leading Dam. Stylish Play Lena daughters are specifically mentioned by Stevie Rey Von management as among the most sought-after crosses for their stallion. First foal crops not yet of showing age as of 2025. NRCHA Cow Horse Incentive and Chrome Cash enrolled. Stud fee $3,500. Owned by Linda Holmes. Standing at Valley Equine, Stephenville TX.

name: Armour
_performance_summary: Armour — 2021 Red Roan. By Metallic Rebel (Metallic Cat x Sweet Abra/Abrakadabracre — LTE $428,271+, 2017 NCHA Horse of the Year, NCHA Hall of Fame, NCHA World Champion Stallion, PE $16.6M+, QData #2 Leading Reined Cow Horse Sire 2025, NRCHA Million Dollar Sire 2024; management and handlers describe him as "such an athlete, amazing mind and is so cowy") out of Coureygous (Dual Rey x Highbrow Supercat/High Brow Cat). Metallic Rebel's sire Metallic Cat carries High Brow Cat athleticism and Peptoboonsmal mental toughness — the combination that defined the modern era of western performance horses. Metallic Rebel himself first competed in NRCHA Snaffle Bit Futurity with offspring in 2022, and by 2023 had 6 making the Open finals — an exceptional debut for the discipline. Coureygous: LTE $250,000+, NCHA Non-Pro Horse of the Year, Co-Champion NCHA Non-Pro Futurity 2019 (shown by Kristen Galyean in her own right as a top-20 NCHA Non-Pro Hall of Fame earner at $840,721), Bonanza Non-Pro Derby Champion. Coureygous is a full sibling to Lil Rattler (dam of Third Edge — multi-NCHA Triple Crown winner and $169K+ earner now owned by Teton Ridge, purchased at major sale — and Nineteen 42), Button Down Supercat ($289,596 by Dual Rey), and Cina De Maya (dam of Metallic Curveball). This Galyean-bred female family is one of the most successful in the cutting industry. Coureygous's dam Highbrow Supercat is by High Brow Cat out of Holly Dolly Too (Colonel Freckles): LTE $364,690, 2005 NCHA Futurity Open Champion (one of only 8 in event history), dam of producers earning $1.4M+. Armour thus has Metallic Cat through his sire, High Brow Cat through his dam's sire (Dual Rey) and through his granddam Highbrow Supercat — three separate layers of elite performance genetics. LTE $379,775. Still competing in 2026. Bred and owned by the Galyean family — Wesley Galyean (2023 NCHA Futurity Champion) and Kristen Galyean trained and showed both Armour and his dam Coureygous for owner Joel Colgrove Sr. Full confirmed show record: Breeders Invitational Open Derby Champion, Split 5th NCHA Open Futurity, 3rd NCHA Non-Pro Derby, 8th American Performance Horseman Cutting Classic, Top 10 Brazos Bash Open Derby. Valley Equine: "His pedigree ties directly to stallions that have shaped this program, and his performance record speaks for itself." First breeding season at Valley Equine 2026 — no offspring of showing age. NRCHA Cow Horse Incentive and Chrome Cash enrolled. Stud fee $4,000. Standing at Valley Equine, Stephenville TX.

name: Bama Jelly
_performance_summary: Bama Jelly — 2015 Bay. By Bamacat (High Brow Cat x MH San Tules Dually/San Tule Freckles — LTE $352,857, NCHA World Champion Stallion, 7-Panel Negative, PE $2.5M, standing at 6666 Ranch — "consistently sires performers that excel in cutting and roping events" and "has proven to pass that cow sense and ability to his foals") out of Wood She Be Neat (Nitas Wood x unknown). Bamacat carries High Brow Cat on his top side and Freckles Playboy, Dual Pep, and Peppy San Badger on the dam side through MH San Tules Dually (LTE $331,846 — NCHA Silver Award, Millionheir Non-Pro Classic Champion, dam of 18 money-earners totaling $906,716). This gives Bamacat's offspring a combination of High Brow Cat speed and cow with Dual Pep athletic grit. Bama Fury, a full sibling to Bamacat out of a related dam, won the Royal Crown Roping Heading Futurity confirming the roping cross potential in this sire line. Nitas Wood (Wood She Be Neat's sire): 1995 Sorrel, Zack T Wood x Nitas Quixote (Doc Quixote) — EquiStat Elite $6 Million Sire described as the "ultimate outcross." His offspring include Woody Be Lucky ($705K NCHA HoF), Junie Wood ($541K NCHA HoY — dam of 2021 NCHA Futurity Champion Janie Wood by Stevie Rey Von, creating a powerful nick), Woodys Baby ($388K, NCHA Non-Pro World Champion), Woodys Bad Boy ($369K NCHA Non-Pro Futurity Champion), and Woody Be Tuff ($351K, PE $15.3M+). Wood She Be Neat herself earned $27,600 and was shown in Amateur and Non-Pro by Madalyn Colgrove. Her dam produce now exceeds $838,000 with two standouts: Bama Jelly ($441K) and Crimsonnette ($111K, NCHA Limited Open Futurity Champion, Augusta Non-Pro Classic winner). LTE $441,762. NCHA Hall of Fame (inducted 2023). 2021 NCHA World Champion Stallion. Scored 230 with Austin Shepard (NCHA Hall of Fame earner $8.37M) to win the Southern Futurity 5/6 Open Classic. Full show record: Augusta Open Futurity Champion (4YO), Arbuckle Mountain Open Futurity Champion (4YO), Southern Open Classic Champion (5/6YO, 228 score), BI Open Classic Challenge Champion (2021), 2021 and 2022 NCHA Open Finals Reserve Champion, 2021 NCHA Eastern Nationals Open Reserve Champion, Split 4th NCHA Open Super Stakes, 2018 Futurity finalist, 2019 Super Stakes Open finalist, 2021-22 NCHA Open Top 15. Described: "very smart about a cow, with amazing talent, athleticism, and genetics." First crop 4-year-olds 2025: RT Playin My Jam placed 2nd at the 2026 NCHA Super Stakes 4-Year-Old Open (221 score). Stud fee $3,500. Valley Equine, Stephenville TX.

name: Catolena Cashin In
_performance_summary: Catolena Cashin In "Axl" — 2017 Sorrel. By Reyzin The Cash (Dual Rey x Spookys Cash/Miss N Cash, LTE $278,381, NCHA Hall of Fame, 2015 NCHA Open Derby Champion, 2016 NCHA Open Classic/Challenge Champion, PE $11M+, QData & NCHA #3 All-Time Leading Sire, NRCHA Million Dollar Sire, 1,744 money-earners — "known for passing along his athleticism, trainability, and disposition" — "offspring claiming titles in multiple disciplines, proving this sire passes on his ability, cow sense, and strength"; now standing at 6666 Ranch 2026; Catalena Cashin In is his highest earner) out of Dual Catalena (High Brow Cat x DPS Lenas Lucinda/Dual Pep, LTE $37,917, NCHA Eastern Nationals Limited Rider Champion, 2022 QData & 2021 NCHA Top 12 Leading Dam of Cutting Money-Earners, dam produce $637,000+, full sister to Cats Dual Olena $97K). Third dam Lenas Lucinda (Doc O'Lena): LTE $161,760, 4th NCHA Open Futurity, dam of 15 money-earners earning $901,963 including SPL Altisimo ($192K — granddam of NCHA HoY LHR Smooth Jamie May $259K). LTE $436,150. NCHA Hall of Fame (inducted 2023). 2X Reyzin The Cash Incentive Champion. Trained and shown by Tarin Rice (EquiStat Elite $3M Rider). Owner/Breeder: Joel Colgrove Sr, Boligee, Alabama. Critical pedigree note: carries confirmed 2x3 linebreeding pattern to Dual Pep — same pattern behind NCHA champions Twice In Santiago (2020 HoY), Dual Reyish (2017 Futurity Champion), CR Gotcha Covered (2019 Open World Champion), and Countin Hot Checks. Show record: 2020 NCHA Open Futurity Finalist (scored 224 on opening day — high score that day); 2021 NCHA Super Stakes 4-Year-Old Open Champion (scored 230 — second highest score in Super Stakes history, behind only Sunettes Dually 231 in 2001); 2021 The Ike Open Derby Champion; 2021 West Texas Open Derby Champion; 2021 The Non-Pro Open Derby Champion; 2021 Arbuckle Mountain Open Derby Reserve Champion; 2021 Brazos Bash Open Derby 3rd; 2021 Abilene Spectacular Open Derby Finalist; 2022 Brazos Bash Open Classic Champion (retirement title); 2022 PCCHA 5/6 YO Open Reserve Champion; 2022 PCCHA Fall Open Classic/Challenge Reserve Champion; 2022 PCCHA Open Classic/Challenge Co-Reserve Champion. Retired after 2022 Brazos Bash Classic Championship. Described: "unparalleled strength, confidence and unique moves put him in a class of his own" and "unique way of moving, superior strength, and athleticism." Tarin Rice described first offspring as horses he was "more than excited to be riding." First foal crop born 2023 — 2-year-olds in 2025. No offspring championship results yet. Stud fee $4,500. Valley Equine, Stephenville TX.

name: Check Yer Metal
_performance_summary: Check Yer Metal "Mike" — 2017 Bay Roan, 14.1H, 1100 lbs. AQHA 5856261, APHA 1106789. By Metallic Cat (High Brow Cat x Chers Shadow/Peptoboonsmal — LTE $637,711, 2008 NCHA Open Futurity Champion, 2009 NCHA Horse of the Year, NCHA Hall of Fame, NRCHA Hall of Fame, PE $83M+, QData and NCHA #2 All-Time Leading Sire, QData and NRCHA #1 All-Time Leading Reined Cow Horse Sire; the most decorated cutting and cow horse sire in the history of the industry) out of Checkers Live Oak (Im Countin Checks x N Yer Wildest Dreams/Peptoboonsmal — LTE $186,541, EquiStat 2023 #17 Cutting Dam). Owned and shown by Stuart Bozeman of Stephenville, Texas. 6 Panel N/N. Still competing as of 2025. Checkers Live Oak, affectionately called "Elanor" by the Bozeman family, was a decorated Non-Pro competitor in her own right. Her full confirmed show record includes: 2016 NCHA Summer Spectacular 5/6YO Non-Pro Champion, 2016 West Texas Futurity 5/6YO Limited Non-Pro Champion, 2016 El Rancho Mercuria Non-Pro Champion, 2016 NCHA World Championship Finals Non-Pro money earner, 2016 Brazos Bash 5/6YO Non-Pro Reserve Champion, 2016 El Rancho 5/6YO Non-Pro Reserve Champion, 2016 NCHA Super Stakes 5/6YO Non-Pro Semifinalist, and 2014 El Rancho 4YO Non-Pro Reserve Champion. Her dam N Yer Wildest Dreams (Peptoboonsmal) produced five Im Countin Checks offspring alone totaling $873,000: Deluxe Checks ($287K), Checkers Live Oak ($186K), Cat Countin Checks ($169K), Chexy Louella ($118K — 2018 NCHA Non-Pro Futurity Champion), and Countess Catrina ($112K) — one of the most productive single-mare/stallion combinations documented. Checkers Live Oak's maternal grandsire Im Countin Checks (Smart Lil Ricochet x Autumn Boon/Dual Pep — LTE $514,757) finished 2nd in the 2008 NCHA Horse of the Year race, is the sire of the 2017 NCHA Open World Champion and 2019 NCHA Non-Pro Horse of the Year, ranked Top 15 NCHA Sire six consecutive years, and carries PE $7M+. Described as having "the perfect outcross pedigree — a perfect cross on all High Brow Cat, Smooth As A Cat, Peptoboonsmal, Smart Little Lena, and Playboy bloodlines." Im Countin Checks was bred and raised at Tommy Manion Ranch alongside his sire Smart Lil Ricochet (leading siring son of Smart Little Lena at his 2007 death — won the 1997 NCHA Futurity first go-round scoring 223 before career-ending injury; offspring PE $3.9M+) and his grandsire Smart Little Lena himself (LTE $743,275 in 8 shows, only NCHA Triple Crown Champion, #2 All-Time NCHA Sire with PE $39M+, sired 17 World Champions, NCHA and AQHA Hall of Fame). LTE $449,312. Full confirmed show record: 2020 NCHA Futurity 3YO Non-Pro Semifinalist; 2021 NCHA Super Stakes 4YO Intermediate Non-Pro Champion, Open Semifinalist, Non-Pro Finalist; 2021 Arbuckle Mountain 4YO Open Finalist, Ltd Non-Pro Champion, Non-Pro & 25K Non-Pro Reserve Champion; 2021 NCHA Summer Spectacular 4YO Non-Pro Finalist; 2021 Breeders Invitational 4YO Non-Pro Finalist; 2022 Brazos Bash 5/6YO Ltd Open Champion; 2022 Cattlemens 5/6YO Int Open Reserve Champion; 2022 NCHA Super Stakes 5/6YO Int Non-Pro 3rd (tie); 2023 NCHA Summer Spectacular 5/6YO Open Finalist, 4th Int Open, Non-Pro Finalist, 3rd Int Non-Pro; 2023 Arbuckle Mountain 5/6YO Int Open Reserve Champion; 2023 The Ike 5/6YO Non-Pro Reserve Champion; 2023 Idaho Cutting Classic 5/6YO Non-Pro Co-Champion; 2023 PCCHA Futurity 5/6YO Int Open Reserve Champion; 2024 Brazos Bash 7&Up Non-Pro Champion. EquiStat 2023 #15 Cutting Horse. #5 Leading Non-Pro Horse 2019–2024 — a five-year sustained ranking that reflects rare consistency. 45+ aged event finals with multiple championships across Open, Non-Pro, and Intermediate divisions. First foals 2-year-olds in 2025 — Valley Equine: "beginning to show their own competitiveness in futurity programs." Stud fee $3,750. Valley Equine, Stephenville TX.

name: Countin Hot Checks
_performance_summary: Countin Hot Checks -- 2016 Sorrel Stallion. By Hottish (Spots Hot x Stylish Play Lena/Docs Stylish Oak -- PE $23.8M+, died February 2020, 2025 QData #3 Leading Sire -- full profile bvss005) out of Cat Countin Checks (Im Countin Checks x A Cat Above/High Brow Cat -- LTE $169,104; 2014 NCHA Super Stakes Classic/Challenge Limited Non-Pro Co-Champion; shown by Jamie Hill/Jamie Goertz-Hill, Bastrop TX; producer of $359,000+ per Valley Equine 2026; Countin Hot Checks was her first money-earner per 2020 NCHA Brazos Bash article). Im Countin Checks (Cat Countin Checks' sire, by Smart Lil Ricochet x Autumn Boon/Dual Pep): LTE $514,757; NCHA Hall of Fame; Top 15 NCHA Sire 6 consecutive years; offspring earnings $5.6M+; 2005 NCHA Futurity Open 3rd; 2006 Breeders Invitational Derby Open Reserve Champion; 2008 NCHA Horse of the Year runner-up; sire of 2017 NCHA Open World Champion and 2019 NCHA Non-Pro Horse of the Year. Autumn Boon (Im Countin Checks' dam by Dual Pep): LTE $259,685; NCHA Super Stakes Champion; Augusta Futurity Champion; produce $1.9M+, grandget $13M+. QHN In The Blood on Catolena Cashin In confirms Countin Hot Checks carries a 4x4x4 linebreeding to Dual Pep -- through Hottish's sire side (Spots Hot by Chula Dual, a Dual Pep son) and through Cat Countin Checks' sire Im Countin Checks (out of Autumn Boon, a direct Dual Pep daughter), creating one of the densest Dual Pep pedigree concentrations among current young stallions. Bred and owned by Jamie Hill, Bastrop TX. Stud fee $6,500. Valley Equine, Stephenville TX. LTE $296,780 (Valley Equine 2026). Valley Equine 2026: 'Countin Hot Checks built his reputation through success at the highest levels of Open aged-event competition, culminating in a World Championship and a Classic/Challenge title.' Confirmed titles from Valley Equine stallion page: NCHA Open Classic/Challenge Champion; Bonanza Open Classic Champion; 2020 Brazos Bash Open Derby Co-Champion (tied 228 points with Dual Clay under Grant Setnicka, ridden by Jaime Snider -- confirmed SallyHarrison.com September 2020; Sanctus with Rodrigo Taboga placed 3rd at 225.5); Abilene Spectacular Open Classic Reserve Champion. Additional: West Texas Derby Open Intermediate Champion; Arbuckle Mountain Open Novice Champion. Stallion Register: 'With athleticism, cow, and heart, Countin Hot Checks is showing success in the major aged events and there is no doubt he will have a future as a successful sire.' Valley Equine 2026: 'Sired by Hottish and out of Cat Countin Checks, a proven earner and producer of over $359,000, he represents a cross of two strong cutting families.' First foals showing in 2025, earning in both cutting and cow horse. Top confirmed offspring at the 2026 NCHA Super Stakes (Valley Equine April 2026): SCR Ima Hottish Pep by Countin Hot Checks and Jasper Patrick topped the Non-Pro Derby field with a 222 for owner Lloyd Ested, earning $8,106.30; a separate 4-year-old by Countin Hot Checks won the 4-Year-Old Non-Pro Derby, described by Valley Equine as 'separated themselves with the highest score of the final and gave Countin Hot Checks a Super Stakes Derby champion.' Two champions in the same Super Stakes event from a first foal crop is a significant debut statement for the stallion's sire career. The Hottish x Im Countin Checks cross creates a complementary pairing of cow horse athleticism (Hottish line) with cutting-specific foot speed and trainability (Im Countin Checks line), both underpinned by the dense Dual Pep concentration that has consistently produced elite performers in the NCHA.

name: Dual Pep
_performance_summary: Dual Pep -- 1985 Chestnut Stallion, deceased 2018. ICSI only. 15H. 5-panel Negative (HYPP N/N, PSSM N/N, HERDA N/N, GBED N/N, MH N/N). Bred by Nic-A-Lode Farms, Boise ID. By Peppy San Badger (Mr San Peppy x Leo San/Peppy Belle -- legendary all-time leading cutting horse sire; sire of Dual Pep, Smart Little Lena, Colonel Freckles, and dozens of all-time leading earners and sires) out of Miss Dual Doc (Doc's Remedy x -- Doc's Remedy is a Doc Bar son; dam's cutting credentials established in NCHA). Owned by Hill Ranch. Valley Equine, Stephenville TX. Stud fee $2,500 ICSI only confirmed Valley Equine 2026 lineup and StallionCompare. 77% foundation bloodlines. Sire of Dual Rey (bvss001 in this database -- LTE $105,038, PE $57,893,606, QData and NCHA #3 All-Time Leading Cutting Sire, deceased 2018) making Dual Pep the only All-Time Top 5 Leading Sire with a son also on the All-Time Top 5 list confirmed NCHA obituary September 2018. LTE $313,192 confirmed Valley Equine 2026 (NCHA portion $302,053.60 confirmed NCHA obituary and StallionCompare). Confirmed show record: 1998 NCHA World Champion Cutting confirmed StallionCompare; 1989 Memphis Futurity Open Reserve Champion confirmed NCHA obituary ('Dual Pep claimed the open reserve championship of the 1989 Memphis Futurity'); NCHA Open Classic Champion confirmed StallionCompare. Shown by Pat Earnheart in open, Bobby Pidgeon in Non-Pro. By end of show career at age 6, NCHA earnings stood at $302,054 confirmed NCHA obituary. NCHA obit: 'Year after year, for more than two decades, Dual Pep offspring dominated the cutting charts, as do the offspring of his sons and daughters, today.' On September 23, 2018, days before his death, Dual Pep's daughter Tears From Heaven won the 2018 Brash Bash -- making Dual Pep the oldest living sire ever to have a major cutting futurity champion at time of death. PE $26,186,416 confirmed Valley Equine 2026. QData and NCHA #7 All-Time Leading Cutting Sire confirmed Valley Equine 2026. QData #6 All-Time Leading Cutting Maternal Grandsire -- daughters produced more than $44 Million in earnings and over 10,000 AQHA points confirmed Valley Equine 2026. Top offspring: Dual Rey Me LTE $812,942 -- 2-time NCHA Open World Champion (2006 and 2007) and 3-time NCHA Open Finals Champion (2006, 2007, 2009) confirmed Valley Equine 2026 and NCHA obituary; Dual Rey LTE $105,038 PE $57,893,606 QData #3 All-Time Leading Cutting Sire (bvss001 -- full profile); three NCHA Non-Pro Horses of the Year confirmed Valley Equine 2026. Incentives: Breeders Invitational and NCHA Super Stakes. Valley Equine Super Stallion Incentive not listed for Dual Pep foals in available sources.

name: Hott Abra
_performance_summary: Hott Abra -- 2021 Bay Stallion. By Hottish (Spots Hot x Stylish Play Lena/Docs Stylish Oak -- PE $23.8M+, died February 2020, 2025 QData #3 and 2024 NCHA #4 Leading Sire -- full profile bvss005) out of Metallilac (Metallic Cat x Sweet Abra/Abrakadabracre -- Metallilac LTE $14,577; producer of 5 money-earners confirmed Valley Equine announcement December 2025; a full sister to Metallic Rebel $438,315 NCHA Open Horse of the Year 2017, PE $16.6M+, bvss004 -- both by Metallic Cat out of Sweet Abra). Sweet Abra (Metallilac's dam by Abrakadabracre): LTE $120,151; NCHA Super Stakes Open Classic finalist; Battle In The Saddle World Series Open Champion; 3rd AQHA World Amateur Cutting; 2022 NCHA #2 All-Time Leading Dam; 24 money-earners producing $2,448,352+ including Metallic Rebel $438,315 NCHA HoY, Pipe Bombs Dream $289,461 [2022 Breeders Invitational Open Cutting Classic Champion, 3rd 2022 NCHA Open Classic/Challenge], Warlock $127,615, The Dewd $124,866 [Southern Open Derby Champion], Magistic Moon $187,799 [Arbuckle Mtn 4YO Open Futurity Co-Champion], Magic Metallic $164,052, Sweet Metallic $157,607, Metabra $123,630, Maggic Mike $109,029, Broken Haloes $94,856; Sweet Abra was NCHA's leading dam in 2016, 2017, and 2019. Abrakadabracre (Sweet Abra's sire): LTE $112,566; AQHA World Champion Junior Cutting Horse; NCHA Limited Open Futurity Champion; Equi-Stat Elite $1 Million Sire. Metallilac is also the dam of Laser (by Hottish, 2020 gelding LTE $58,359, in training with Kolby Moore) and Lets Rollz (by Rollz Royce, 2020 stallion) -- both Hottish and Rollz Royce sons, confirming this family's proven compatibility with premier cutting stallions. 7 Panel N/N. Owned by Wendell and Wes Reeder, War Ranch, Deport TX. Shown by Colt Moore, continuing to show through 2026. Stud fee $4,500. Joined Valley Equine for 2026 breeding season announced December 30, 2025. Valley Equine, Stephenville TX. LTE $84,347. 2025 Brazos Bash Open Derby Champion. 2025 Southern Cutting Open Derby Co-Champion. Non-Pro Cutting Novice Horse Derby Champion. 2nd The Outback Cutting Day One Open Derby. 4th Non-Pro Cutting Open Derby. Finalist in multiple premier events per Valley Equine 2026 lineup. Continuing to show through 2026 breeding season due to active show schedule. Foals first eligible starting at the 2026 NRCHA Snaffle Bit Futurity. Own incentive program: Hott Abra Incentive returns money to foals competing at the NCHA Futurity in Open, Non-Pro, and Amateur divisions. Also eligible for Valley Equine Super Stallion Incentive and NCHA Super Stakes. Andrew Waters, Stallion Manager, Valley Equine: 'Hott Abra checks the boxes. He has already proven himself in the Open, he comes from a deep and reliable female line, and he has the mind and consistency breeders should look for when planning for the future. We are extremely excited to welcome him to Valley Equine.' The combination of Hottish (Spots Hot / Doc O'Lena lineage) on the top and Metallic Cat / Sweet Abra depth on the bottom creates a cross of extraordinary genetic concentration. Metallilac is a full sister to Metallic Rebel, one of the top-producing sires in the industry -- breeders who cross Hott Abra on Metallic Cat or High Brow Cat mares are stacking proven elite cutting genetics from both sides of the cross.

name: Kinky Bootz
_performance_summary: Kinky Bootz -- 2016 Sorrel Stallion. By Dual Rey (QData and NCHA #3 All-Time Leading Cutting Sire, PE $57.9M+, AQHA Hall of Fame -- full profile bvss001) out of Sheza Stylish Cougar (High Brow Cat -- LTE $57,040; Kinky Bootz confirmed as her first money-earner per NCHA Southern Futurity announcement October 2020; by High Brow Cat, QData/NCHA #2 All-Time Leading Cutting Sire, PE $97M+ -- full profile bvss002). The cross of Dual Rey on a High Brow Cat mare is one of the most proven pedigree combinations in modern cutting: Dont Stopp Believin (Dual Rey x High Brow Cat mare, LTE $463,962, PE $5.9M+, NCHA Hall of Fame, 2025 QData Top 12 Leading Sire) and Reyzin The Cash (Dual Rey x Spookys Cash, PE $11M+) are notable recent examples of this cross. Bred and owned by Glenn and Debbie Drake, Weatherford TX. Shown by Austin Shepard, NCHA Hall of Fame earner of over $8.5 million -- one of the most decorated riders in cutting history with five Southern Futurity 4-Year-Old Open titles. Entered stud 2024; first foals are two-year-olds in 2026. Stud fee $2,500. Valley Equine, Stephenville TX. Semen availability: cooled/fresh (GREEN designation on Valley Equine Breeding Calendar). LTE $182,221. Compiled three major event championships in 2020 alone. Confirmed full show record: 2019 The Ike Open Derby Champion (scored 216 and 222 in go-rounds with Austin Shepard -- confirmed Austin Shepard Cutting Horses, described as 'back-to-back triumphs' by Shepard following Countess Catrina victory); 2020 Southern Futurity 4-Year-Old Open Champion (scored 225 with Austin Shepard, October 27, 2020, in Weatherford TX; NCHA reported 'this was Austin Shepard's fifth Southern Futurity 4-Year-Old championship win,' and described the win as 'the third major 2020 win for Kinky Bootz'; five of 19 finalists scored 220+ points, Hit Tha Flo marked 224 for reserve, and Jae Zee scored 223.5 for third; NCHA confirmed Kinky Bootz 'is the first money earner out of the High Brow Cat daughter Sheza Stylish Cougar LTE $57,040'); 2020 Arbuckle Mountain Open Classic split 2nd/3rd (scored 220.5 with Austin Shepard, tied with Bama Jelly also ridden by Shepard -- confirmed NCHA February 2021; KR Isadorable won the class with Lloyd Cox). At least two additional major wins in 2020 preceded the Southern Futurity title per NCHA description of 'third major 2020 win.' Valley Equine 2026: 'His own record was built in the aged events, showing consistency and competitiveness against strong fields, and he comes from a family known for producing cutting earners generation after generation. With cow on the top side and a proven female line underneath, Kinky Bootz offers a young sire option grounded in ability and backed by depth on paper.' No offspring yet showing -- first foals are two-year-olds in 2026, and the Valley Equine Super Stallion Incentive program is in place to support early believers. Eligible for Valley Equine Super Stallion Incentive, NCHA Super Stakes, Breeders Invitational, NRCHA Cow Horse Incentive, and PCCHA.

name: Lone Woolf
_performance_summary: Lone Woolf 'Ace' -- 2020 Red Roan Stallion. AQHA/APHA (solid Paint). By Metallic Rebel (Metallic Cat x Sweet Abra/Abrakadabracre -- LTE $438,315, NCHA Open Horse of the Year 2017, NCHA Hall of Fame, NCHA World Champion Stallion 13 championships, PE $16.6M+, NRCHA Million Dollar Sire -- full profile bvss004) out of A Little Reylena (Dual Rey x Katie Little Lena/Smart Little Lena -- LTE $126,058; EquiStat Elite $1 Million Dam; QData and NCHA Top 15 All-Time Leading Dam per Valley Equine 2026; dam of Dual Reyish $452,687 [2017 NCHA Open Futurity Champion, PE $2.5M+, NCHA Hall of Fame -- by Hottish, bvss005] AND Lone Woolf [2023 NCHA Open Futurity Champion] -- two separate NCHA Open Futurity Champions from the same dam in a six-year span, one of the most extraordinary produce records in cutting horse history; A Little Reylena's confirmed show record includes 2008 NCHA Summer Spectacular 5/6YO 50K NP Champion, 2008 Utah Futurity 5/6YO NP Co-Champion, 2009 NCHA Super Stakes 5/6YO NP Reserve Champion, 2009 The Mane Event 5/6YO NP Reserve Champion). Bred and owned by Billy Wolf, Whitesboro TX (Wolf Livestock). Shown by Wesley Galyean, EquiStat Elite $6.8M+ Rider, Claremore OK -- Galyean persuaded Wolf not to sell Lone Woolf as a yearling at the Western Bloodstock sale after seeing him work in a round pen: 'He was so fast so light footed, just insane talent and I immediately went and told Billy I said, Listen, this is the type of horse that you are going to turn around in a year or two and try to buy back for a couple of million dollars.' Wolf did not sell, and Galyean's assessment proved correct. NCHA Hall of Fame. Stud fee $5,000. Eligible: Valley Equine Super Stallion Incentive, Breeders Invitational, NRCHA Cow Horse Incentive, NCHA Super Stakes, PCCHA, Chrome Cash. Valley Equine, Stephenville TX. Semen availability: GREY designation on Valley Equine Breeding Calendar. LTE $668,310 (Valley Equine 2026 -- most current confirmed). Highest earning offspring of Metallic Rebel and highest earning offspring of A Little Reylena -- both confirmed Valley Equine 2026 lineup. 2023 NCHA Open Futurity Champion: scored 228.5 as the last horse to enter the pen at the Will Rogers Coliseum in Fort Worth TX on December 9, 2023, besting over 500 horses entered -- the largest NCHA Futurity ever hosted. Won $318,649.29 plus incentives including Chrome Cash ($6,534). This gave Wesley Galyean his second NCHA Open Futurity Championship -- his first was in 2004 aboard Spots Hot as the youngest rider ever to win the title. NCHA: 'God is Great,' Galyean proclaimed repeatedly when crowned champion. NCHA Reserve Horse of the Year -- confirmed Valley Equine 2026. NCHA Hall of Fame Inductee -- confirmed Valley Equine 2026. Placed 2nd in the 2024 NCHA Super Stallion Incentive at the NCHA Futurity (paid $6,896) -- confirmed Valley Equine Summer Spectacular article. As a 4-year-old in 2024 QHN reported: 'He is already grasped more champion and reserve champion titles and is now on his way to the NCHA Super Stakes Semi Finals.' Valley Equine 2026: 'Lone Woolf earned his place among the most accomplished horses of his generation through sustained success at the highest level of competition.' No offspring data yet -- first foals not yet of showing age.

name: Magicality
_performance_summary: Magicality -- 2010 Brown Stallion. AQHA #5353239. By Very Smart Remedy (Smart Little Lena x Remedy's Response/Doc's Remedy -- LTE $103,601; 2003 NRCHA Derby Champion; 2004 NRCHA Derby Champion [consecutive, back-to-back titles]; 2005 World's Greatest Horseman Champion -- confirmed NRCHA; NRCHA Million Dollar Sire; owned by Anne Reynolds, King Hill ID; by Smart Little Lena who is the NCHA Triple Crown winner and one of the most foundational sires in the entire cow horse and cutting horse industry) out of Magical Lena (Little Lenas Legend -- LTE $153,250; NRCHA Non-Pro Futurity Champion; NRCHA World's Greatest Horseman Reserve Champion with Anne Reynolds; River Front NRCHA Open Derby Co-Reserve Champion; River Front NRCHA Non-Pro Derby Champion and Co-Reserve Champion; NRCHA Stallion Stakes Non-Pro Champion; NRCHA Open Hackamore Classic Champion; 4th NRCHA Open Stallion Stakes; NRCHA Hall of Fame; QData and NRCHA #7 All-Time Leading Dam of RCH Money-Earners -- confirmed Valley Equine black type PDF; 20 AQHA foals age 3 and over, 16 money-earners producing $686,453+; key produce: Magicality, More Magic Please $107,305 [NRCHA Non-Pro Futurity Champion, 3rd NRCHA Non-Pro Derby, NRCHA Derby Non-Pro Bridle Spectacular Champion twice], Very Black Magic [$60,000+ including 3rd place NRCHA Open Futurity 2012 per NRCHA announcement], Smart Medicine Man [finalist 2012 NRCHA Open Futurity], Logicality $44,963, Physicality $37,233, Romantic Magic $17,986, Technicality $17,349, Musicality $15,675, Shiny Magic $13,252). Owned by Home Ranch. Shown by Gusti Buerger. Valley Equine, Stephenville TX. Foals eligible through 2026 NCHA Summer Spectacular per Valley Equine Super Stallion Incentive program. Eligible: Valley Equine Super Stallion Incentive, Breeders Invitational, NRCHA Cow Horse Incentive, NCHA Super Stakes, Royal Crown, National Reining Breeders Classic, NRBC, NRHA Sire and Dam. LTE $173,771 (Valley Equine black type PDF confirmed). Weatherford Equine: 'proudly owned by Home Ranch and shown by Gusti Buerger, with Lifetime earnings over $173,971.' Confirmed full show record: 2013 NRCHA Open Futurity 4th; 2013 NRCHA Intermediate Non-Pro Futurity Champion; 2013 NRCHA Non-Pro Futurity Co-Reserve Champion; NRHA Level 4 Non-Pro Futurity Co-Reserve Champion; NRHA Level 3 Non-Pro Futurity Champion. At 4: 3rd Idaho RCHA Open Derby; finalist NRCHA Open Stallion Stakes (Rein Work Champion); finalist NRBC Non-Pro Derby and Primetime Non-Pro Derby. At 5: Idaho RCHA Open Derby Reserve Champion; NSHA RCH Open Derby Champion; Cactus Reining Classic Non-Pro Derby Co-Reserve Champion; 5th NRCHA Int. Open Derby; Cactus Reining Classic Primetime Non-Pro Derby Champion; NSHA RCH Int. Open Derby Champion. At 6: 4th NRCHA Derby Bridle Spectacular Open; Idaho RCHA Futurity Open Bridle Champion; Low Roller Reining Classic Non-Pro Derby Reserve Champion; Idaho CHA Limited Non-Pro Classic Reserve Champion; Low Roller Reining Classic Derby Primetime Non-Pro Champion. Aged horse: 2021 NRCHA World's Greatest Horseman Preliminaries Fence and Rein Work Champion. AQHA 1.5 cutting Level 3 points. 2022 EquiStat 10-Year All-Industry Horse 1st Place -- confirmed Weatherford Equine. 2023 EquiStat 10-Year All-Industry Horse 2nd Place -- confirmed Weatherford Equine. Top 10 Reined Cow Horse Jr Sire. Top confirmed offspring: More Magic Please $107,305 [NRCHA Non-Pro Futurity Champion, 3rd NRCHA Non-Pro Derby, NRCHA Derby Non-Pro Bridle Spectacular Champion twice]; Logicality $44,963 [NRCHA Limited Open Derby Co-Reserve Champion, 3rd NRCHA World Non-Pro Two-Rein]; Physicality $37,233 [top 10 2025 NRCHA World's Greatest Horseman Open]; Romantic Magic $17,986 [top 10 NRCHA Int. Open Futurity, Idaho RCHA Open Derby Co-Champion]; Technicality $17,349 [split 6th 2024 Reno RCH Open Derby, 5th Idaho RCHA Open Derby]; Musicality $15,675 [finalist NRCHA Int. Open Futurity, Utah RCHA Open Futurity Champion]; Rising From The Ashes $11,385 [2024 Calgary Stampede RCH Open Hackamore Spectacular].

name: Meteles Cat
_performance_summary: Meteles Cat 'Alvin' -- 2010 Bay Roan Stallion. AQHA. 14 hands. By Metallic Cat (High Brow Cat x Chers Shadow/Peptoboonsmal -- LTE $637,711, NCHA Open Futurity Champion 2008, NCHA Horse of the Year 2009, QData/NCHA #2 All-Time Leading Cutting Sire, PE $83.6M+, NRCHA All-Time Leading Sire -- full profile in database) out of Teles Lies (Lenas Telesis -- LTE $93,206; Northwest Festival Open Derby Reserve Champion; San Diego Open Derby Reserve Champion; 3rd NCHA $10,000 Novice Top Ten; PCCHA $10,000 Novice Champion; 6th PCCHA Fall 4YO Open Stakes; finalist NCHA $10,000 Novice Finals). 5-Panel N/N, HERDA N/Hrd, N/My, EJSCA N/N. Trained and shown by Rock and Cody Hedlund, whose skill, dedication and love for the horse were instrumental in his rise to prominence per Solo Select Horses. NCHA Hall of Fame. Now standing at Solo Select Horses, Gainesville TX for 2026 breeding season at $3,200 ($2,500 standing fee plus $700 chute fee). Previously stood at Brazos Valley Stallion Station / Valley Equine, Stephenville TX; foals from Valley Equine years remain eligible for Valley Equine Super Stallion Incentive through the 2028 NCHA Futurity. Also eligible: Breeders Invitational, NCHA Super Stakes, NRCHA Stallion Stakes, PCCHA, Royal Crown Roping, Gold Buckle Futurities. LTE $437,016. NCHA Hall of Fame. 48 finals appearances -- extraordinary consistency across a long career. 14 Championships, 8 Reserve Championships. 2 AQHA World Championships in Cutting. Confirmed titles: Breeders Invitational Non-Pro Derby Reserve Champion; NCHA Non-Pro Super Stakes Reserve Champion; Showdown in Cowtown Summer Slot Cutting 4/6YO Non-Pro Derby Champion; Breeders Invitational Non-Pro Classic Champion; The Ike Open Classic Reserve Champion; NCHA Non-Pro Classic/Challenge Reserve Champion; Bonanza Non-Pro Classic Champion. NCHA Non-Pro Futurity finalist. AQHA Open Preperformance ROM, earning 12 Cutting (Level 3) points in open events. Solo Select Horses: 'Throughout his illustrious career, Meteles Cat made 48 finals appearances, captured 14 Championships, and secured 8 Reserve Championships, solidifying his reputation as a top performer.' His 14 hands frame belies an athlete of remarkable power and footwork whose ability to read and rate cattle proved elite across nearly a decade of competition. PE $3,262,972 as of January 6, 2026 (confirmed gallopauction.com -- most current). 576 AQHA foals registered, 183 money-earners, average earnings per money-earner $17,830.45. Foal earnings discipline breakdown: Cutting $2,725,778.90; Reined Cow Horse $383,220.41; Roping (all events) $139,594.77; Barrel $12,893.00; Ranch $5,706.87; Other $7,065.61. Versatility across disciplines confirms Meteles Cat passes athleticism, cow sense, and trainability broadly across his foal crops. Solo Select Horses: 'Meteles Cat has become a $3.2+ Million-Dollar Sire, with his offspring continuing to excel in multiple disciplines.' In-foal partners (earlier listing): 'Meteles Cat's offspring are proving to be very versatile. Producing NRCHA and NCHA Champions that have earned over $500,000 in earnings with very limited foal crops.' The Metallic Cat x Teles Lies (Lenas Telesis) cross creates a pairing of elite cutting athleticism on top with a non-pro-proven, trainable mare family underneath -- producing offspring that have proven accessible across a range of competitive levels from NCHA open to non-pro, NRCHA, and roping.

name: Metallic Rey Mink
_performance_summary: Metallic Rey Mink -- 2016 Red Roan Stallion. By Metallic Cat (High Brow Cat x Chers Shadow/Peptoboonsmal -- LTE $637,711, QData/NCHA #2 All-Time Leading Cutting Sire, PE $83.6M+ -- full profile in database) out of Dual Rey Mink (Dual Rey x -- 2019 NCHA Top 10 Leading Dam of Cutting Money-Earners confirmed Performance Horse Central; by Dual Rey, QData/NCHA #3 All-Time Leading Cutting Sire PE $57.9M+). Owned by Los Jaboncillos Ranch, Premont TX. Trained and shown by Austin Shepard, EquiStat $10M+ Rider. Joined Valley Equine for the 2025 breeding season -- confirmed Valley Equine announcement September 2024. Stud fee $4,000. Foals eligible: Valley Equine Super Stallion Incentive, Breeders Invitational, NRCHA Cow Horse Incentive, NCHA Super Stakes, PCCHA, Abilene Spectacular, Royal Crown Roping, Chrome Cash. Valley Equine, Stephenville TX. LTE $205,224. #1 All-Age Money Earner in 2019 -- confirmed Los Jaboncillos Ranch. 2019 NCHA Open Futurity Champion -- scored 226, confirmed multiple sources. 2020 NCHA Senior Open Champion. 2020 West Texas Open Derby Finalist. 2020 Waco Derby Open Finalist. Austin Shepard: 'He was not only a great athlete, but he was as smart about a cow as any horse I have ever seen.' Valley Equine September 2024: 'Known for his impeccable natural cow sense and cutting style, this stallion is set to make a remarkable impact on the future of the industry.' First foal crop producing historic results. 2025 NCHA Open Futurity: Minkish (x Blackish/Metallic Rebel, for Jackpot Farm and Ellen Carter) scored 226 under Beau Galyean, earned $138,000 in Valley Equine Super Stallion Incentive payouts -- confirmed Valley Equine December 2025. Valley Equine: 'His finals score matched the 226 his sire earned in his own Futurity year, a fitting milestone for the first crop.' One of Jackpot Farm's connections said: 'They always said Mink was special and so willing, even as a two year old, and watching that trait pass on has been so meaningful.' 2026 NCHA Super Stakes confirmed offspring champions: Red N Milds (Open Derby Champion, scored 223.5, $77,514.70 for Wheeler Dealer Cutting Horses LP with Michael Cooper -- led both go-rounds and the semifinals before winning the finals); Tessa Rey (Amateur Derby Champion, scored 222, $14,674.55 for Crow Performance Horses LLC with Trystan Crow); Mazeratis Mink (Limited Amateur Co-Champion, scored 212, $5,384.87 for Dwayne and Amber Haselip with Ashtyn Haselip); Matchbox (Limited Amateur Co-Reserve Champion with owner-rider Marcie Campbell). Valley Equine April 2026: 'Another title from Metallic Rey Mink's first crop made it clear that Red N Milds was not a one-off story.' Four champions from a single major event, all from the first foal crop -- one of the most dominant debut sire performances in recent NCHA history. The Metallic Cat x Dual Rey Mink cross stacks the two deepest sire lines in modern cutting -- #2 All-Time (Metallic Cat) on top and #3 All-Time (Dual Rey) on bottom.

name: Moms Lil Rebel
_performance_summary: Moms Lil Rebel -- 2019 Bay Stallion. By Metallic Rebel (Metallic Cat x Sweet Abra/Abrakadabracre -- LTE $438,315, NCHA Open Horse of the Year 2017, NCHA Hall of Fame, NCHA World Champion Stallion, PE $16.6M+, 2025 QData #2 Leading Reined Cow Horse Sire, NRCHA Million Dollar Sire -- full profile bvss004) out of SDP Moms CD (High Brow CD x -- LTE $133,129; producer of $526,000+ confirmed Valley Equine 2026 lineup; from SDP Buffalo Ranch). High Brow CD (SDP Moms CD's sire, High Brow Cat x Sweet Little CD/CD Olena): LTE $542,101; 2007 NCHA Open Futurity Champion; 2008 NCHA Horse of the Year; 2011 NCHA Champions Cup Champion; NCHA Hall of Fame; PE $8,644,760; described as 'the only stallion in history to win the NCHA Futurity and then 5 major events at age 4.' The pedigree of Moms Lil Rebel creates a significant concentration of High Brow Cat influence: Metallic Rebel is by Metallic Cat (son of High Brow Cat) and SDP Moms CD is by High Brow CD (son of High Brow Cat), meaning High Brow Cat appears twice in the first three generations -- a pedigree structure that consistently produces elite cow sense and athletic ability. Stud fee $3,500. Valley Equine, Stephenville TX. Foals eligible: Valley Equine Super Stallion Incentive, Breeders Invitational, NCHA Super Stakes. Semen availability: GREEN designation on Valley Equine Breeding Calendar. LTE $422,270 (Valley Equine 2026 confirmed). Valley Equine 2026 lineup: 'Moms Lil Rebel built his record through consistent finals appearances across multiple major aged events, earning at a level that reflects durability and competitiveness in strong company.' Confirmed title: 2022 NCHA Futurity Brazos Bash Valley Super Stallions Open Incentive Champion -- confirmed Valley Equine stallion page. Still actively showing in 2025 per Valley Equine page (2025 Show Schedule listed). No foal crop data yet; first foals approaching show age. Metallic Rebel's influence as a sire makes this stallion an attractive early entry: the sire of Moms Lil Rebel is the 2025 #2 Leading Reined Cow Horse Sire and continues to produce at the top of multiple disciplines. Valley Equine 2026 on Metallic Rebel: 'Metallic Rebel, the 2025 #2 Leading Reined Cow Horse Sire, and out of SDP Moms CD, an earner of $133,129 who has gone on to produce more than $526,000.' Breeders targeting Metallic Rebel genetics with a High Brow Cat-line dam cross have a compelling option in Moms Lil Rebel. The double High Brow Cat concentration in this pedigree combined with proven Metallic Cat sire-line production makes him a strong candidate for cutting and cow horse programs alike.

name: My Pistols Hott
_performance_summary: My Pistols Hott -- 2018 Bay Stallion. 14.2H, 1012 lbs. AQHA 5956396. 7-panel N/N. By Hottish (Spots Hot x Stylish Play Lena/Docs Stylish Oak -- 2004 NCHA Futurity Open Champion; PE $23,842,560 confirmed Valley Equine 2026; deceased, ICSI only at Valley Equine; one of the top producing sires of the modern cutting era; sire of Dual Reyish, Zigzagg, My Pistols Hott, Countin Hot Checks, Cool N Hot, Hottish Metal and many others in this database) out of Shes My Other Pistol (Playgun x Miss Freckles Hancock/Doc Bar -- Playgun is a leading NCHA and NRCHA sire by Mr Jess Perry; Miss Freckles Hancock carries Doc Bar and Three Bars blood; dam produce record for Shes My Other Pistol not further confirmed in available sources; Playgun influence adds reining athleticism to the Hottish cow sense base). Valley Equine (formerly Brazos Valley Stallion Station), Stephenville TX. Stud fee $3,500 confirmed Valley Equine 2026. Contact Valley Equine at valleyequinerepro.com. Source: https://valleyequinerepro.com/stallions/ LTE $254,011 confirmed valleyequinerepro.com. NCHA Super Stakes Open Classic Champion confirmed from Valley Equine profile. The NCHA Super Stakes is one of the three premier NCHA major events alongside the Futurity and the Derby, bringing together the top cutting horses aged 5 and 6 in the country to compete across Limited Open, Open, and Non-Pro divisions across multiple rounds. Winning the Open Classic at this level is a significant credential that establishes a horse as an elite open-level cutting competitor with the athleticism, cow sense, and training to succeed against the best competition in the country. The Hottish x Playgun cross pairs two distinct but complementary performance backgrounds. Hottish brings the Spots Hot x Stylish Play Lena combination -- a pedigree that has consistently produced horses with exceptional cow sense and natural athleticism that reads cattle instinctively. Playgun through Shes My Other Pistol adds reining-bred athleticism and the Doc Bar foundation that has underpinned elite performance horses for decades across cutting, reining, and cow horse. The combination creates offspring with versatility and depth of pedigree to compete across NCHA cutting and potentially NRCHA cow horse competition as foal crops mature. No offspring show data confirmed in available sources -- My Pistols Hott is a 2018 stallion with first foal crops just beginning to reach competition age. His NCHA Super Stakes Open Classic title at 6 years old establishes him as a legitimate open-level competitor whose position at Valley Equine reflects genuine competitive achievement. The 7-panel N/N genetic status confirms clean health genetics throughout the pedigree. Breeders crossing mares without Hottish or Playgun bloodlines will find the greatest genetic diversity benefit from this breeding.

name: One Fine Vintage
_performance_summary: One Fine Vintage 'Vinnie' -- 2009 Sorrel Stallion. 15.1 hands. 6-Panel N/N. By One Time Pepto (LTE $331,097; 2005 NCHA Super Stakes Open Champion; 2006 Augusta 5/6YO Open Classic Champion; 2006 Abilene Spectacular Open Classic Champion; PE $22M+; by Peptoboonsmal; owned by Jeffrey and Sheri Matthews, Weatherford TX; Team Roping Journal confirms '$22 million producer') out of Shiners Siena (Shining Spark -- Shining Spark is a foundational NRHA/NRCHA sire, NRHA Futurity Champion and NRCHA Snaffle Bit Futurity Champion, multiple NRHA world champions in produce). Owned by Robertson Ranches. Standing at Valley Equine, Stephenville TX. Foals eligible: Valley Equine Super Stallion Incentive, NRCHA Cow Horse Incentive, PCCHA, Royal Crown Roping, Riata Buckle, ARHFA Top Gun Stallion Incentive, Gold Buckle Futurities, The Diamond Classic. Enrolled: NRCHA Stakes, PCCHA Stakes. LTE $135,187. Competed successfully across seven or more disciplines at the AQHA World Show -- an exceptional demonstration of versatility and trainability. Confirmed full show record: 2015 NRCHA Supreme Reined Cow Horse; 2016 AQHA World Champion Senior Working Cow Horse; 2017 AQHA Bronze Champion Senior Working Cow Horse; 2017 NSHA World's Richest Stock Horse Reined Cow Horse Open Champion; 2018 World's Greatest Horseman Finalist; 2019 AQHA World Show Qualifier and Finalist in Working Cow Horse, Heading, Heeling, Ranch Riding, and Halter; AQHA High Point Open and Supreme Working Cow Horse; NRCHA Supreme Reined Cow Horse; 280.5 AQHA Points. Stallion Register: 'AQHA and NRCHA World Champion, AQHA High Point Open and Supreme Working Cow Horse and NRCHA Supreme Reined Cow Horse.' Team Roping Journal 2025: 'One Fine Vintage, the No. 11 team roping sire of 2024 according to QData, has offspring that have won nearly $500,000 in roping alone. Known as Vinnie, the stallion is himself an AQHA and NRCHA world champion, and the cornerstone of Robertson Ranches breeding program.' Jazlyn Rice (fit Robertson Ranches yearlings for sale): 'We have been so impressed by the consistency in their size, build and demeanor. They are equal parts smart and sweet and possess the athletic ability to excel at multiple events just like Vinnie did. He puts his stamp on them every time.' PE $792,879 (Valley Equine 2026 -- most current confirmed). No. 11 QData Team Roping Sire of 2024 -- confirmed Team Roping Journal February 2025. Offspring won nearly $500,000 in roping alone. Versatility across disciplines confirms the dam-line (Shining Spark) and sire-line (One Time Pepto x Peptoboonsmal) combination produces horses with multi-event athleticism and trainability. Valley Equine 2026: 'One Fine Vintage brings together a rare combination of cow horse excellence, stock horse versatility, and practical production. A World Champion across multiple associations, his own resume spans the highest levels of the AQHA and NRCHA, including elite Open Bridle and Hackamore accomplishments. That same adaptability is showing up in his offspring, with success across rope horse futurities on both the head and heel side, as well as continued presence in the cow horse and stock horse arenas.' Of all the stallions in this database, One Fine Vintage stands out as the most directly relevant to breeders targeting team roping performance alongside cow horse and cutting versatility.

name: Phil N Dangerous
_performance_summary: Phil N Dangerous 'Phil' -- 2019 Sorrel Stallion. By Hottish (Spots Hot x Stylish Play Lena/Docs Stylish Oak -- PE $23.8M+, 2025 QData #3 and 2024 NCHA #4 Leading Cutting Sire -- full profile bvss005) out of Lil Maddy Rey (Dual Smart Rey x -- LTE $240,000+ confirmed Valley Equine 2026; producer of $680,000+ in earning offspring confirmed Valley Equine 2026; Dual Smart Rey sire: LTE $330,436, 2006 NCHA Super Stakes 4YO Open Champion, PE $10M+; Phil N Dangerous was the first money-winning performer in EquiStat for Lil Maddy Rey -- confirmed QHN December 2022). Owned by Misty Greeson. Shown by Lindy Thorn. Stud fee $5,125 (confirmed Valley Equine 2026 lineup). Foals eligible: Valley Equine Super Stallion Incentive, NCHA Super Stakes, PCCHA, Breeders Invitational, NRCHA Cow Horse Incentive. Valley Equine, Stephenville TX. Semen availability: GREY designation on Valley Equine Breeding Calendar. LTE $575,979 (Valley Equine 2026 confirmed). 2022 NCHA Open Futurity Champion -- scored 228 with Lindy Thorn on December 10, 2022, at Will Rogers Coliseum in Fort Worth TX; won $300,061 plus incentives from a field of over 500 horses. The win made Lindy Thorn the first woman to win the NCHA Futurity Open Championship since Kathy Daughn in 2000 -- a 22-year milestone confirmed QHN and NCHA. Only the third woman to win the NCHA Futurity Open ever (Lindy Burch in 1981, Kathy Daughn in 1985 and 2000). Thorn: 'When I saw the score, I thought my heart was gonna fall out of my chest.' Phil N Dangerous is the second NCHA Open Futurity Champion sired by Hottish, who also produced 2017 NCHA Open Futurity Champion Dual Reyish -- QHN: 'the first of a 1-2 punch for EquiStat Elite $10 Million Sire Hottish, who also sired Open Reserve Champion Kittenish' in the same 2022 finals. Thorn on Phil N Dangerous: 'He's super sensitive. He's super careful. He's very willing, he doesn't like to get in trouble -- he's just like his mother.' 2025 NCHA Open Classic/Challenge Co-Champion -- confirmed Valley Equine 2026 lineup. Multiple aged-event finals appearances across his 5 and 6YO seasons. Valley Equine 2026: 'Phil N Dangerous proved himself early and often against the best competition of his generation. He captured the NCHA Open Futurity Championship, backed it up with multiple aged-event finals, and added a Co-Champion title in the 2025 NCHA Open Classic/Challenge. Along the way he was a finalist in multiple premier events.' Hottish sire page confirms Phil N Dangerous among Hottish's named top offspring alongside Kittennish, Dual Reyish, Hottish Metal, Cool N Hot, Hott Rod, and Blackish. No offspring data yet; first foals approaching show age.

name: Purrn Likeasmoothcat
_performance_summary: Purrn Likeasmoothcat 'Canelo' -- 2013 Dun Stallion. AQHA #5580510, APHA #1118685, double registered. 14.2 HH, 1150 lbs. 6-Panel N/N. By Smooth As A Cat (High Brow Cat x Shes Pretty Smooth/Wheeling Peppy -- LTE $500,000+; NCHA Horse of the Year; NCHA and NRCHA Hall of Fame; 14.1 HH; PE $36.5M+; 43 finals appearances, never missed a show due to injury or unsoundness -- confirmed Manion Ranch; Issuu: 'EquiStat's 4th ranking Cutting Sire for 2019 and Top 10 All-Time Leading Cutting Sires; among High Brow Cat's offspring, Smooth As A Cat ranks as his No. 2 sire of offspring with earnings in excess of $29,000,000 and grandsire of performers with more than $4,300,000') out of Purr N Like Magic (Abrakadabracre x -- LTE $88,234; 2008 West Texas Futurity 4YO Non-Pro and LMT Non-Pro Champion; 2008 South Point Futurity 4th (tie) 4YO LMT Non-Pro; 2008 NCHA Super Stakes 4YO Non-Pro semifinalist; 2009 Augusta Futurity 4th 5-6YO Non-Pro; 2009 West Texas Futurity 5-6YO LMT Non-Pro finalist; 2009 NCHA Summer Spectacular 5-6YO Open and 50K Non-Pro finalist; 2009 NCHA Super Stakes 5-6YO Non-Pro finalist; 2010 Cattlemens Derby 5-6YO Non-Pro Reserve Champion; 2010 Arbuckle Mountain Futurity 3rd 5-6YO Non-Pro; 2010 Augusta Futurity 4th 5-6YO Open; 2010 Abilene Spectacular 5-6YO Open finalist). Abrakadabracre (Purr N Like Magic's sire by Bob Acre Doc): LTE $112,566; AQHA World Champion Junior Cutting Horse; NCHA Limited Open Futurity Champion; Equi-Stat Elite $1 Million Sire. name: Smooth Talkin Style
station: XIT Ranch / Bosque Ranch Performance Horses
_performance_summary: Smooth Talkin Style 'Talker' -- 2011 Sorrel Stallion. AQHA/APHA. By Smooth As A Cat (LTE $474,325; PE $36,594,820; QData and NCHA #5 All-Time Leading Cutting Sire; NCHA Horse of the Year; 'the only NCHA Horse of the Year to sire not only one but two NCHA Open Horses of the Year' per in-foal partners; one of only three stallions in NCHA history to sire both an NCHA HoY and an NCHA World Champion Open or Non-Pro horse, alongside Smart Little Lena and High Brow Cat) out of Stylish Play Lena (Docs Stylish Oak x Play Lena/Freckles Playboy -- LTE $264,473; QData and NCHA #4 All-Time Leading Cutting Dam confirmed Valley Equine 2026 and multiple sources; PE $2,392,989; 2001 South Point Futurity 4YO Open Reserve Champion; 2003 NCHA Summer Spectacular 5/6YO Open Champion; 2003 Abilene Spectacular 5/6YO Open Champion; dam of Hottish $301,843 PE $23.8M+ 2025 QData #3, Smooth Talkin Style, Pepto Boom $316,324, Areybe $160,250 currently showing; produce earnings $2M+ with grandget $9M+). 5-Panel N/N. Cross-discipline offspring earnings confirm exceptional versatility: cutting, reined cow horse, roping, and barrel racing all represented among top earners.

name: Sniperr
_performance_summary: Sniperr -- 2019 Red Roan Stallion. By High Brow Cat (High Brow Hickory x Smart Little Kitty/Smart Little Lena/Doc's Hickory -- QData and NCHA #2 All-Time Leading Sire PE $97M+; deceased October 2019; ICSI only at Valley Equine; sire of Metallic Cat, Bet Hesa Cat, NRR Cat King Cole, Badboonarising and many others in this database; the foundation of the modern cutting horse industry through his sons and daughters) out of Gini One Time (One Time Pepto x -- One Time Pepto is by Peptoboonsmal x One Time Soon, a leading NCHA cutting sire; dam produce record for Gini One Time not further confirmed in available sources; the One Time Pepto connection adds the Peptoboonsmal/Peppy San Badger foundation to the High Brow Cat top line). Valley Equine (formerly Brazos Valley Stallion Station), Stephenville TX. Stud fee $3,500 confirmed Valley Equine 2026. Source: https://valleyequinerepro.com/stallions/ LTE $216,536 confirmed valleyequinerepro.com. Confirmed show record: 2023 Abilene Spectacular Champion; 2023 NCHA Summer Spectacular Non-Pro Champion. The Abilene Spectacular is a premier NCHA regional event bringing together top cutting horses for open and non-pro competition across multiple go-rounds. Winning the championship at this level in 2023 establishes Sniperr as an active and competitive performer at the age when most stallions are just beginning their breeding careers, giving breeders the rare combination of a proven show record and elite pedigree depth. The High Brow Cat x One Time Pepto cross pairs two of the most influential cutting horse sire lines of the modern era. High Brow Cat with PE $97M+ is the #2 All-Time Leading NCHA sire and the foundation of the Cat bloodline that dominates cutting horse breeding globally. One Time Pepto through Gini One Time brings the Peptoboonsmal and Peppy San Badger line that has produced elite cow horse and cutting talent for decades. The combination creates horses with exceptional cow sense from both sides of the pedigree -- High Brow Cat athleticism and natural cattle reading ability paired with the Peptoboonsmal line intelligence and competitive fire that has produced champions across all three phases of reined cow horse and cutting competition. No offspring show data confirmed in available sources -- Sniperr is a 2019 stallion with first foal crops still young. His 2023 NCHA championship credentials combined with Valley Equine placement and exceptional pedigree depth establish him as a legitimate breeding prospect. Breeders seeking to access both the High Brow Cat and Peptoboonsmal pedigree lines simultaneously will find Sniperr an efficient cross on mares that lack either bloodline.

name: Storyteler
_performance_summary: Storyteler -- 2019 Sorrel Stallion, AQHA/APHA double-registered. By Smooth Talkin Style (bvss035 -- 2015 NCHA Open Horse of the Year, PE $9,390,419, QData #6 Leading Cow Horse Sire, Leading Freshman Sire 2020 -- full profile bvss035) out of Show Biz Kitty (High Brow Cat x -- NCHA Leading Dam 2023, 2020, and 2018; 3rd Leading Dam 2022; producer of $2M+ confirmed QHN March 2024; 'anticipating becoming the all-time leading Western performance horse dam in the near future' per QHN). Foals eligible: Valley Equine Super Stallion Incentive, NCHA Super Stakes, Breeders Invitational, PCCHA, NRCHA Cow Horse Incentive, Chrome Cash. Valley Equine, Stephenville TX. Show Biz Kitty is the most accomplished active producing dam in Western performance -- also dam of: All Spice (Once In A Blu Boon x Show Biz Kitty -- 2020 NCHA Open Futurity Champion, NCHA Open Horse of the Year 2020, sold for $5M at 2025 Teton Ridge Sale); Kittennish (Hottish x Show Biz Kitty -- LTE $549,190+, 2025 NCHA Open Horse of the Year confirmed Valley Equine HoY article); Badboonarising (Once In A Blu Boon x Show Biz Kitty -- PE $3,811,012, 2025 QData #7 Leading Cutting Sire -- full profile bvss014). Banuelos at 2024 APH: 'I owe everything to the horse today... My hats off to their mama and what she has done.' Storyteler is a half-sibling to All Spice (2023 APH cutting champion with Banuelos) and Kittennish. The depth of Show Biz Kitty's produce record is unparalleled in the modern era of Western performance horse breeding. LTE $383,249 (Western Bloodstock September 2025 -- most current). Confirmed full show record: 2024 American Performance Horseman Open Cutting Champion -- scored 230 with Adan Banuelos at Globe Life Field in Fort Worth TX, March 2024; confirmed AQHA, APHA, QHN, Western Horseman, Horse Illustrated, multiple sources. Won for a second consecutive year for Banuelos (who won 2023 APH cutting on half-sibling All Spice). Storyteler also named 2024 AQHA Fan Favorite Horse of the Event, voted by those in attendance. NCHA Super Stakes Intermediate Open Derby Co-Reserve Champion -- confirmed Valley Equine 2026 lineup. Split 3rd Run For A Million Cutting Challenge -- confirmed Western Bloodstock Sept 2025. Split 3rd NCHA Super Stakes Open Derby -- confirmed Western Bloodstock. 3rd NCHA Super Stakes Open Classic -- confirmed Western Bloodstock. Valley Equine 2026: 'Storyteler built his reputation in the spotlight, earning a Co-Reserve Championship at the NCHA Super Stakes Intermediate Open Derby and capturing the Open Cutting title at The American Performance Horseman with a 230. His show record established him as the highest-earning son of Show Biz Kitty.' Banuelos: 'This horse is phenomenal. He comes to work every day enjoying what he does; he thinks it's a game, and I want to keep it that way as long as I can. I can't tell you how proud of this horse I am. He loves what he does, and so do I.' First foals approaching show age in 2025-2026 -- no offspring data yet.

name: Sugarr Daddy

name: Whiski Sauer
_performance_summary: Whiski Sauer -- 2020 Blue Roan Stallion. 6-panel N/N including HERDA N/N. By High Brow Cat (High Brow Hickory x Smart Little Kitty/Smart Little Lena/Doc's Hickory -- QData and NCHA All-Time #1 Leading Sire PE $97M+; deceased October 2019; ICSI only at Valley Equine; foundation sire of the modern Cat bloodline and father of Metallic Cat bvss002, Bet Hesa Cat add002, NRR Cat King Cole bvss012, Badboonarising bvss014, Sniperr bvss036 and many others in this database; Whiski Sauer is among the final foal crops from High Brow Cat's ICSI program making him part of an increasingly rare and valuable gene pool at the top of cutting horse breeding) out of Moms Stylish Scoot (Docs Stylish Oak x -- Docs Stylish Oak is a leading reining and NRCHA sire known for producing athletes with natural collection and precision rein work; dam produce record for Moms Stylish Scoot not further confirmed in available sources; the Docs Stylish Oak influence adds reining athleticism and technical precision to the High Brow Cat cow sense base). Valley Equine (formerly Brazos Valley Stallion Station), Stephenville TX. Stud fee $2,000 confirmed Valley Equine 2026. 6-panel N/N including HERDA N/N -- a critical health credential for breeders crossing on High Brow Cat daughters which carry HERDA risk through the line. Source: https://valleyequinerepro.com/stallions/ LTE $59,888 confirmed valleyequinerepro.com. Whiski Sauer is a 2020 stallion whose LTE reflects early competition rather than a full show career. His primary value as a breeding stallion lies in his exceptional pedigree -- as a High Brow Cat son out of a Docs Stylish Oak dam, he combines the #1 All-Time cutting sire with one of the top reining and cow horse sire lines in a single package available at an accessible stud fee. The High Brow Cat x Docs Stylish Oak combination produces offspring with the natural cattle reading ability and explosive athleticism that has defined the Cat bloodline for three decades, paired with the reining mechanics and training foundation that Docs Stylish Oak daughters consistently contribute. This cross has proven effective across NCHA cutting and NRCHA cow horse competition where both cutting instinct and precise rein work are required simultaneously. Breeders crossing mares without High Brow Cat or Docs Stylish Oak breeding will maximize the genetic diversity benefit from this pairing. The 6-panel N/N genetic status eliminates hereditary disease risk and makes Whiski Sauer a clean cross on any mare regardless of her HERDA or HYPP carrier status -- an important consideration for breeders who already have High Brow Cat mares in their program.

name: Zigzagg
_performance_summary: ZigZagg -- 2019 Bay Stallion. By Hottish (Spots Hot x Stylish Play Lena/Docs Stylish Oak -- 2004 NCHA Futurity Open Champion; PE $23,842,560 confirmed Valley Equine 2026; deceased, ICSI only at Valley Equine; one of the top producing sires of the modern cutting era; sire of Dual Reyish, My Pistols Hott, Countin Hot Checks, Cool N Hot, Hottish Metal, Roasting, Swing Wide and many others in this database) out of Justasassycat (High Brow Cat x -- High Brow Cat PE $97M+ is the #2 All-Time Leading NCHA Sire; Justasassycat's dam side not further confirmed in available sources; the High Brow Cat dam brings elite Cat bloodline athleticism and cow sense to the Hottish top line creating a concentration of the two premier cutting sire families of the modern era). Placing as a finalist at the NCHA Open Futurity is a significant credential -- the NCHA Futurity is the premier cutting horse event in the world, and Open Futurity Finalists represent the top horses in any given crop year competing against the best-bred, best-trained cutting prospects available. Zigzagg's combination of Non-Pro championship success and Open Futurity finalist status demonstrates versatility across competition levels and establishes his credentials as both an open-level and amateur-level competitive performer. The Hottish x High Brow Cat cross is one of the most proven pedigree combinations in the modern cutting horse world. Hottish brings cow sense and athletic presence through the Spots Hot x Stylish Play Lena combination -- a pedigree that has produced champions across NCHA cutting, NRCHA cow horse, and multiple disciplines. High Brow Cat through Justasassycat adds the premier Cat bloodline that has produced more documented NCHA offspring earnings than virtually any other sire family. The cross concentrates two complementary elite lines to produce horses with the natural ability to read cattle and the athletic presence to compete at the highest levels of cutting competition. No offspring show data confirmed in available sources -- Zigzagg is a 2019 stallion new to Valley Equine in 2026 with first foal crops still developing. His NCHA Open Futurity Finalist credential at the highest level of cutting horse competition establishes him as a legitimate addition to the Valley Equine lineup.

_performance_summary: CSR Dual Glo -- Stallion. By Dual Rey (Peptoboonsmal x Nurse Rey/Nu Rey -- PE $57,893,606 QData #3 All-Time Leading Cutting Sire; deceased 2022; one of the most influential performance horse sires of the modern era; sire of Dual Reyish bvss001 and many other elite performers in this database; his sons and daughters dominate NCHA, NRCHA, and team roping arenas across the country) out of a Bobby Lewis mare (dam name not confirmed in available sources; Bobby Lewis connection brings team roping and heading athleticism; Bobby Lewis is a proven heading and heeling sire with USTRC and NRCHA credentials; dam produce record not further confirmed in available sources).
