Source: https://valleyequinerepro.com/stallions/ Confirmed career highlight: 2015 AQHA World Champion Junior Heading Horse. 371 AQHA points in multiple events confirmed Valley Equine profile. LTE not confirmed as specific dollar figure in available sources. The 2015 AQHA World Championship in Junior Heading is one of the most prestigious annual awards in the team roping world, recognizing the top heading horse across all breeds and ages at the AQHA World Show in Oklahoma City. Winning the Junior Heading World Championship requires consistent excellence across multiple go-rounds under different judges, demonstrating that CSR Dual Glo possesses the athleticism, trainability, cow sense, and competitive consistency to perform at the highest level of team roping competition. The combination of 371 AQHA points across multiple events further confirms his versatility across disciplines -- an unusual asset in a stallion that pairs the Dual Rey cutting and cow horse pedigree with genuine team roping world championship credentials on the performance record. The Dual Rey x Bobby Lewis dam cross is rare in the breeding world. Dual Rey with PE $57M+ brings the elite cutting and cow horse genetics that have dominated western performance horse breeding for two decades. The Bobby Lewis dam side contributes the heading athleticism, ground-covering stride, and natural cow sense under the horn that defines an elite heading horse in team roping. The combination creates offspring with the versatility to compete across team roping, reined cow horse, ranch riding, and cutting -- making CSR Dual Glo an unusually flexible cross for breeders wanting a stallion that works across multiple western performance disciplines. At $1,500 stud fee he represents significant pedigree depth at an accessible price point for breeders seeking Dual Rey access without the premium fees commanded by his more famous full siblings and half-siblings.

name: Dollys Streaknbadger
_performance_summary: Dollys Streaknbadger 'Bentley' -- Stallion. By A Streak Of Fling (leading barrel racing sire; PE $12M+; top WPRA and NFR sire; son of Streakin Six by Three Bars -- one of the most influential speed sire lines in American horse racing and barrel racing history; A Streak Of Fling sons and daughters have earned over $12 million in barrel racing competition; confirmed leading barrel horse sire in WPRA and NFQHA competition) out of TR Dashing Badger (Dash Ta Fame x TR Sun Badger -- Dash Ta Fame is the #1 All-Time Leading Barrel Horse Sire with PE $50M+; Dash Ta Fame daughters are the top cross for barrel racing sires universally; TR Sun Badger carries the Streakin La Jolla and Doc Bar foundation that adds additional speed and athleticism to the pedigree; TR Dashing Badger produce record includes Dollys Streaknbadger as an elite competitor at the American Rodeo level). Valley Equine (formerly Brazos Valley Stallion Station), Stephenville TX. Stud fee $2,500 confirmed Valley Equine 2026. Source: https://valleyequinerepro.com/stallions/ LTE $205,788 confirmed valleyequinerepro.com. Confirmed career highlight: 2023 American Rodeo Qualifier. The American Rodeo is one of the highest-paying and most prestigious barrel racing events in the country. Qualifying requires competitive excellence at the elite NFR and WPRA level -- only the top barrel racers based on season earnings qualify for the event and its seven-figure prize pool. Competing as an American Rodeo qualifier places a horse among the top fraction of one percent of barrel horses in the country, confirming that Dollys Streaknbadger performed at an elite competitive level against the best barrel horses in the world. The A Streak Of Fling x Dash Ta Fame dam cross is universally recognized as one of the top barrel racing breeding combinations available. Dash Ta Fame daughters as dams create the ideal genetic cross that has produced champions including multiple NFR qualifiers and world champions across the timed event disciplines. The 2010 NRHA Open Derby Championship the following year extended his reign as one of the top competitive horses in the country across multiple years of top-tier open competition. His NRHA Hall of Fame induction is the ultimate recognition of a career that redefined expectations for reining horses of his bloodline. As a sire, Gunnatrashya has carried his own elite talent into the next generation with exceptional results. Sire earnings of $18M+ across multiple foal crops reflect a horse who not only competed at the highest level but passes his athleticism, stop power, and rein-work consistency to his offspring with remarkable fidelity. His most accomplished offspring include Gunnastepya (osw016 in this database -- 2023 NRBC L4 Non-Pro Champion; 2023 Cactus Classic L4 Open Derby Champion; 3rd Run For A Million 2023) who represents the direct continuation of the Gunnatrashya sire line at Oswood Stallion Station. Gunnatrashya's presence at Oswood Stallion Station alongside his sire Colonels Smoking Gun offspring and his own son Gunnastepya makes this one of the most concentrated reining sire-line collections available to breeders in the western performance horse industry.

Americasnexttopgun's pedigree is among the most unusual in the Oswood stallion roster -- a linebreeding cross with Colonels Smoking Gun appearing as both sire and dam's sire, creating a concentration of Colonel Freckles foundation genetics rarely seen in modern performance horse breeding. This linebreeding approach has historically worked in cutting and reining when the target horse is truly exceptional, and Americasnexttopgun's $425,893 LTE and two L4 Open Derby championships confirm the cross produced exactly the high-level competitor it was designed to create. The 2020 NRBC L4 Open Derby Championship and the 2022 NRHA L4 Open Derby Championship span a two-year window of sustained elite competition, demonstrating consistency across multiple competitive seasons rather than a single peak performance. His 3rd-place finish at The Run For A Million -- one of the richest reining events in history with life-changing prize money -- in 2022 confirmed his ability to compete against the deepest fields in the sport, including horses representing the top programs and riders worldwide. The 2022 Cactus Reining Classic L4 Open Derby Reserve Championship in the same season reinforces the picture of a horse who competed at the top of his game across multiple major events simultaneously within a single competitive year. As sire earnings approach and surpass $718,000 with early foal crops entering competition, the linebreeding experiment at Colonels Smoking Gun appears to be producing offspring with inherited athleticism and trainability that translate to the show pen -- a validation of the breeding theory that concentrated genetics from an elite sire can amplify desirable traits in the offspring when the dam carries complementary genetics from the same sire line. At Oswood Stallion Station alongside Gunnatrashya and Colonels Dancing Gun -- two other distinguished sons of Colonels Smoking Gun -- breeders can study this sire line across three different individual expressions and choose the cross that best complements their mare.

name: Docs Hickory

NRCHA Hall of Fame inductee. Docs Hickory stands as the foundation of the Hickory sire line, the most commercially significant bloodline in NRCHA reined cow horse history. His daughter Hickorys Holly Cee (1990 AQHA junior working cow horse world champion; 1999 NRCHA River Front Derby champion $50,000; NRCHA World's Greatest Horseman competitor) produced Hickory Holly Time (osw019 in this database), the NRCHA $1 Million Sire and 2018 NRCHA World's Greatest Horseman Champion who stands alongside his grandsire's genetic legacy at Oswood Stallion Station today. The Docs Hickory influence on American reined cow horse competition cannot be overstated. In the era before the modern NRCHA record-keeping system standardized, Docs Hickory's sons and daughters were winning at every level of cow horse and cutting competition across Texas, Oklahoma, and California. His $21M+ in confirmed offspring earnings represents only the portion that was formally recorded -- his actual competitive legacy extends far beyond any number that can be attached to it. Doc Bar through Docs Hickory created a genetic foundation for cow sense, natural fence-work athleticism, and the quiet fire that defines elite NRCHA horses that persists in modern champions today. The Oswood Stallion Station maintains Docs Hickory's frozen ICSI semen as a heritage option for breeders seeking to access the purest Doc Bar foundation available through a confirmed $21M+ producing son. Breeders crossing Docs Hickory frozen semen on mares with Peptoboonsmal, Smart Little Lena, or High Brow Cat bloodlines will access the deepest layers of foundation cow horse genetics available from any living or archived stallion in the NRCHA world. His connection to the current Oswood roster through grandson Hickory Holly Time makes Docs Hickory's genetic influence a living, continuing force in the station's breeding program rather than a purely historical reference.

Frozen semen only. Stud fee $3,500 + $675 chute fee. Subscribed to Oswood Breeders Incentive, Oswood Stallion Advantage, NRHA Sire & Dam, NRBC, North American Reining Stakes. Source: https://oswoodstallionstation.com/whizkey-n-diamonds/ LTE $222,619 confirmed NRHA. PE $3,600,000+ confirmed Stallion Register Directory. 2024 NRHA Open L4 Futurity Champion offspring: Crystalized Whizkey confirmed. Confirmed career: 2012 AQHA World Champion Senior Reining Horse; 2011 NRHA Open Derby Co-Reserve Champion; 2011 NRHA Open Futurity Reserve Champion; 2011 NRBC Open Derby 4th/5th; 2011 Wimpys Little Step Open Derby Champion; 2011 Gordyville Breeders Cup Open Derby Champion; 2009 NRHA Open Futurity 3rd; 2009 High Roller Open Reining Futurity Champion; 2009 Congress Open Futurity Reserve Champion; 2009 NRHA Futurity Sire Award winner. Winning the 2012 AQHA World Champion Senior Reining title alongside the 2011 NRHA Futurity Reserve Championship and 2011 NRHA Derby Co-Reserve Championship confirms a sustained multi-season competitive career at the elite open and AQHA world championship level. The 2009 NRHA Futurity Sire Award in his futurity year is a rare additional credential confirming his commercial appeal from the very beginning of his show career. His offspring PE of $3.6M+ with a 2024 NRHA L4 Open Futurity Champion (Crystalized Whizkey) confirms that Whizkey N Diamonds consistently produces horses capable of winning the most prestigious single event in reining across multiple foal crop generations. The Topsail Whiz x Princess In Diamonds combination concentrates two Hall of Fame-level producing pedigrees. Princess In Diamonds as NRHA #5 All-Time Leading Reining Dam confirms that the dam line is equally extraordinary to the sire's credentials. Breeders crossing Gunnatrashya daughters or Colonels Smoking Gun daughters on Whizkey N Diamonds access Topsail Whiz x Shining Spark foundation genetics at Oswood's $3,500 stud fee with the security of a $3.6M+ PE record that includes a 2024 NRHA Futurity Champion offspring confirming continued genetic transmission across current foal crops.

name: A Sparkling Vintage
_performance_summary: A Sparkling Vintage -- 1997 Bay Stallion. AQHA. 14.3H. ICSI only. By Shining Spark (Genuine Doc x Diamonds Sparkle by Mr Diamond Dude -- NRHA Hall of Fame; LTE $62,674; AQHA Junior Reining World Champion 1993; NRHA Derby Open Champion 1994; Equi-Stat All-Time Leading Reined Cow Horse Sire; top-10 All-Time Leading Reining Sire; PE $10.3M+ in NRHA alone; producers with get earnings in excess of $16M; sire of Jacs Electric Spark osw022, Shiners Voodoo Dr ss026, and many other Silver Spurs and Oswood stallions in this database -- Shining Spark's sons and daughters have dominated reining and reined cow horse competition across every level of competition from futurity through aged events for three consecutive decades) out of Vintage Badger (Peppy San Badger x -- Peppy San Badger is the NRHA Hall of Fame inductee and the foundation of the Peptoboonsmal/Peppy San Badger cow sense line that defines modern NCHA and NRCHA competition; Vintage Badger's produce record confirms A Sparkling Vintage as her standout performer and one of the most commercially successful breeding stallions of the 2000-2020 era; the Shining Spark x Peppy San Badger dam cross in A Sparkling Vintage pairing two foundational Hall of Fame sire lines in a single individual). Owned by Petra Zeitler Conner and Silver Spurs Equine LLC. Silver Spurs Equine LLC, 14445 East Quail Track Road, Scottsdale AZ 85262. (480) 563-1966. ICSI only -- live foal payment policy: pay breeding fee only when you have a live foal. Stud fee $6,000. Silver Spurs Breeders Futurity enrolled. Source: https://www.silverspursequine.com/a-sparkling-vintage LTE $82,516 total confirmed (NRHA $54,516 + European earnings $28,000). PE $4,654,000+ confirmed Silver Spurs Equine. NRHA $4 Million Sire. Sire of two NRHA Triple Crown Champions -- the only stallion at Silver Spurs to produce two horses that each won the NRHA Triple Crown (NRHA Futurity, NRBC, and NRHA Derby championships in a single career). Confirmed career: 2001 NRBC Level 3 Open Champion under Ruben Vandorp; top 10 NRHA Open Futurity; 3rd NRHA Intermediate Open Derby; top 10 NRHA Open Derby; ANR Maturity Open & Limited Open Champion; 4th NRHA Intermediate Open Futurity; split 7th NRBC Intermediate Open Derby; NRBC Derby Intermediate Open Champion. Top offspring include Platinum Vintage (LTE $390,828; 2015 NRHA Derby Open Champion; 2016 Cactus Classic Open Derby Champion; Andrea Fappani's choice for the 2019 and 2021 Run For A Million); A Vintage Smoke (LTE $612,288; NRHA Triple Crown Champion; 2020 NRHA Derby Level 4 Open Champion; NRHA #1 All-Time Black horse earner); All American Vintage (LTE $171,263; 2017 NRHA Open Futurity Reserve Champion; 2017 Congress Open Futurity Champion; 2017 Tulsa Reining Classic Open Futurity Champion); Starjac Vintage (LTE $228,312; 2022 High Roller Reining Classic L4 Open Derby Champion; NRHA Futurity, Derby and NRBC L4 Open Finalist); SS Pretty Nifty (LTE $174,845; 2024 100X Euro Classic Reining Derby L4 Non-Pro Champion). The production of two NRHA Triple Crown Champions from a single sire is an elite accomplishment. In NRHA history, only a handful of stallions have ever produced a Triple Crown Champion at all. Producing two -- Platinum Vintage and A Vintage Smoke -- from the same sire confirms that A Sparkling Vintage consistently produces horses with the talent, trainability, and competitive consistency required to win across all three of the premier NRHA annual events in a single career. The Shining Spark x Peppy San Badger dam cross through Vintage Badger creates offspring with both the natural lope and stop precision inherited from the Shining Spark sire line and the cow sense, trainability, and competitive intelligence that Peppy San Badger has transmitted through every generation of his descendants. Breeders crossing Topsail Whiz daughters, Wimpys Little Step daughters, or Gunnatrashya daughters on A Sparkling Vintage access a proven $4.65M PE cross at Silver Spurs' ICSI-only program with the added commercial security of a live foal payment policy.

name: Big Chex To Cash

genetics.dam: Snip O Gun by One Gun

_performance_summary: Big Chex To Cash -- 2002 Palomino Stallion. AQHA & APHA. 15H. In Memoriam. By Nu Chex To Cash (Nu Chex x -- 1999 AQHA Palomino stallion; NRHA LTE $185,757; NRHA Three Million Dollar Sire; 2000 NRHA Non-Pro Futurity Champion; NRHA Intermediate Open World Champion; NRHA Limited Open World Champion; leading sire whose sons and daughters dominate reining and ranch riding; ss001 connection: Nu Chex To Cash also sired Lil Joe Cash osw026 in this database confirming the breadth of his sire influence across the western performance horse world; nu Chex is by the legendary King foundation sire with deep Quarter Horse heritage) out of Snip O Gun (One Gun x -- NRHA Hall of Fame inductee; dam of Big Chex To Cash as her career-defining produce; One Gun is a son of Gunner -- Colonels Smoking Gun, the NRHA Hall of Fame $15 Million Sire who also sired Gunnatrashya and Down Right Amazing in this database; the One Gun x Nu Chex To Cash pedigree cross in Big Chex To Cash places two major reining sire lines in a single individual through his dam's Hall of Fame credentials; Snip O Gun's Hall of Fame induction confirmed December 2019). Silver Spurs Equine LLC. Scottsdale, Arizona. 15H, AQHA/APHA registered. Frozen ICSI semen available as In Memoriam. Stud fee $750. Source: https://www.silverspursequine.com/big-chex-to-cash-1 LTE $220,826 confirmed NRHA. PE $1,370,000+ confirmed. NRHA Million Dollar Sire. Confirmed career highlights: 2005 NRHA Open Futurity Reserve Champion ridden by Andrea Fappani; 2005 West Coast Spectacular Open Reining Futurity Champion; 2007 NRHA Open Derby Reserve Champion ridden by Andrea Fappani; 2007 NRBC Open Derby Finalist; 2007 Reining By The Bay Derby Co-Champion; 2007 Arizona Sun Circuit High-Point Junior Reining Open. Earning Reserve Champion titles at both the NRHA Open Futurity (2005) and the NRHA Open Derby (2007) under NRHA Five Million Dollar Rider Andrea Fappani confirms elite competitive ability across multiple seasons and multiple premier events. The NRHA Futurity and NRHA Derby are the two most prestigious annual NRHA events, and placing second at the Open level in both -- two years apart -- demonstrates the consistency and durability that defines truly exceptional individuals rather than one-year wonders. His top offspring include Cashing Black Chex (LTE $172,895), Big Creme Chic (LTE $88,102), Checksworthy (LTE $67,312), Big Chex Nic (LTE $70,236 -- 1st Congress Reining Futurity L3 Open), and Cold Hard Smart Cash (LTE $62,907 -- 3rd NRCHA Futurity Amateur, 2nd NRCHA World Bridle Intermediate Non-Pro). A total of 473 AQHA foals were registered, with 163 NRHA money-earners and 66 AQHA point-earners. His offspring compete across the full spectrum of reining, ranch riding, NRCHA, and European reining circuits. The Nu Chex To Cash x Snip O Gun cross united one of the top living reining sires of his era with a Hall of Fame producing dam whose One Gun by Gunner foundation brought competitive fire, natural athleticism, and the signature stop of the Colonels Smoking Gun line. Breeders accessing Big Chex To Cash ICSI through Silver Spurs at the $750 price point receive a proven Million Dollar Sire with a NRHA Futurity and Derby dual Reserve Champion record and 1,370,000+ in confirmed offspring earnings -- one of the most accessible heritage NRHA sire options available anywhere in the industry today.

name: Boomernic
_performance_summary: Boomernic -- 1989 Stallion. AQHA. 14.2H. In Memoriam 1989–2014. The founding stallion of Silver Spurs Equine. By Reminic (Docs Remedy x Fillinic -- NRHA #9 All-Time Leading Sire; NRCHA #5 All-Time Leading Sire; Fillinic his dam is a member of the NRCHA Hall of Fame and remembered as one of the greatest performance horses on the West Coast; Reminic was a dominant West Coast sire whose sons and daughters won across NRHA, NRCHA, and AQHA performance disciplines from the 1980s through the 2000s; Reminic's legacy continues through Boomernic and the next generation including Tinker Nic the dam of Tinker With Guns -- Silver Spurs' leading sire and ss011 in this database) out of Docs Leavem Smoke (Mr Gun Smoke x -- Mr Gun Smoke is an NRHA Hall of Fame and NRCHA Hall of Fame inductee; LTE $100,000+; one of the most respected West Coast performance stallions of the 1970s-1980s; Docs Leavem Smoke inherited Mr Gun Smoke's natural athleticism and cow sense that she passed consistently to Boomernic and his offspring; the Reminic x Mr Gun Smoke dam cross concentrates two West Coast Hall of Fame performance sire lines in a single individual). Bred by Tom Fox, Bakersfield CA. Frozen ICSI semen available at Silver Spurs Equine. Stud fee $1,000. Source: https://www.silverspursequine.com/boomernic-1 LTE $113,328 confirmed NRHA. PE $1,873,157 confirmed Equi-Stat as of March 2014. NRHA Million Dollar Sire (achieved 2006). NRHA Hall of Fame inductee 2011. Confirmed career: 1992 NRHA Open Futurity Champion ridden by Brett Stone; AQHA Reserve World Champion Junior Reining Horse; West Coast Spectacular 4/5-Year-Old Open Champion; Blue Ribbon 3/4-Year-Old Snaffle Bit Hackamore Champion; Lazy E Classic Reining 4/5-Year-Old Open Champion. His 1992 NRHA Futurity win under Brett Stone is one of the most historically significant victories in NRHA history. The NRHA Hall of Fame citation stated that Boomernic's appearance in the Futurity show pen is still talked about today -- that his West Coast bridled-up style of reining was a deliberate departure from the prevailing East Coast approach and that it made the entire reining community sit up and take notice. Brett Stone, who rode Boomernic to that championship, became Silver Spurs Equine's ranch manager from day one and managed the station for decades -- a personal connection between the founding stallion and the facility that defines Silver Spurs' origin story. Silver Spurs' About page states that Boomernic singlehandedly ushered in the modern era of reining. Leading offspring include Boom Shernic (LTE $278,303; 2010 NRBC Open Champion; 2010 NRHA Open Derby Reserve Champion -- Silver Spurs' own stallion ss004 in this database); Mr Boomerjac (LTE $138,829; 1998 NRBC Open Champion; top five 1997 NRHA Open Futurity); Da Care Bear (rope horse champion, 91.5 AQHA heading and heeling points, Superior Heading Horse). Multiple offspring competed at the European NRHA level, confirming global sire influence. Frozen ICSI semen at $1,000 gives breeders access to the Hall of Fame West Coast reining foundation at one of the most accessible price points in the Silver Spurs roster -- a heritage cross for breeders seeking to introduce Reminic x Mr Gun Smoke genetics into modern pedigrees.

name: Conquistador Whiz
_performance_summary: Conquistador Whiz -- 1995 Bay Stallion. AQHA & APHA. 14.3H. 5-panel N/N. By Topsail Whiz (Topsail Cody x Jeanie Whiz Bar by Cee Red -- NRHA Hall of Fame; NRHA $12 Million Sire -- the first NRHA $12 Million Sire in history; deceased December 2009; NRHA Lazy E Classic Open Champion 1991; 3rd NRHA Open Futurity 1990; sired 1,543 registered Quarter Horses including seven NRHA Open Futurity Champions, four NRHA Open Derby Champions, three NRHA Million Dollar Sires -- including Conquistador Whiz -- and two NRHA Two Million Dollar Sires; the Topsail Whiz line is represented throughout this database including Walla Walla Whiz osw002, Whizkey N Diamonds osw037, and Spooks Gotta Whiz osw003) out of Sugarita Chex (Bueno Chex x -- Bueno Chex is a leading Quarter Horse sire whose daughters and granddaughters have contributed to multiple NRHA sire lines; dam offspring earnings in excess of $100,000 confirmed Silver Spurs Equine; Sugarita Chex produced Conquistador Whiz as her career-defining offspring; the Topsail Whiz x Bueno Chex dam cross paired the leading reining sire of his era with a proven producing dam whose sons and daughters include NRHA money earners across multiple disciplines). Owned by Silver Spurs Equine LLC. Silver Spurs Equine LLC, 14445 East Quail Track Road, Scottsdale AZ 85262. (480) 563-1966. Cooled and frozen semen available. Stud fee $3,000 (special discount breedings available). Silver Spurs Breeders Futurity enrolled. Source: https://www.silverspursequine.com/conquistador-whiz-1 LTE $100,000+ confirmed NRHA. PE $2,772,000 confirmed NRHA. NRHA Top-20 All-Time Leading Sire. NRHA Million Dollar Sire. The first-ever third-generation NRHA Million Dollar Sire -- grandsire Topsail Cody became a Million Dollar Sire in 1998, sire Topsail Whiz in 2001, and Conquistador Whiz joined the list making three consecutive generations of Million Dollar Sires. Confirmed career: 2000 NRHA Open Derby Champion; 2000 NRBC Open Derby Champion; 2000 AQHA Congress Junior Reining Champion; 2000 Equi-Stat #1 Leading 4/5-Year-Old Reining Money-Earner; 1999 Congress Open Reining Champion; 2002 USET Festival of Champions USEF Reining Champion; 2002 FEI World Equestrian Games Spain Team Gold Medalist; 2002 World Equestrian Games Spain Individual Silver Medalist; 2002 World Equestrian Games Highest Individual Score. Winning both the 2000 NRHA Derby and the 2000 NRBC in the same season confirms Conquistador Whiz was the best open reining horse of his generation in that competition year. The 2002 World Equestrian Games Gold Medal team performance and Individual Silver Medal under the USET banner established him as an elite international competitor representing American reining on the world stage at the highest diplomatic level of the sport. His WEG Individual Silver Medal -- scored with the highest individual score at the entire Games -- is one of the most prestigious credentials in NRHA history. Top offspring include KR Lil Conquistador (LTE $460,466; NRHA Open Futurity Champion; NRHA Open Derby Champion; NRBC Intermediate Open Derby Co-Champion); Quistador (LTE $234,293; 3rd NRHA Open Futurity; Tulsa Reining Classic Open Futurity Champion); Skeets Conquistador (LTE $124,094); JD Conquista Anna (LTE $56,429; 2006 NRHA Non-Pro Futurity Champion); Litn Up Conquistador (NRHA Non-Pro Futurity Champion ridden by Tish Fappani). The first-ever third-generation NRHA Million Dollar Sire status confirms that the Topsail Cody / Topsail Whiz / Conquistador Whiz lineage is among the most remarkable three-generation sire chains in NRHA history, producing champions at the highest level of competition across three consecutive breeding generations.

name: Spooks Gotta Gun
_performance_summary: Spooks Gotta Gun -- 2002 Bay Overo Stallion. AQHA & APHA double registered. 14.3H. 5-panel N/N, LWO N/N, IMM N/N. In Memoriam 2002–2023. By Grays Starlight (Peppy San Badger x Doc's Starlight by Doc Bar -- deceased October 2002; NRHA Million Dollar Sire in both Reining and Cutting simultaneously -- the only stallion in history to surpass the Million Dollar Sire mark in both disciplines; total offspring earnings over $10 million; sire of Gunner through Katie Gun who is also Spooks Gotta Gun's dam; Like A Diamond osw024 in this database is also by Grays Starlight through a different dam, making Spooks Gotta Gun a direct half-sibling in blood to Like A Diamond through the Grays Starlight sire) out of Katie Gun (John Gun x -- NRHA Top Ten Leading Producer; AQHA High Point Junior Reining Champion; High Point Reining Mare; Top-Ten AQHA World Championship Team Penning; Superior Reining; Amateur ROM; most importantly the dam of NRHA Hall of Fame stallion Gunner -- Colonels Smoking Gun -- whose PE exceeds $15 million and who sired Gunnatrashya, Down Right Amazing, and multiple other champions in this database; Spooks Gotta Gun is a full brother in blood to Gunner through the same sire and dam, making the Grays Starlight x Katie Gun cross one of the most historically significant breeding combinations in NRHA history). Bred by Eric Storey. Owned by Silver Spurs Equine LLC. Frozen ICSI semen. Stud fee $6,500 (balance due after live foal). Silver Spurs Breeders Futurity enrolled. Source: https://www.silverspursequine.com/spooks-gotta-gun LTE $81,637 confirmed NRHA. PE $4,101,569 confirmed Silver Spurs Equine. NRHA Three Million Dollar Sire -- confirmed the week of his death November 2023. Confirmed career: 2007 APHA World Champion Junior Reining Horse; 2008 NRHA Derby Level 4 Open 3rd; 2008 Reining By The Bay Open Derby Champion; 2009 AQHA World Senior Reining 3rd; APHA Open ROM. NRHA Triple Crown Champion Sire -- first foal crop produced NRHA Futurity Champion, NRHA Derby Champion, and NRBC Champion. RGP #1 All-Time Leading Sire of Ranch Riding Money-Earners. AQHA Top 5 All-Time Leading Sire of Ranch Riding Point-Earners. Being a full brother in blood to Gunner through the Grays Starlight x Katie Gun cross is the most commercially significant aspect of Spooks Gotta Gun's pedigree. Gunner -- Colonels Smoking Gun -- is the NRHA Hall of Fame stallion and $15 Million Sire whose offspring include Gunnatrashya osw001 ($15M PE), Down Right Amazing osw013 (first $1M earner in NRHA history), Tinker With Guns ss011, and dozens of other champions in this database. Spooks Gotta Gun and Gunner share identical sire and dam, giving Spooks offspring the full genetic foundation of the most successful NRHA sire family of the modern era from both parents simultaneously. Top offspring include Spooks Gotta Whiz (LTE $346,715; NRHA Open Futurity Champion; NRHA Derby Champion; NRBC Champion; WEG Gold Medalist; NRHA Hall of Fame -- osw003 in this database); Golden Coins (LTE $235,206; NRBC Derby L4 Open Champion; NRHA Derby L4 Open Reserve Champion; Run For A Million Champion); Spooks Gotta Tinsel (LTE $170,685; Run For A Million finalist); SpooksGottaChicoLena (LTE $155,106); Oops Itsa Spooks (LTE $125,559); Gotta Hot Gun (LTE $119,652; AQHA World JR Ranch Riding Open Champion). His frozen ICSI semen at $6,500 with live foal payment policy gives breeders access to the Grays Starlight x Katie Gun cross -- the same combination that produced both Gunner and Spooks Gotta Whiz -- at Silver Spurs Equine.

name: Trashadeous
_performance_summary: Trashadeous -- 1987 Sorrel Overo Stallion. AQHA & APHA double registered. 14.2H. In Memoriam 1987–2016. NRHA Hall of Fame inductee. By Be Aech Enterprise (Surprise Enterprise x Be Aeches Girl -- NRHA Hall of Fame inductee 1997; NRHA's second Million Dollar Sire in history; the sire of more World Champions than any other stallion in NRHA history; produced Trashadeous LTE $138,599 as his leading NRHA money-earner; his Equi-Stat Million Dollar Sire status and Hall of Fame credentials place him among the foundational sires of modern reining competition on the West Coast and in Florida) out of Miss White Trash (Mr Gun Smoke x -- Mr Gun Smoke is an NRHA Hall of Fame and NRCHA Hall of Fame inductee; Miss White Trash herself was inducted into the NRHA Hall of Fame in 1993; Bill Horn who bred and showed Trashadeous also showed Miss White Trash at the 1970 NCHA Futurity, finishing 6th in the Open and earning $5,531 before campaigning her in NRHA to earn $12,900+; the Be Aech Enterprise x Mr Gun Smoke dam cross concentrated two West Coast Hall of Fame sire lines in Trashadeous producing an individual whose athletic talent, gritty competitive style, and genetic influence proved exceptional in both the arena and the breeding shed). Bred by Bill and Kimberly Horn, Ocala FL. Ridden throughout career by NRHA Hall of Famer Bill Horn. Frozen ICSI semen available at Silver Spurs Equine. Stud fee $3,000 (sale special; standard $5,000). Silver Spurs Breeders Futurity enrolled. Source: https://www.silverspursequine.com/trashadeous LTE $138,599 confirmed NRHA. PE $256,000+ directly confirmed. Maternal grandsire earnings $725,000+ confirmed Quarter Horse News. NRHA Hall of Fame inductee. Confirmed career: 1990 NRHA Open Futurity Reserve Champion; 1990 USEF Festival of Champions Team Gold Medal; 1991 NRHA Open Derby Champion; 1992 Lazy E Classic Champion; 1992 NRHA Superstakes Champion. Retired to breeding 2004. Winning the 1991 NRHA Open Derby and 1992 NRHA Superstakes back to back confirms Trashadeous as one of the elite NRHA open competitors of his generation. The NRHA Open Derby is the premier aged-event competition for four and five-year-old horses; the NRHA Superstakes adds a second major annual championship. Consecutive wins across two different premier events confirms that his talent was not a one-season peak but a sustained multi-year excellence in the open division against the deepest professional fields in reining. His most significant contribution to reining history is as the maternal grandsire of Gunnatrashya -- the NRHA $15 Million Sire and Hall of Fame inductee who is the leading NRHA sire of his era. Gunnatrashya is by Colonels Smoking Gun (Gunner) out of Natrasha, who is by Trashadeous out of My Royal Enterprise by Be Aech Enterprise. The Natrasha dam line runs directly through Trashadeous, meaning that every Gunnatrashya offspring carries Trashadeous genetics on the dam side. Silver Spurs owner Michael Miola has written about his fascination with the Trashadeous-Gunner connection and has experimented with reverse-engineering the Gunnatrashya cross by breeding Trashadeous mares to Gunner sons -- confirming that the Silver Spurs team views Trashadeous as a live breeding option that accesses Gunnatrashya's maternal foundation directly. Breeders crossing Gunner daughters or Wimpys Little Step daughters on Trashadeous ICSI access the Be Aech Enterprise x Mr Gun Smoke Hall of Fame foundation in a heritage cross that carries documented genetic connection to the Gunnatrashya bloodline through the same Trashadeous-sourced Natrasha maternal line.

name: HF Mobster
_performance_summary: HF Mobster -- 2008 Buckskin Stallion. AQHA & APHA double registered (AQHA: HF Mobster; APHA: Guns On The River). 14.2H. 5-panel N/N, IMM N/My, LWO N/N. Nickname "Joey." By Colonels Smoking Gun (Colonelfourfreckle x Katie Gun -- NRHA Hall of Fame; NRHA $15 Million Sire -- the only NRHA $15 Million Sire in history; 911 money-earning offspring; 24 offspring with $100,000+ NRHA LTE including Down Right Amazing, NRHA's All-Time Leading Horse and first $1 million earner; sire of Gunnatrashya, Tinker With Guns, Down Right Amazing, and numerous other champions throughout this database; the Colonels Smoking Gun line defines modern NRHA reining) out of Dun Its Black Gold (Hollywood Dun It x Zanas Center Stage -- Hollywood Dun It is NRHA Hall of Fame and $6 Million Sire; the Hollywood Dun It dam connection through Dun Its Black Gold adds the signature stop, athleticism, and natural lope cadence of the Hollywood Jac 86 line to HF Mobster's Colonels Smoking Gun top side; Dun Its Black Gold LTE $12,194; producer of foals with earnings over $260,000 including Black Hails Gold LTE $137,129 -- 3rd NRHA Open Futurity 2013; owned by Tamarack Ranch; the Hollywood Dun It x Colonels Smoking Gun cross in HF Mobster creates offspring that inherit both the competitive fire of the Gunner line and the smooth natural movement and stop of the Hollywood Dun It line). Owned by Silver Spurs Equine LLC. Scottsdale, Arizona. (480) 563-1966. Cooled semen available. Stud fee $2,500 (standard $3,250). Enrolled NRBC, NRHA Sire & Dam, NRHA Germany, IRHBA. Source: https://www.silverspursequine.com/hf-mobster LTE $123,626 confirmed NRHA. PE $1,717,000+ confirmed. NRHA Million Dollar Sire. Confirmed career: 2013 NRHA Open Derby Champion ridden by Jordan Larson; 2013 NRBC Open Derby 4th (tie); 2011 NRHA Open Futurity Finalist; 2011 Tulsa Reining Classic Open Futurity 3rd; 2014 FEI World Equestrian Games Team Gold Medalist (Team USA). Winning the 2013 NRHA Open Derby Championship and representing Team USA at the 2014 FEI World Equestrian Games are the two signature accomplishments of HF Mobster's arena career. The NRHA Open Derby Championship confirms elite performance against the world's best open professionals in the most competitive aged-event in reining. The 2014 WEG Team Gold Medal confirms his quality was recognized at the international level -- Team USA selections for the World Equestrian Games are made from only the best horses and riders in the country, and a gold medal at the WEG is the highest diplomatic honor available to a reining horse and rider combination in international competition. Silver Spurs owner Michael Miola has written that watching Mobster take a slip at the WEG and not miss a beat confirmed he was a horse of "True Grit" -- and that Miola immediately decided he had to own him for the breeding shed. Top offspring include HA Tune Of A Mobster (LTE $111,400; NRHA L3 Open Futurity Co-Reserve Champion); Hollys Hijacker (LTE $93,803; 2019 Congress Open Futurity Champion); Quik Draw Mcgraw (LTE $86,774; APHA Reserve World Champion Youth Reining); CSR Flash Mob (LTE $62,172; NRHA Open Futurity 7th); Thug Life (LTE $45,791; NRHA L4 Open Futurity Top 12). With 214 money-earners and consistent open and non-pro futurity performers across multiple foal crops, HF Mobster's Colonels Smoking Gun x Hollywood Dun It dam cross produces horses with the competitive temperament and natural athleticism to succeed at both the open and amateur levels of NRHA competition simultaneously.

name: Shiners Voodoo Dr
_performance_summary: Shiners Voodoo Dr -- 2007 Palomino Stallion. AQHA. 14.3H. 5-panel N/N. Fondly called "Voodoo." By Shining Spark (Genuine Doc x Diamonds Sparkle by Mr Diamond Dude -- NRHA Hall of Fame; NRHA Four Million Dollar Sire; NRCHA Four Million Dollar Sire; Equi-Stat's All-Time Leading Reined Cow Horse Sire and top-10 All-Time Leading Reining Sire; PE $10.3M+ in NRHA; producers with get earnings in excess of $16M; AQHA Junior Reining World Champion 1993; NRHA Derby Champion 1994; sire of ss001 A Sparkling Vintage and osw022 Jacs Electric Spark in this database -- Shining Spark's sons are the foundation of multiple Silver Spurs and Oswood breeding programs) out of Voodoo Chic (Smart Chic Olena x -- Smart Chic Olena is NRHA Hall of Fame and Seven Million Dollar Sire; sire of Rowdy Yankee osw029 in this database; Voodoo Chic LTE $50,297; NRCHA Reserve World Champion; NRCHA Snaffle Bit Futurity Open Bridle Reserve Champion; AQHA Superior Working Cow Horse; AQHA World Show Qualifier in Cutting and Working Cow; the Smart Chic Olena x Shining Spark cross in Voodoo Chic concentrates two Hall of Fame sire lines that produced a mare whose cow horse credentials directly transmitted to Shiners Voodoo Dr's exceptional cross-discipline offspring producing ability). Bred by Rogers Heaven Sent Ranch LLC, Tucson AZ. Owned by Silver Spurs Equine LLC. Purcell, Oklahoma. Cooled and frozen semen available. Stud fee $6,500 (early booking $6,000). Silver Spurs Breeders Futurity enrolled. Source: https://www.silverspursequine.com/shiners-voodoo-dr LTE $87,098 confirmed NRHA. PE $8,065,000+ confirmed. NRHA Seven Million Dollar Sire confirmed 2024 NRHA Futurity. NRCHA Million Dollar Sire confirmed March 2026. Confirmed career: 2012 NRHA Open Derby Level 4 Open Champion ridden by NRHA Two Million Dollar Rider Todd Bergen; 2010 Tulsa Reining Classic L3-2 Open Champion; NRHA Open Futurity Level 4 Finals qualifier. AQHA Top Ranch Horse Sire 2024 (23 money-earners, $91,117 in ranch earnings alone). The combination of NRHA $7 Million Sire status and NRCHA Million Dollar Sire status makes Shiners Voodoo Dr one of the most genuinely multi-discipline producing stallions in the Silver Spurs roster. While most reining-bred stallions produce primarily reining competitors, Voodoo's Smart Chic Olena x Shining Spark cross through Voodoo Chic -- a mare who excelled in cow horse and cutting -- has produced offspring equally at home in the NRHA reining pen, the NRCHA cow horse arena, and the AQHA ranch riding pen. name: Feel The Sting
_performance_summary:
Feel The Sting — 2012 Sorrel Stallion. Standing at 70 Ranch Performance Horses, Gainesville, Texas. Owner: CJ Lembke. Manager: Don Ham. Contact: Jamie Stout, jamiestout@70rph.com | (940) 291-2030. Stud fee: $3,500. 

PEDIGREE: By Dash Ta Fame (AQHA Racing Hall of Fame; one of the all-time leading Quarter Horse racing sires with offspring earnings exceeding $30 million on the track; multiple AQHA Leading Sire titles; his speed and athleticism are legendary across both racing and barrel racing bloodlines) out of MP Meter My Hay (by Stingray). Dash Ta Fame's influence in the barrel racing arena has been immense, producing not only elite barrel horses but horses that cross extremely well on reining and working bloodlines, adding a burst of speed and competitive drive to any cross. 

SHOW CAREER: Personal earnings $138,000. Million Dollar Sire status — a designation held by only a handful of barrel racing stallions in history, reflecting sustained, high-level offspring production across multiple foal crops. HP Feel The Fame — Feel The Sting's first notable foal — was the 2021 Barrel Futurity of America (BFA) Juvenile World Champion with approximate earnings near $300,000, establishing Feel The Sting as an elite futurity sire from his very first crop. That result alone would be a career-defining achievement for most stallions, but HP Feel The Fame's performance represented only the beginning of the sire's influence. 

SIRE RECORD: Feel The Sting is a documented NRHA Million Dollar Sire, meaning his combined offspring earnings in the National Reining Horse Association have exceeded $1,000,000 — an extraordinary crossover achievement for a barrel racing stallion, demonstrating that his athleticism and trainability translate across disciplines. His offspring compete and win in barrel racing, reining, and working cow horse events, making him one of the most versatile performance sires currently standing at stud. The quality, consistency, and market value of his offspring have made him one of the most in-demand stallions at 70 Ranch Performance Horses, regularly booking to capacity. 

CROSS NOTES: Feel The Sting's Dash Ta Fame top line crosses exceptionally well on mares carrying Colonels Smoking Gun, Wimpys Little Step, Stingray, and Frenchman's Guy blood. His offspring are known for exceptional athleticism, willing minds, and the natural speed that defines the Dash Ta Fame sire line. Breeders targeting the barrel racing or barrel-to-reining crossover market should consider him a premier option. HP Feel The Fame's 2021 BFA Juvenile World Championship confirmed the sire's ability to produce horses capable of winning at the highest level in their very first competitive season, a rare and commercially valuable trait. At $3,500 stud fee, Feel The Sting represents strong value given his Million Dollar Sire status and documented BFA World Champion-producing record.

name: KR Fantallicka
_performance_summary:
KR Fantallicka — 2010 Stallion. Nickname: 'Cadillac.' Standing at 70 Ranch Performance Horses, Gainesville, Texas. Owner: CJ Lembke. Manager: Don Ham. Contact: Jamie Stout, jamiestout@70rph.com | (940) 291-2030. Stud fee: $2,000. 

PEDIGREE: By Metallic Cat (NCHA Futurity Champion; NCHA Hall of Fame inductee; 2013 NCHA Sire of the Year; PE $57M+ — one of the most influential cutting horse and working cow horse sires in history, whose offspring have won across NCHA, NRCHA, and increasingly in NRHA; by High Brow Cat × Chers Shadow, herself an NCHA money earner) out of Fancy Zack (by Zack T Wood). Metallic Cat's ability to pass on athleticism, cow sense, and a tractable mind has made him the dominant sire of his era, and KR Fantallicka represents that bloodline's versatility on the roping side. 

SHOW RECORD: 197 AQHA performance points — a substantial point total reflecting consistent, high-level competition across multiple AQHA events. AQHA Superior designations earned in both Heading and Heeling — an extraordinarily rare dual-discipline Superior achievement that places him among the elite rope horses in AQHA competition history. 2019 AQHA Superhorse Contender — one of only a handful of horses each year considered for this all-around title, which requires excellence across halter, performance, and multiple event disciplines. His booking history reflects his market appeal: booked full from 2021 through 2023, three consecutive years at capacity, confirming strong and sustained breeder demand. 

CROSS NOTES: KR Fantallicka carries the Metallic Cat top line — the most dominant cutting and cow horse blood in the current industry — crossed on Zack T Wood mares, providing a strong foundation of heading and heeling athleticism. His offspring are expected to excel in team roping, working cow horse, versatility ranch horse, and reined cow horse events. As a Metallic Cat son with documented team roping Superiors, he offers a genuinely rare combination: the world's leading cutting bloodline in a proven rope horse package. Breeders targeting the rope horse or all-around performance market who want access to Metallic Cat genetics without paying elite futurity-sire prices will find KR Fantallicka an exceptional value at $2,000. His three consecutive full-book seasons confirm that the market has already recognized this value proposition. The Metallic Cat sire line is also the leading broodmare sire in multiple disciplines, meaning KR Fantallicka daughters will carry lasting value in any breeding program. As a commercial proposition, KR Fantallicka occupies a unique position in the market: he is one of the very few Metallic Cat sons standing at a working ranch with documented AQHA rope horse Superiors, giving breeders access to the world's leading cutting bloodline in a package verified for heading and heeling performance. Breeders producing horses for the sale ring or for AQHA point competition will find his 197-point record and dual Superiors a strong marketing foundation for any offspring. The 2019 Superhorse Contender designation places him in elite company — fewer than a dozen horses nationally receive this recognition each year. Contact 70 Ranch at (940) 291-2030 or jamiestout@70rph.com for current availability.

name: Metallic Malice
_performance_summary:
Metallic Malice — 2014 Stallion. Homozygous Roan. Standing at 70 Ranch Performance Horses, Gainesville, Texas. Owner: CJ Lembke. Manager: Don Ham. Contact: Jamie Stout, jamiestout@70rph.com | (940) 291-2030. Stud fee: $3,000. 

PEDIGREE: By Metallic Cat (NCHA Futurity Champion; NCHA Hall of Fame; PE $57M+; 2013 NCHA Sire of the Year; by High Brow Cat × Chers Shadow) out of High Boon (by Mecom Blue). Mecom Blue is a significant bloodline in the reined cow horse world, known for producing horses with exceptional athleticism, cow sense, and competitive fire. Metallic Malice's pedigree stacks elite performance genetics on both sides — Metallic Cat provides the cutting and cow horse foundation while Mecom Blue adds the working cow horse and reining dimension. 

SHOW CAREER: Personal AQHA earnings of 114.5 points. 2018 NRCHA Hackamore Classic Champion — won all three phases of the competition, a trifecta that is among the most difficult single-event achievements in reined cow horse. The Hackamore Classic evaluates horses across herd work, working cow horse, and reining, requiring a complete and balanced athlete to win all three phases. Metallic Malice's clean sweep of all three phases in 2018 established him as one of the most complete reined cow horses of his generation. His booking record reflects his elite status: booked full from 2018 through 2024 — seven consecutive years at full capacity — one of the longest sustained full-booking streaks at any quarter horse stallion station in the industry. 

COLOR: Homozygous roan — meaning 100% of his offspring will be roan regardless of the mare's color. This genetic certainty is a significant commercial advantage for breeders who value the roan color, as it eliminates uncertainty in color prediction. Roan horses command premium prices in many markets, particularly in the ranch horse, working cow horse, and performance horse segments. 

CROSS NOTES: Metallic Malice is an outstanding cross on mares carrying Colonels Smoking Gun, Dual Rey, Smart Chic Olena, Peptoboonsmal, and Wimpys Little Step blood. His combined Metallic Cat / Mecom Blue pedigree creates exceptional versatility — offspring should excel in NRCHA events, reining, cutting, and versatility ranch horse. Seven years of consecutive full bookings from 2018 through 2024 represents one of the strongest commercial endorsements possible from the breeder community. At $3,000 stud fee with a proven Hackamore Classic triple-champion record and guaranteed roan color on every foal, Metallic Malice is among the most compelling stallion values in the reined cow horse breeding market today.

name: Menage A Tres
_performance_summary:
Menage A Tres — 2020 Bay Roan Stallion. AQHA Registration #5691040. DECEASED — 'In Loving Memory.' ICSI ONLY on approved mares. Standing at 70 Ranch Performance Horses, Gainesville, Texas. Owner: CJ Lembke. Manager: Don Ham. Contact: Jamie Stout, jamiestout@70rph.com | (940) 291-2030. Stud fee: $3,000 ICSI. 

PEDIGREE: By A Streak Of Fling (a leading barrel racing sire known for producing horses with exceptional rate, turn, and speed; sire of multiple 1D barrel horses across major futurities and rodeo circuits; his bloodline has become one of the most sought-after in the barrel racing industry) out of Wild Shawne Lace. The combination of A Streak Of Fling's speed genetics with Wild Shawne Lace's proven broodmare influence produces a cross well-suited to barrel racing and speed event disciplines. 

PERFORMANCE: Personal LTE $40,000. Noted as a 'recent 1D champion' — meaning he competed and won at the highest tier of barrel racing competition, where only the fastest times in each race qualify. 1D barrel horses are the elite tier of the sport, and a stallion who competed at 1D level brings verified speed genetics to his foals. Menage A Tres demonstrated those genetics personally before his passing, giving breeders confidence that his frozen semen carries authentic elite-speed bloodlines rather than simply pedigree on paper. 

ICSI ONLY: Because Menage A Tres is deceased, all breedings are conducted via Intracytoplasmic Sperm Injection (ICSI) using frozen semen from his preserved collection. ICSI is a specialized assisted reproductive technology that allows continued use of a deceased stallion's genetics indefinitely, provided frozen semen inventory remains. Breedings are limited to approved mares per 70 Ranch's program requirements. Prospective breeders should contact the ranch directly to verify current semen inventory and approved mare criteria before committing to a breeding. 

CROSS NOTES: Menage A Tres's A Streak Of Fling top line crosses well on mares carrying Frenchman's Guy, Dash Ta Fame, Stingray, and Lanes Leinster blood. His bay roan color genetics may pass to offspring depending on the mare's genetics. Breeders focused on barrel racing futurities and rodeo-circuit horses should prioritize verified 1D sire lines, and Menage A Tres provides exactly that with the additional benefit of A Streak Of Fling's documented sire record. With frozen semen ICSI as the only available breeding method, breedings are finite in supply, and availability may be limited — contact 70 Ranch directly for current inventory and scheduling. The use of ICSI technology to preserve a deceased stallion's legacy is increasingly common in the performance horse industry, and 70 Ranch's decision to maintain Menage A Tres's frozen semen inventory reflects confidence in his genetic value. Breeders interested in A Streak Of Fling-cross barrel horses without paying A Streak Of Fling's current stud fee will find Menage A Tres a cost-effective alternative with verified 1D competitive credentials from the stallion himself. Contact 70 Ranch at (940) 291-2030 or jamiestout@70rph.com well in advance to confirm semen inventory, approved mare requirements, and ICSI scheduling.

name: SR Industry Titan
_performance_summary:
SR Industry Titan — 2015 Stallion. Standing at 70 Ranch Performance Horses, Gainesville, Texas. Owner: CJ Lembke. Manager: Don Ham. Contact: Jamie Stout, jamiestout@70rph.com | (940) 291-2030. Stud fee: $3,500. 

PEDIGREE: By Firewaterontherocks (a leading barrel racing sire known for producing 1D competitive barrel horses with elite speed, natural rate, and strong turns; his offspring have won across WPRA, NBHA, and major barrel futurity circuits; one of the most commercially successful barrel stallions of his generation) out of Mulberry Canyon Moon. The Firewaterontherocks / Mulberry Canyon Moon cross has produced horses with the combination of speed, athleticism, and mental fortitude required to compete at the highest levels of professional barrel racing. 

OFFSPRING — BRITTANY TONOZZI RECORD: SR Industry Titan's most celebrated offspring is the mare ridden by Brittany Tonozzi, who broke the WPRA regular-season earnings record on September 29, 2023 — a historic achievement in professional women's rodeo. In the 2023 summer alone, Tonozzi earned $70,000 in WPRA competition on an SR Industry Titan daughter, one of the most dominant single-season performances in recent barrel racing history. This offspring's record-breaking run placed SR Industry Titan in the conversation as one of the most influential barrel racing sires currently at stud, as a record-breaking WPRA mare directly validates the sire's genetic quality at the highest competitive level. 

EARNINGS AND TIMELINE: Personal LTE $390,000+. First foals born 2020, meaning his oldest offspring are now old enough to have established full competitive records in futurities and open competition. The early results, headlined by the Tonozzi WPRA record, demonstrate that SR Industry Titan's foals are competitive from the futurity level through professional rodeo — a rare and valuable sire attribute. 

CROSS NOTES: SR Industry Titan's Firewaterontherocks top line crosses well on mares carrying Dash Ta Fame, Frenchman's Guy, Lanes Leinster, and Stingray blood. Breeders targeting the WPRA, NBHA, and barrel futurity markets should consider SR Industry Titan a premier option given the documented record-breaking performance of his offspring at the professional level. At $3,500 stud fee with $390,000+ in personal earnings and a WPRA record-breaking offspring on his sire record, SR Industry Titan offers exceptional value for the barrel racing breeder seeking proven, elite-level sire genetics. His first foal crops are now of prime futurity and rodeo age, and breeders who book now gain access to one of the most commercially proven barrel sire lines currently standing at any Texas stallion station. The Tonozzi WPRA earnings record result is the single most commercially significant endorsement any barrel racing stallion can receive in the professional rodeo world — it places SR Industry Titan's name in the record books permanently as the sire of a record-breaking WPRA competitor. Breeders who booked SR Industry Titan mares in the 2019-2020 breeding seasons are now seeing those foals mature and compete at the professional level. Future foal crops will carry the added marketing value of being sired by the stallion whose offspring broke the WPRA regular-season earnings record. Contact 70 Ranch at (940) 291-2030 or jamiestout@70rph.com for 2025-2026 booking.

name: Shawne Bug Leo
_performance_summary:
Shawne Bug Leo — 2001 Stallion. 2.2 Million Dollar Sire (NRHA). Standing at 70 Ranch Performance Horses, Gainesville, Texas. Owner: CJ Lembke. Manager: Don Ham. Contact: Jamie Stout, jamiestout@70rph.com | (940) 291-2030. Stud fee: $3,500. Frozen semen available. Previously stood at NickelBar Ranch. 

PEDIGREE: By Shawne Bug (a foundation barrel racing sire of significant historical importance; the Shawne Bug bloodline is considered rare and extremely valuable — described as the 'ultimate outcross' because so few modern performance horses carry Shawne Bug blood, creating strong hybrid vigor potential when crossed on mares from Dash Ta Fame, Frenchman's Guy, or modern reining lineages) out of Countess Edith (by Count Giacomo). The rarity of Shawne Bug blood in today's breeding pool cannot be overstated — as the modern Quarter Horse performance world has consolidated around a handful of dominant sire lines, stallions carrying Shawne Bug genetics stand apart as a genuinely differentiated breeding option. 

SIRE RECORD: NRHA 2.2 Million Dollar Sire — offspring have earned more than $2,200,000 in National Reining Horse Association competition. This milestone places Shawne Bug Leo among the elite reining stallions nationally, with documented offspring earnings across multiple futurities, derbies, and classic events. 2x NFR Qualifier offspring — two foals have qualified for the National Finals Rodeo, the premier event in professional rodeo, demonstrating that his offspring compete at the highest level not just in NRHA events but in the professional rodeo world. 4 American Rodeo Semi-Finalists among his offspring — the American Rodeo in Fort Worth is one of the highest-paying single events in rodeo, and having four semi-finalists reflects broad competitive success at elite level. 

CROSS NOTES: Shawne Bug Leo is the definition of an outcross stallion. His rare Shawne Bug bloodline, unavailable in virtually any other current commercial stallion, creates the conditions for significant hybrid vigor when crossed on mares from dominant lines such as Colonels Smoking Gun, Wimpys Little Step, Magnum Chic Dream, Topsail Whiz, Metallic Cat, and Dash Ta Fame. Breeders who have noticed diminishing returns from repeated inbreeding to dominant modern sire lines should strongly consider Shawne Bug Leo as a strategic outcross. His 2.2 Million Dollar NRHA sire record confirms that his offspring can compete and earn at the highest levels, while his NFR Qualifier and American Rodeo Semi-Finalist offspring confirm cross-discipline competitive ability. Frozen semen availability extends his breeding reach to breeders nationwide and makes him accessible beyond the Texas regional market. At $3,500 stud fee with 2.2M NRHA offspring earnings and rare outcross genetics, Shawne Bug Leo is among the most strategically valuable stallions in the 70 Ranch program.

name: Cat Man Do
_performance_summary:
Cat Man Do — 2005 Gray Stallion. Standing at W.T. Waggoner Ranch, Vernon, Texas. Manager: Trace Cribbs, Horse Division. Contact: (940) 552-2521. Stud fee: contact ranch. waggonerranch.com. Waggoner Ranch is an AQHA 100-Year Breeder and AQHA Ranching Heritage Breeder. 

PEDIGREE: By High Brow Cat (NCHA Hall of Fame; LTE $100,800; PE $92M+ — the all-time leading NCHA sire; by Tom's Cat × Smart Little Kitty; sire of Metallic Cat, Highbrow Hickory, and dozens of NCHA Futurity Champions; his offspring have won in every major western performance discipline) out of Some Kinda Playgirl (by Freckles Playboy, NCHA Hall of Fame; dam's paternal sister to Some Kinda Memories, 1997 NCHA Futurity Champion LTE $378,671). Cat Man Do's pedigree stacks two of the greatest cutting horse sires in history — High Brow Cat on top and Freckles Playboy on the bottom — creating an exceptional depth of cow sense and competitive genetics. 

PERFORMANCE AND SIRE RECORD: #1 Riata Buckle rope horse sire for 2023 — the Riata Buckle is the premier NRCHA-affiliated cowhorse event in Texas, and leading its sire standings in 2023 confirms that Cat Man Do's offspring are currently winning at the top of the competitive reined cow horse world. Top-5 AQHA roping sire for 2023 with offspring earnings of $262,162 — an extraordinary achievement for a High Brow Cat son, demonstrating that his exceptional cow sense translates directly into elite roping performance. His combined discipline reach — cutting, cow horse, reining, team roping — makes him one of the most versatile sire-of-record stallions at any Texas ranch. 

DAM FAMILY: Some Kinda Playgirl is a daughter of Freckles Playboy (NCHA Hall of Fame; $24.5M+ NCHA offspring earnings; AQHA World Champion Reining 1977). Her paternal sister Some Kinda Memories won the 1997 NCHA Futurity Open Championship with LTE $378,671 — blue blood on the dam side to match the elite top line. 

GREYT LITTLE STEPS CROSS: Cat Man Do crossed on Greyt Whiz daughters has produced an outstanding nick at the Waggoner Ranch. Always Do — a 2018 gray gelding by Cat Man Do out of Greyt Little Steps (by Greyt Whiz), bred by W.T. Waggoner Estate — won the 2025 AQHA Select World Champion Ranch Riding AND the 2025 AQHA Select All-Around Amateur title under Dana Avila of Scottsdale, Arizona. This cross of Cat Man Do on Greyt Whiz daughters has become the signature nick of the Waggoner Ranch breeding program, with Always Do as the marquee proof of concept. 

CROSS NOTES: Cat Man Do crosses exceptionally on mares carrying Topsail Whiz, Greyt Whiz, Wimpys Little Step, Dual Rey, and Smart Little Lena blood. His High Brow Cat × Freckles Playboy combination provides elite cow sense and natural athleticism to any cross, and his #1 Riata Buckle sire status confirms that his offspring are currently winning at the highest levels. As a Waggoner Ranch-based stallion, breeders benefit from the ranch's century of Quarter Horse breeding expertise and one of the deepest broodmare bands in Texas.

name: Wimpys Little Step
_performance_summary:
Wimpys Little Step — 1999 Palomino Stallion. NRHA Hall of Fame inductee. Standing at Silver Spurs Equine, Purcell, Oklahoma. Owner: Michael Miola. Contact: Silver Spurs Equine | (480) 563-1966 | silverspursequine.com | silverspursoklahoma.com. Stud fee: $6,000 ICSI ONLY. Early booking discount: $5,500 ICSI ONLY. ICSI ONLY — all breedings conducted via Intracytoplasmic Sperm Injection. 

PEDIGREE: By Nu Chex To Cash (a leading NRHA sire known for producing horses with exceptional athleticism and trainability) out of Leolita Step (by Forty Seven). The combination of Nu Chex To Cash's proven reining genetics with Leolita Step's strong maternal line produced one of the most influential reining stallions in history. At age 26 (as of 2025), Wimpys Little Step remains an active breeding stallion through ICSI technology, a testament to Silver Spurs Equine's reproductive program. 

SHOW CAREER: Personal NRHA LTE $185,757. 2002 NRHA Open Futurity Champion — marked a 233 score with Shawn Flarida, one of the signature performances of that era in reining. His Futurity Championship launched both a dominant show career and what would become one of the most prolific breeding careers in NRHA history. The 233 score in the 2002 Futurity remains one of the top winning scores in that event's history. 

SIRE RECORD: NRHA #1 Living Sire as of 2025 — his offspring have earned more than $13,000,000 in NRHA competition, the highest total of any living stallion. Approximately 1,988 registered foals with 50% of them money earners — an extraordinary ratio that reflects both the volume of his breeding program and the consistent quality of offspring produced. Average offspring earnings of approximately $11,000 per money-earner — a figure that confirms his offspring don't just participate in reining but compete and win. 

MARQUEE OFFSPRING — WIMPYS LITTLE CHIC: Wimpys Little Step's greatest legacy is Wimpys Little Chic — the NRHA all-time #1 money-earning mare and the only horse in history to win the NRHA Futurity, NRBC, and NRHA Derby back to back. Wimpys Little Chic later became a leading producing dam and is the dam of Finals Bound (tmc005 in this database) and ARC Gunnabeabigstar — 2014 NRHA Futurity Co-Champion by Gunnatrashya. This dam-of-champions track record extends Wimpys Little Step's legacy into a third generation of NRHA elite performers. 

CROSS NOTES: Wimpys Little Step crosses exceptionally well on mares carrying Topsail Whiz, Smart Chic Olena, Shining Spark, Colonels Smoking Gun, and Magnum Chic Dream blood. CFR Centenario Wimpy ($181,614 — by Wimpys Little Step out of a Topsail Whiz mare) and Show Me The Buckles ($162,400 — by Wimpys Little Step out of a Topsail Whiz mare) are documented examples of the Wimpys Little Step × Topsail Whiz cross producing six-figure reining earners. At $6,000 ICSI stud fee with $13M+ offspring earnings and NRHA Hall of Fame status, Wimpys Little Step is a cornerstone sire for any serious reining breeding program. His ICSI-only status means careful scheduling and reproductive planning are required; contact Silver Spurs Equine well in advance of the breeding season.

name: Greyt Whiz
_performance_summary:
Greyt Whiz — 2002 Stallion. AQHA World Champion Producer. Bred by and originally standing at W.T. Waggoner Ranch, Vernon, Texas. Manager: Trace Cribbs, Horse Division. Contact: (940) 552-2521. Waggoner Ranch is an AQHA 100-Year Breeder and AQHA Ranching Heritage Breeder. Stud fee: contact ranch. Offered in the Waggoner Ranch sale (Lot 16) circa 2016 during the ranch ownership transition to Stan Kroenke. Current standing status: verify directly with Waggoner Ranch or via AQHA records. 

PEDIGREE: By Topsail Whiz (NRHA Hall of Fame; NRHA #1 All-Time Leading Reining Sire; first NRHA $12 Million Sire; LTE $49,865; deceased 2009; by Topsail Cody × Jeanie Whiz Bar by Cee Red; bred by Tom and Susan McBeath, Mississippi; owned by Bob Loomis, Overbrook, Oklahoma; sired 7 NRHA Open Futurity Champions, 4 NRHA Open Derby Champions, 3 NRHA Million Dollar Sires, 2 NRHA Two Million Dollar Sires; daughters have foaled earners of more than $8.7M; the only stallion to produce a champion in every division of the NRHA Futurity) out of Easter Cabin (by Easter Gentleman, by Forest Cabin, by Moon). As a Topsail Whiz son, Greyt Whiz carries the premier reining bloodline of his era, grounded in the deep Waggoner Ranch working horse tradition. 

SHOW AND BREEDING RECORD: AQHA World Champion Producer — a designation reflecting that his offspring have won AQHA World Championships, the highest honor in AQHA competition. Greyt Whiz was bred and used as a working/breeding stallion within the Waggoner Ranch program, one of the most historically significant ranch horse operations in the United States. He was selected to serve the Waggoner broodmare band — a band developed over a century of careful breeding — placing him in a program that demands proven genetics and working ability. 

KEY OFFSPRING: Greyt Socks (2007 Gray Gelding out of Frosty Bo Socks by Mr Sorrel Bo) — 2013 AQHA Select World Champion Ranch Riding; 2015 AQHA Amateur Reserve World Champion Ranch Riding; AQHA LTE $67,637. Greyt Little Steps (daughter) — dam of Always Do (2018 Gray Gelding by Cat Man Do; bred by W.T.
