name: Hollywoodstinseltown
_performance_summary:
Hollywoodstinseltown — 2004 Palomino Stallion. DECEASED (late stallion). Frozen semen only. Bred and owned by David Silva Sr. of Long Grove, Illinois (Silva Reining Horses). Managed during active breeding career at Tom McCutcheon Reining Horses, 3732 Shepard Road, Aubrey, Texas 76227. Breeding office: (940) 453-0003 | mccutcheonbreeding@gmail.com | tmreining.com. European frozen partners: Isabeau Rohde, info@frozen-partners.de | +49 173 700 5000. Australian partners: Samantha Smith, Cowgirl Performance Horses, smithfamily_1@outlook.com, +61 417 427 387. 5-Panel Genetic Test N/N. 

PEDIGREE: By NRHA Hall of Fame and Seven Million Dollar Sire Hollywood Dun It out of NRHA Hall of Fame show mare Miss Tinseltown (by Great Red Pine). Hollywoodstinseltown is believed to be the only stallion in NRHA history to have both parents inducted into the NRHA Hall of Fame — a distinction that underscores the depth and quality of his bloodline. Hollywood Dun It sired offspring with $7.3M+ in NRHA earnings and is Equi-Stat's leading reining sire from the Hollywood Jac 86 / Doc Bar lineage. Miss Tinseltown was the NRBC Open Champion and one of the NRHA's leading all-time producing dams. 

SHOW CAREER: Personal NRHA LTE $185,886. 2007 NRHA Open Futurity finalist and Prime Time Open division winner — his first year in the show pen. 2008 NRHA Open Derby finalist, finishing 11th. 2009 NRBC — marked a 222 in the first round and missed the Open finals by a half point, but made the most of the Intermediate Open finals berth with trainer Marco Ricotta, scoring an incredible 232 to win the Intermediate Open Championship. 2009 Cowboy Capital Classic Intermediate Open Derby — split 5th. 2010 National Reining Breeders Classic Level 4 Open — finished 4th, earning $39,000 with Marco Ricotta. 2010 World Equestrian Games, Lexington, Kentucky — paired with NRHA Hall of Famer and Million Dollar Rider Tim McQuay, the team brought home the Team Gold Medal and finished 4th in the Individual competition — one of the most prestigious results in American reining history at an Olympic-level event. AQHA World Qualifier in Senior Reining; Open ROM with 30 AQHA reining points. Split 5th, 2009 Cowboy Capital Classic Intermediate Open Derby. 

SIRE RECORD: NRHA $4 Million Sire milestone announced June 2025. 389 NRHA money-earning foals as of 2025. The annual Hollywoodstinseltown Open Futurity at the Tulsa Reining Classic was established in his name by owners Dave and Bonnie Silva, and continues to be one of the most celebrated ancillary events on the NRHA calendar. Offspring have earned money not only across North America but throughout Europe, proving his global breeding influence. 

TOP OFFSPRING: Shining In Town (LTE $200,000+ — 2019 NRHA Derby All-Level Non-Pro Champion, all four levels in a single run; aka 'Chubbs'; bred by Carol Rose Quarter Horses; out of Shine Ann, a Shining Spark daughter owned by Toyon Ranch, Texas; 2nd leading earner by Hollywoodstinseltown); Flexing Guns In Town (LTE $115,000 — out of Shesa Fashion Gun; 2024 NRHA European Level 4 Open Derby Champion; 2024 100X European Classic Level 4 Open Derby Reserve Champion; ridden by Arnaud Girinon); Tinseltown Flash (LTE $134,920 — out of Billie Gun Flash; bred and nominated by McQuay Stables Inc.; owned by Ruoff Dietter Reining Horses Inc.); Mr Royal Hollywood (LTE $134,034 — 2015 Chestnut Stallion out of Cee Miss Hollywood; bred by Brian Bell; NRHA Futurity Top 10, NRBC finalist, Derby Top 10, Run for a Million competitor). 

CROSS NOTES: Hollywoodstinseltown carries no Colonels Smoking Gun, Wimpys Little Step, Topsail Whiz, Gunnatrashya, or Magnum Chic Dream blood at close range — making him an outstanding outcross option on mares from any of those dominant sire lines. He nicks cleanly on Shining Spark daughters, Smart Spook daughters, Colonels Smoking Gun daughters, Wimpys Little Step daughters, and Topsail Whiz daughters. His palomino color and iconic Hollywood Dun It athleticism pass consistently to foals.

name: Late Night Stopper
_performance_summary:
Late Night Stopper — 2011 Smoky Black AQHA Stallion. Also spelled 'Late Nite Stopper.' Physical standing location: Oswood Stallion Station, Weatherford, Texas. Owned by Marc & Kathy Gordon, Elgin, Illinois. Website: latenightstopper.com. 6-Panel Genetic Test N/N; EJSCA N/N. 15.0 hands. AQHA Registration #5414531. 

PEDIGREE: By Jacs Electric Spark (by Genuine Doc) out of Best Stop (LTE $43,208; PE $643,524+; dam of 20 NRHA money-earners — NRHA All-Time Leading Dam). Best Stop is by Custom Crome × Rest Stop. Custom Crome = NRHA Hall of Fame inductee; multiple NRHA Futurity and Derby Champion sire. Rest Stop = NRHA Hall of Fame inductee; NRHA Open Futurity Reserve Champion; NRHA Open Reserve World Champion; Congress NRHA Non-Pro Champion; Non-Pro Champion at the Lazy E Classic and NRHA Futurity Fun in the Sun Derby. Rest Stop is by Topsail Cody (NRHA Hall of Fame). That gives Late Night Stopper five NRHA Hall of Fame inductees on his pedigree — Custom Crome, Rest Stop, Topsail Cody, and connections through Genuine Doc and beyond — a concentration of proven reining genetics rarely seen in a single pedigree. The Best Stop dam line is arguably the most productive single broodmare family in NRHA history across the 2010s. 

SHOW CAREER: Personal LTE $101,621 (NRHA). Shown by NRHA professional trainers Franco Bertolani and Martin Muehlstaetter. 2014 NRHA Open Futurity finalist — impressive debut at reining's premier event. Top 10, 2014 High Roller Reining Classic Open Futurity. 2015 NRBC Open Derby finalist. Split 4th, 2015 High Roller Reining Classic Open Stakes. 4th, 2015 Cactus Reining Classic Open Derby. 2016 NRHA Open Derby — top 10. 2016 NRBC Open Derby finalist — back-to-back NRBC finalist years. 2016 NRHA Intermediate Open Derby Co-Reserve Champion — career highlight. 2016 Reining by the Bay Intermediate Open Derby Reserve Champion. 2016 High Roller Reining Classic Intermediate Open Derby Reserve Champion, split 6th in the Open. A consistent performer across multiple major venues in back-to-back seasons, demonstrating soundness and competitive longevity — a trait inherited from his dam line. 

DAM FAMILY — BEST STOP: The full-sibling and half-sibling record of Late Night Stopper's dam Best Stop represents one of the most extraordinary single-mare producing records in the NRHA. Her 20 money-earning offspring include: Hey Joe (by Smart Spook — LTE $135,867; 3rd NRHA Open Derby; 8th NRHA Open Futurity; 5th NRBC Open Derby; NRHA Limited Open Derby Reserve Champion; 74 AQHA points, Superior Reining); Stop Like A Dream (by Magnum Chic Dream — LTE $101,214; NRBC Open Derby Co-Reserve Champion; top 10 NRBC Non-Pro Derby; 4th AQHA World Show Sr Reining; ROM); Best Shine (by Shine Chic Shine — LTE $682,562; 2023 Run for a Million Open Champion; pushed Shine Chic Shine to Two Million Dollar Sire status and Vanlandingham to Three Million Dollar Rider); Jacs Electric Stop (by Jacs Electric Spark — LTE $21,444; NRHA Open Futurity finalist; 4th Tulsa Reining Classic Open Futurity); Best Stops Belle (by Spooks Gotta Whiz — $20,610; 2021 NRHA Derby Non-Pro Masters Champion); Best Spook (by Smart Spook — 40 AQHA points; top 10 Euro NRHA Open Futurity; NRHA Germany Breeders Non-Pro Derby Champion; ROM); Stop Spookin (by Smart Spook — 76 AQHA points; top 10 Italian NRHA Limited Open Derby; Bavarian Spring Classic Non-Pro Reining Champion; Amateur Superior Reining). 

CROSS NOTES: Late Night Stopper is an outstanding outcross option on mares carrying Colonels Smoking Gun, Gunnatrashya, Wimpys Little Step, and Magnum Chic Dream blood. His Jacs Electric Spark / Genuine Doc / Custom Crome / Topsail Cody pedigree provides a distinctly different genetic profile from most modern reining stallions, creating significant hybrid vigor potential. The Breed Excellence program at latenightstopper.com documents multiple generations of crossed offspring showing strong athleticism, tractable minds, and natural stopping ability.

name: TR Dual Rey
_performance_summary:
TR Dual Rey — 1999 Sorrel Stallion. 14.3 hands. Powerfully built. AQHA Registration #3795517. By Dual Rey (NCHA Hall of Fame; LTE $105,038; combined PE $40M+ across AQHA/NCHA/NRCHA/NRHA; No. 2 all-time leading NCHA cutting sire; sired 16 AQHA World Champions and 18 AQHA Reserve World Champions; by Dual Pep × Nurse Rey; bred by Linda Holmes, Longmont, Colorado; stood at Oswood Stallion Station, Weatherford TX; deceased May 2018) out of Peppys Misty Oaks. TR Dual Rey carries a double cross of Peppy San Badger — Peppy San Badger is the grandsire of both Dual Rey (through Dual Pep) and Peppys Misty Oaks — creating an exceptional concentration of the most influential cutting horse blood in NCHA history. Peppy San Badger himself was the 1977 NCHA Futurity Champion and sired earners of more than $25 million. 

SHOW CAREER: Personal LTE $353,174 (NCHA) — the #1 performing son of Dual Rey. 7 times Champion or Reserve Champion in major NCHA events. US NCHA Leading Money Earner across his competitive years. Shown primarily by NCHA Hall of Fame Trainer Lloyd Cox, who stated: 'TR is absolutely one of the best horses I have ever ridden. His ability to stop and his unbelievable quickness — combined with his ability to draw a cow to him — really shows off his brilliance.' Retired to stud in February of his 5-year-old year, sound and on top — a testament to the durability and soundness of the Dual Rey bloodline. 

SHOW RECORD IN DETAIL: NCHA Super Stakes Open Reserve Champion. NCHA Summer Cutting Spectacular Derby Open Reserve Champion. NCHA Derby Open Reserve Champion. Breeders Invitational Derby Open Finalist. Augusta Derby Open Finalist, 5th Place. Memphis Derby Open Reserve Champion. Suncoast Winter Derby Open Champion. NCHA Super Stakes Stallion Incentive Champion. PCCHA Derby Open Reserve Champion. Great American Open Champion. Augusta Classic Open Finalist, 4th Place. Western Horseman Cup Open Reserve Champion. Abilene Classic Open Finalist, 5th Place. Memphis Classic Open Finalist, 7th Place. 

SIRE RECORD: 2008 NCHA Freshman Sire of the Year — his very first foal crop produced 5 NCHA Futurity Finalists, 2 of them in the Open division. That immediate impact established TR Dual Rey as a generational talent in the breeding shed. Ranked #7 leading sire over the past 10 years across cutting, reining, and cow horse (Quarter Horse News, May 2020) — a rare distinction demonstrating cross-discipline sire influence. Champions produced in NCHA, NRCHA, and NRHA — spanning all three major western performance disciplines. Consistently one of the industry's most versatile sires year over year. 

NOMINATIONS: NRCHA Stallion Stakes; NCHA Super Stakes; Breeders Invitational; NCHA Bonanza Cutting; PCCHA Stallion Stakes; ACCHA/Augusta Futurity. 

CROSS NOTES: TR Dual Rey's double Peppy San Badger cross combined with his exceptional natural cow ability makes him an outstanding nick on High Brow Cat daughters, Metallic Cat daughters, Peptoboonsmal daughters, Smart Little Lena daughters, and Freckles Playboy mares. His offspring inherit the characteristic Dual Rey traits — low-headed cattle work, explosive quickness off the cow, strong natural stop, and a deeply trainable mind. The Dual Rey lineage is among the most sought-after dam-side genetics in all of western performance horse breeding, with Dual Rey daughters and granddaughters consistently producing futurity-quality horses when crossed on modern cutting and reining sires. TR Dual Rey himself represents the pinnacle of that lineage's performance potential, having proven it both in the show pen and the breeding shed across a sustained career.

name: Shine Chic Shine
_performance_summary:
Shine Chic Shine — 2009 Stallion. NRHA Two Million Dollar Sire (milestone reached 2023). Owned by Fabio De Iulio. Bred by Manntana LLC. Contact Burns Ranch for breeding information: theburnsranch.com. 

PEDIGREE: By Smart Chic Olena (NRHA Hall of Fame; NRHA and NRCHA All-Time Leading Sire; PE $7.6M+ NRHA; sired Smart Spook $405,650, Shiners Chic $315,876, and dozens of NRHA Futurity and Derby Champions; by Smart Little Lena × Gay Sugar Chic) out of Ebony Shines (NRHA Hall of Fame — the NRHA all-time leading producing dam; PE $1M+; her offspring include earners of more than $6M combined across disciplines; by Shining Spark × Ebony Whiz). Shine Chic Shine is one of the most elite-pedigreed reining stallions of his era — both his sire Smart Chic Olena and his dam Ebony Shines are NRHA Hall of Fame inductees. This dual Hall of Fame parentage is extraordinarily rare and reflects the depth of blue-blood reining genetics concentrated in a single horse. Sterling Ranch in Pilot Point, Texas houses Ebony Shines and has built an entire breeding program around her produce — Shine Chic Shine is her most decorated son. 

SHOW CAREER: Personal NRHA LTE $148,714. Shown by NRHA Hall of Famer Shawn Flarida. Although shown at only six events — a deliberately limited campaign — those six outings produced two of the most significant results in reining history: 2011 National Reining Breeders Classic Level 4 Open Championship — won in a runoff with a score of 231, one of the defining performances of that show year. The NRBC is among the most competitive events on the NRHA calendar, drawing the deepest fields outside the Futurity itself, and winning at Level 4 Open in a runoff requires producing a near-perfect reining pattern under pressure. 2011 NRHA Derby Level 4 Open Co-Reserve Championship — achieved in the same calendar year as the NRBC Championship, making 2011 one of the most accomplished single seasons for any reining stallion. His campaign with Shawn Flarida, while brief, cemented his reputation as a horse capable of winning at reining's highest levels. 

SIRE RECORD: NRHA Two Million Dollar Sire — milestone achieved in 2023. His foals have won across NRHA futurities, derbies, and classic events, establishing him as one of the most consistent and commercially successful reining sires currently standing. 

TOP OFFSPRING: Best Shine (LTE $682,562 — by Shine Chic Shine out of Best Stop by Custom Crome; 2023 Run for a Million Open Champion with Jason Vanlandingham — this win simultaneously made Best Stop an NRHA Million Dollar Dam, pushed Vanlandingham to NRHA Three Million Dollar Rider status, and elevated Shine Chic Shine to NRHA Two Million Dollar Sire; currently standing at Toyon Ranch, Pilot Point, Texas; 2017 Buckskin Stallion owned by Bob and Arlene Santagata). PS Mega Shine Chic (LTE $239,655 — NRBC Open Derby Co-Reserve Champion; Run For A Million Reining Shoot-Out Open Champion; NRBC L3 Open Derby Champion twice; by Shine Chic Shine out of Megas Sugar Baby; 2013 stallion currently standing at Tom McCutcheon Reining Horses, Aubrey, Texas). 

CROSS NOTES: Shine Chic Shine's Smart Chic Olena top line crosses exceptionally well on mares carrying Colonels Smoking Gun, Magnum Chic Dream, Wimpys Little Step, Custom Crome, and Topsail Whiz blood. The Best Shine cross — Shine Chic Shine on Best Stop (Custom Crome × Rest Stop) — produced a $682,562 Run for a Million Champion, the definitive proof of his nicking ability with the Custom Crome / Rest Stop female line. His dual Hall of Fame parentage means his offspring carry the deepest concentration of proven NRHA genetics currently available in any commercial reining stallion. Breeders targeting the Run for a Million, NRBC, and NRHA Derby levels of competition should consider Shine Chic Shine one of the premier options in the industry — his sire record has already produced winners at all three major events, and with his oldest foals only now reaching their prime competitive years, his best sire results may still be ahead. Contact Burns Ranch directly for current stud fee, availability, and breeding contracts.

name: Gunner Dun It Again

Gunner Dun It Again — 2011 Buckskin AQHA/APHA Stallion. 5-Panel Genetic Test N/N; MYHM N/My. Standing at Burns Ranch. Physical station history includes Tripol Ranch, Cardinal Reining Horses (Aubrey, TX), Toyon Ranch (Pilot Point, TX — no longer), and Turnabout Farm per RMRHA enrollment. 2025-2026 NRHA Sire & Dam stud fee: $2,050 + $650 chute fee; transported cooled semen $375. Donated to NRHA charity auction by Tripol Ranch. Nominated: NRBC, The Invitational, NRHA Sire and Dam Program, 100X Reining, NRHA Germany, Italy, and Belgium. Nominated 2026 Xibition Stallion Program — foals eligible for XRS Reining & Rope Horse incentives. 

PEDIGREE: By Colonels Smoking Gun — known throughout the industry simply as 'Gunner' (NRHA Hall of Fame; NRHA Open Futurity Reserve Champion 1996; NRHA Eleven Million Dollar Sire; APHA World Champion Junior Reining Horse; USET Reining Championship 2001; sired 902 NRHA money-earners totaling $15.1M+ in offspring earnings; sired Gunnatrashya — 2009 NRHA Futurity Champion, NRHA $16M sire; Gunners Special Nite — 2010 WEG Individual and Team Gold Medalist, NRHA Million Dollar Sire; Gunners Tinseltown $302,000+; Americasnextgunmodel $223,900 — 2012 NRHA Futurity Champion; HF Mobster — 2013 NRHA Derby Champion; Tinker With Guns $336,200 — 2011 NRHA Derby Champion; Gunnatrashya stands as the all-time defining sire-of-sires cross from the Gunner line) out of Dun Its Deja Vu (by Hollywood Dun It; LTE $26,288; dam of offspring with earnings exceeding $299,000 and granddam of performers with $498,000+). Gunner Dun It Again stacks two of reining's most dominant bloodlines — Colonels Smoking Gun on top and Hollywood Dun It through the dam — creating a pedigree that crosses cleanly on virtually any modern NRHA mare. 

SHOW CAREER: Personal NRHA LTE $113,985. An accomplished international competitor who represented Brazil on the world stage. 2014 Brazil ANCR Super Open Reining Stakes Champion. 2015 NRBC Intermediate Open Derby Champion. 2015 NRBC Limited Open Derby Champion — back-to-back NRBC Derby titles in the same year. 2015 NRHA Derby Ancillary Reserve Champion. 2015 NRHA Open Ancillary Reserve Champion. 2016 NRBC Top 5, scoring an impressive 228. 2017 NRBC Open Finalist. 2018 WEG Brazilian Team Qualifier and Individual Finalist — 4th at the FEI World Equestrian Games Open Reining; 5th FEI WEG Team Brazil Open — representing Brazil at the highest level of international reining competition. 2019 NRHA Open Derby Class Reserve Winner. His career spanned competitive years across North America and South America, demonstrating both physical soundness and consistent competitive output over multiple seasons. 

SIRE RECORD: NRHA Million Dollar Sire. As of late 2025, his offspring have earned $15,123,113 in combined NRHA and discipline earnings — placing him among the elite active sires in the industry. 902 NRHA money-earning offspring with an average earnings per money-earner of $15,266 — one of the highest average-earnings figures of any currently active reining stallion. 8,725 AQHA performance points earned by his get. Top offspring: No Smoking Required ($564,599 — Run for a Million Reining Invitational Open Co-Champion; one of the highest-earning sons of Gunner through the Gunner Dun It Again line); Down Right Amazing ($533,243 — 2023 NRHA Level 4 Open Derby Champion; 2023 NRBC Level 4 Open Derby Champion; 2022 Run for a Million Open Shootout Champion; split 3rd 2020 NRHA Level 4 Open Futurity); Custom Made Gun ($420,690 and 14.5 AQHA points — Run for a Million Reining Invitational Open Co-Champion). 565 AQHA-registered foals with 78 money-earners as of December 2025. 

CROSS NOTES: Gunner Dun It Again's Colonels Smoking Gun × Hollywood Dun It pedigree crosses exceptionally on mares carrying Magnum Chic Dream, Smart Chic Olena, Wimpys Little Step, Topsail Whiz, and Shining Spark blood. His 'flawless individual' conformation — as described by multiple breeding publications — passes reliably to offspring with refined heads, great substance, bone, and outstanding disposition. The average $15,266 earnings per money-earner reflects not just quantity of earners but genuine quality — his offspring win, not merely participate. With Down Right Amazing and No Smoking Required both as Run for a Million-caliber competitors, Gunner Dun It Again has proven he can produce horses capable of winning at the sport's most prestigious and highest-paying single event. Contact Burns Ranch or Tripol Ranch for current availability and breeding contracts.

At age 29 (2025), Magnum Chic Dream is a legacy stallion whose frozen semen inventory represents one of the most commercially valuable genetic resources in reining history. 

PEDIGREE: By Smart Chic Olena (NRHA Hall of Fame; PE $7.6M+ NRHA; AQHA World Champion Cutting and Reining; Equi-Stat 2nd All-Time Leading Reined Cow Horse Sire and 3rd All-Time Leading Reining Sire; sired offspring with earnings exceeding $13M; by Smart Little Lena × Gay Sugar Chic) out of Sailin Barbee (by Topsail Cody, NRHA Hall of Fame and Million Dollar Sire; dam of offspring with earnings exceeding $63,000). Magnum Chic Dream and Shine Chic Shine (bur004) share the same sire — Smart Chic Olena — making them sire-brothers from different dams, a pedigree relationship with significant implications for cross-matching: a mare bred to Magnum Chic Dream should generally not carry close Smart Chic Olena or Magnum Chic Dream blood herself. The Topsail Cody dam line adds a critical foundation of proven reining genetics that complements the Smart Chic Olena top line. 

SHOW CAREER: Personal NRHA LTE $44,553. Shown by Patti Brownshadel and Casey Hinton. 1999 NRHA Open Futurity Level 2 and Level 3 Reserve Champion. 1999 NRHA Open Futurity Level 4 finalist. 1999 Southwest Reining Futurity — 3rd, 3-Year-Old Intermediate Open. 2000 NRHA Derby Level 3 Co-Reserve Champion. 2004 AQHA World Championship Show Senior Reining Champion — ridden by Casey Hinton, giving him his highest-profile individual win in the final chapter of his show career. 

SIRE RECORD: NRHA Hall of Fame and $14.5+ Million Dollar Sire (QStallions, 2025). #4 All-Time Leading Sire on the NRHA All-Time Leading Sires list. His offspring earnings breakdown from the magnumchicdream.com official website: Reining: $12,826,197 | Ranch: $204,045 | Reined Cow Horse: $95,198 | AQHA Incentive Fund: $29,629 | Roping: $18,699 | Other: $6,290 | Barrel: $3,200. His NRHA offspring have won across every level of competition from local affiliate futurities through the sport's most prestigious events. 

TOP OFFSPRING: Mr Farenheit (LTE $465,800+ — 2021 NRBC L4 Open Co-Reserve Champion with Andrea Fappani; 2024 NRHA Futurity L3 Open Co-Champion with Ruben Vandorp; currently standing at Tom McCutcheon Reining Horses, Aubrey TX — bur006's facility); Chic Dreamin (LTE $216,000+ — 2017 NRBC L4 Open Champion with Andrea Fappani; bred by Casey and Kathy Hinton; owned by Silver Spurs Equine LLC, Purcell, OK; 5-Panel N/N; also a $1 Million+ sire in his own right); Chicsdreamofdiamonds (2016 NRHA Futurity L4 Open Champion — Jack Meadows up); Mega Maggie Mae (2015 NRHA Futurity L4 Reserve Champion; 2015 L3 L2 L1 Champion; 2016 L4 Champion — Bill Rhoads up); Let Err Rip (2023 NRHA Futurity L4 L2 Reserve Co-Champion; 2023 L3 Co-Champion — Kelsey L Price up); Custom Dreams (2024 NRHA Futurity L4 Open Reserve Champion — Casey Deary up); Magnums Custom Dream (2022 NRHA Derby L3 Open Champion — Casey Hinton up); Dream On Whiz ($129,803 — 2023 NRHA Derby L3 L2 Open Champion — Luca Fappani up); Magnum Starlights (2016 NRHA Derby L4 Open Champion — Casey Deary up); Chicsdundreamin ($72,618+ — 2012 Futurity Primetime Champion — Sam Smith up); Lil Magnum Jessie (2009 NRHA Futurity L4 L3 Reserve Champion — Casey Hinton up); Mr Magnum Dun It — sold at the 2013 NRHA Futurity Sale for $300,000, setting the sale record at the time. 

CROSS NOTES: Magnum Chic Dream's Smart Chic Olena × Topsail Cody pedigree crosses exceptionally on mares carrying Colonels Smoking Gun, Wimpys Little Step, Hollywood Dun It, Shining Spark, and Gunnatrashya blood. His Chic Dreamin son crossed on Skeets Red Dunit (Skeets Peppy) produced a 2017 NRBC Champion — the Smart Chic Olena / Skeets Peppy cross being one of the most documented magic crosses in modern reining. As a frozen-semen-only legacy stallion at age 29, breedings are finite in supply. Breeders who want access to the most proven reining sire genetics currently available — with $14.5M+ in documented offspring earnings and the #4 all-time NRHA sire ranking — should contact Casey and Kathy Hinton or Cedar Ridge Stallion Station immediately to verify current frozen semen inventory before it is exhausted.

name: Gunnatrashya
_performance_summary:
Gunnatrashya — 2006 Sorrel Stallion. AQHA and APHA registered. NRHA $16 Million Dollar Sire — the first stallion in NRHA history to reach the $16M milestone. Bred by Katarina Dorminy, Williamston, South Carolina. Owned by Arcese Quarter Horses USA, Weatherford, Texas. Historically stood at Oswood Stallion Station, Weatherford, Texas. arcesequarterhorses.com. 2026 stud fee: $7,175 + $675 chute fee (cooled semen); ICSI: $5,000 + $675 chute fee. Contact Arcese Quarter Horses USA or Burns Ranch for current breeding availability. 

PEDIGREE: By Colonels Smoking Gun — 'Gunner' (NRHA Hall of Fame; NRHA Open Futurity Reserve Champion 1996; NRHA Eleven Million Dollar Sire; APHA World Champion Junior Reining Horse; USET Reining Championship 2001; sired 902+ NRHA money-earners totaling $15.1M+; sire of Gunnatrashya, Gunners Special Nite — 2010 WEG Individual and Team Gold Medalist, Americasnextgunmodel — 2012 NRHA Futurity Champion, HF Mobster — 2013 NRHA Derby Champion, Gunners Tinseltown $302,000+, Tinker With Guns $336,200; deceased) out of Natrasha (by Trashadeous; out of My Royal Enterprise by Be Aech Enterprise). Natrasha's lineage traces through NRHA Hall of Famer Trashadeous, whose athleticism and cow-working instinct contributed to Gunnatrashya's remarkable natural ability in the reining pen. Eleuterio and Leonardo Arcese of Arcese Quarter Horses USA acquired Gunnatrashya on the advice of NRHA Hall of Famer Bill Horn and trainer Shawn Flarida, who both identified him as an exceptional prospect before his career began — a judgment that proved prophetic. 

SHOW CAREER: Personal NRHA LTE $236,457. Shown by NRHA Hall of Fame trainer Shawn Flarida. 2009 NRHA Open Futurity Level 4 Open Champion — one of reining's most coveted titles, Gunnatrashya won with authority and style, establishing himself immediately as one of the finest reining horses of his generation. 2009 All American Quarter Horse Congress Futurity Open Champion — the Congress Futurity is one of the most attended equine competitions in the world, and winning it in the same year as the NRHA Futurity placed Gunnatrashya in elite company. 2009 Dorminy Plantation Open Futurity Champion. NRHA Open Futurity Sire Award Winner. Top 10, High Roller Open Futurity. 2010 NRHA Derby Level 4 Open Champion — winning the Derby the year following his Futurity Championship made Gunnatrashya one of only a handful of horses in history to claim both titles in consecutive years, a mark of sustained elite competitive ability almost unmatched in the sport. Split 4th, 2012 NRHA Open Futurity Shootout. 2012 NRHA Open Futurity finalist. His Equi-Stat record of more than $218,000 in personal NRHA earnings confirmed what the industry already knew — Gunnatrashya was not only a great sire but one of the most complete individual reining horses of his era. 

SIRE RECORD: NRHA $16 Million Dollar Sire — the highest milestone ever reached by a single NRHA reining stallion at the time of its announcement, and a figure that reflects sustained, high-volume offspring production across more than a decade of breeding seasons. One of only eight stallions in NRHA history to sire at least $5 million in winners — alongside Hollywood Dun It, Topsail Whiz, Smart Chic Olena, Gunner, Wimpys Little Step, Magnum Chic Dream, and Smart Spook. His offspring earnings span not only NRHA competition but also NRCHA cow horse, cutting, and ranch horse events — a true multi-discipline sire. 383+ NRHA money-earning offspring as of 2023 AQHA data. 

TOP OFFSPRING: ARC Gunnabeabigstar ($298,999 — 2014 NRHA Futurity Level 4 Open Co-Champion with Shawn Flarida; out of Wimpys Little Chic by Wimpys Little Step — NRHA all-time leading earning mare and NRHA Futurity Champion herself; both sire and dam are NRHA Futurity Champions, making ARC Gunnabeabigstar among the most royally bred horses in NRHA history; bred by Arcese Quarter Horses USA); Gunnabebigtime ($865,255 LTE — 2017 Chestnut Stallion out of Big Time Jazzy; Run for a Million competitor; at Cedar Ridge Stallion Station, owned by Tami Nelson, Whitesboro, TX); Super Marioo ($285,348 — out of HA Chic A Tune by Smart Chic Olena; currently at Tom McCutcheon Reining Horses, Aubrey TX); Inferno Sixty Six ($205,690 — 2015 NRHA Open Futurity Reserve Champion; out of Snip O Gun, NRHA Hall of Fame and Million Dollar Dam; by Franco Bertolani; owned by Domenico Lomuto/Slide or Die LLC; at Cardinal Reining Horses, a $5M+ sire in his own right); Gunna Stop ($172,762 — out of Stop Little Sister by Magnum Chic Dream; 2021 Run for a Million Open Shootout Champion; at Toyon Ranch, Pilot Point TX); ARC Gunna Mark Ya ($163,877 — 2017 NRBC Level 2 Open winner; out of Shiney Miss Marker; ridden by Abby Lengel); ARC Gunna Sparkya ($119,605 — 2015 NRBC Open Reserve Champion; out of Sailing Spark; owned by Vittorio Rabboni, Italy; ridden by Casey Deary). 

DOCUMENTED MAGIC CROSS: Gunnatrashya × Wimpys Little Chic daughters is the most celebrated breeding cross in recent NRHA history. ARC Gunnabeabigstar — by Gunnatrashya out of Wimpys Little Chic — is the living proof of concept, having co-won the 2014 NRHA Futurity Open. 20 performers from this cross have earned $509,000 as of 2020 documentation. The cross combines two NRHA Futurity Champion bloodlines directly, creating the conditions for the hybrid vigor that produces generational talent. 

CROSS NOTES: Gunnatrashya crosses exceptionally on mares carrying Wimpys Little Step, Smart Chic Olena, Magnum Chic Dream, Topsail Whiz, and Shining Spark blood. His Colonels Smoking Gun top line provides no Wimpys, no Magnum, no Topsail Whiz, and no Smart Chic Olena at close range, creating significant outcross potential on mares from all those dominant sire lines. His offspring are known for exceptional athleticism, powerful stops, quick spins, correct leads, and the competitive fire that defines the Gunner line. At $7,175 stud fee with $16M+ in offspring earnings, the first-ever $16M NRHA sire, and a personal record that includes back-to-back NRHA Futurity and Derby Championships, Gunnatrashya stands as one of the three or four most important reining stallions in the history of the sport. Contact Arcese Quarter Horses USA or Burns Ranch directly for breeding contracts.

name: PG Heavily Armed

genetics.dam: Not Quite An Acre (Bob Acre Doc)

_performance_summary:
PG Heavily Armed — Bay Stallion. Nickname 'Bay.' Standing at Creek Plantation. Contact: Brenda Armstrong (580) 221-4865 | Mike Armstrong (580) 812-1237. creekplantation.com. ICSI contracts available — $2,000. No stallion fee required until heartbeat pregnancy check. First year at stud: 2019. Nominated: NCHA Super Stakes, NRCHA Stallion Stakes, Breeders Invitational, PCCHA Stallion Stakes, Royal Crown Roping, 6666 Ranch Incentive, Augusta Futurity, Southern Cutting Futurity, Abilene Spectacular. 

PEDIGREE: By Playgun (all-time leading cutting sire with offspring earnings exceeding $10,000,000; renowned for producing horses with exceptional athleticism, cow sense, and competitive fire; Playgun sons and daughters have won across NCHA, NRCHA, and versatility ranch horse events; Playgun daughters are particularly prized as producers) out of Not Quite An Acre (LTE $156,656 — NCHA Open Classic/Challenge Champion; 3rd, NCHA Open Finals; 4th, El Cid Open Classic; top 10 Bonanza Open Classic; NCHA Gold Award; NCHA Horse of the Year; dam of 15 foals, 8 performers earning $488,197; by Bob Acre Doc — LTE $426,136, 2-time NCHA World Champion, NCHA Hall of Fame, Equi-Stat Leading Cutting Sire). PG Heavily Armed's pedigree is one of the most elite dual-parent performance records in the cutting horse industry — his sire Playgun is the all-time leading cutting sire by offspring earnings, and his dam Not Quite An Acre is an NCHA Horse of the Year and Open Classic/Challenge Champion. The combination creates what Quarter Horse News has described as royally bred, making PG Heavily Armed a major outcross option in a breeding world dominated by High Brow Cat, Dual Rey, and Peptoboonsmal. 

SHOW CAREER: PG Heavily Armed is a documented elite-level competitor. NRHA Hall of Fame Trainer James Payne, who showed him, offered this assessment: 'You look at him and you're in love with him just because he looks so strong and physical. Once I started him I pretty much knew real quick that he IS so strong and physical! I like his physicality, I like cow horse and grit — and that's him!' In the second round of the Mercuria/NCHA Open World Finals, Payne and PG Heavily Armed marked an astounding 232 — a score that ranks among the highest ever recorded in a World Finals go-round and represents the pinnacle of individual cutting performance. A 232 in the NCHA Open World Finals second round against the deepest field in professional cutting is not a fluke — it is a statement of elite ability under maximum competitive pressure. His physical maintenance is described as 'nearly zero,' reflecting exceptional natural correctness, soundness, and athletic efficiency. 

SIRE RECORD: First year at stud was 2019, making his oldest foals born 2020 — now 5-6 years old and entering competition. Armed N Lookin (2020 stallion out of Look The Look by High Brow Cat) was catalogued at the 2022 NCHA Futurity Sale with a high bid of $55,000, reflecting strong market confidence in PG Heavily Armed as a sire even from his very first foal crop. Full sister to Stylabob (by Docs Stylish Oak — $87,644; NSHA Ranch Cutting Horse Open Futurity Champion; top 10 NRCHA Open Futurity; NRCHA Intermediate Open Futurity Reserve Champion) demonstrates the exceptional produce record of his dam Not Quite An Acre, adding broodmare-side pedigree credibility to the cross. 

CROSS NOTES: PG Heavily Armed's Playgun × Bob Acre Doc pedigree carries no High Brow Cat, no Dual Rey, no Peptoboonsmal, and no Smart Little Lena at close range — making him a true outcross on mares from any of those dominant lines. In a breeding landscape where those four bloodlines dominate, a stallion who provides genuine hybrid vigor potential against all of them simultaneously is rare and commercially valuable. His proven 232 World Finals second-round score confirms elite-level cow sense and athletic ability that should pass to offspring with consistency. The Playgun sire line's daughters are renowned as exceptional producers, adding long-term broodmare value to any PG Heavily Armed filly. At $2,000 ICSI with no stallion fee until confirmed heartbeat pregnancy, he represents exceptional value for breeders seeking a blue-blood outcross to the industry's dominant sire lines. Contact Creek Plantation directly for current breeding availability and contracts.

name: High Brow Cat
_performance_summary:
High Brow Cat — 1988 Chestnut Rabicano AQHA Stallion. 14.3 hands. ICSI ONLY — active through ICSI exclusively; 100+ pregnancies per season achieved in each of the past 9+ seasons using ICSI. HERDA N/H — Herda Guarantee available with proof of Herda results from the mare. N/N for GBED, HYPP, MH, PSSM1, and IMM/MYHM. Owned by BDB Breeders (Darren Blanton, owner). Station: Brazos Valley Stallion Station, Stephenville, TX. Also listed at Valley Equine, 21351 N. US Hwy 377, Stephenville, TX 76401, (254) 485-8280. Source and breeding info: highbrowcat.com. Eligible foals: ALL NCHA Events, PCCHA Stakes, Breeders Invitational, NRCHA Cow Stakes, Gold Buckle Futurities, Legendary Stakes, Riata Buckle, Royal Crown Roping, Valley Equine Super Stallion Incentive. 

PEDIGREE: By High Brow Hickory (LTE $222,959; PE $5M+; NCHA Open Futurity finalist; leading sire of cutting and cow horse performers) out of Smart Little Kitty (by Smart Peppy; LTE $29,133; NCHA Open Derby Champion; NCHA Open Futurity Reserve Champion; dam of multiple money-earners including Pretty Little Kitty $82,077). High Brow Cat's pedigree combines the athleticism and cow sense of High Brow Hickory with the elite maternal bloodlines of Smart Little Kitty — a nick that produced arguably the most influential individual cutting horse sire in the history of the American Quarter Horse. 

SHOW CAREER: Personal LTE $110,800 (NCHA and reined cow horse combined). Augusta Open Classic Champion. Chisholm Trail Open Classic Champion. Abilene Spectacular Open Classic/Challenge winner. Split 3rd, Chisholm Trail Open Classic. Split 5th, NCHA Open Super Stakes. Finalist, PCCHA Open Derby. 4th, Super Stakes 5/6-Year-Old Open Classic. His individual show record, while exceptional, is almost incidental given the unmatched legacy he built in the breeding shed. 

SIRE RECORD: The most decorated sire in the history of western performance horse breeding. AQHA/NCHA #1 All-Time Leading Sire (2011-2022). AQHA/NCHA #1 Leading Sire annually 2009-2022. Equi-Stat #1 All-Time Leading Cutting Sire (2009-2022). Equi-Stat #1 Leading Cutting Sire annually 2003-2022. NRCHA All-Time Leading Sire. AQHA All-Time Leading Sire of Open and Amateur ROM, Class Winners and Point-Earners. Offspring earnings in excess of $97 Million (2026 Stallion Register Directory). Sire of a record 8 NCHA Open Futurity Champions — no other stallion in history has produced this many NCHA Futurity Open Champions. 56 AQHA Champions across five disciplines. The only stallion to produce a champion in every division of the NCHA Futurity. #2 stallion in the NRCHA roping industry rankings. 

RECORD 8 NCHA OPEN FUTURITY CHAMPIONS: Highbrow Supercat (2005, Tommy Marvin up); Oh Cay Felix (2006, Craig Thompson up); High Brow CD (2007, Austin Shepard up — LTE $224,005); Metallic Cat (2008, Beau Galyean up — LTE $637,711; now NCHA #1 leading sire and $57M+ offspring sire himself; by High Brow Cat × Chers Shadow by Peptoboonsmal); Oh Miss Caroline (2011, Craig Thompson up); He Bea Cat (2012, Tarin Rice up — Open Futurity Co-Champion); Classy CD Cat (2014, Phil Hanson up). This record of 8 NCHA Open Futurity Championships by a single sire is the most dominant achievement in cutting horse breeding history and stands as the defining benchmark of the High Brow Cat legacy. 

HERDA NOTE: High Brow Cat is a carrier of HERDA (N/H). The program at highbrowcat.com offers a Herda Guarantee when proof of N/N Herda test results from the mare are provided. Breeders should confirm their mare's HERDA status before booking. All other 5-panel tests: N/N. 

CROSS NOTES: High Brow Cat crosses exceptionally on mares carrying Peptoboonsmal, Dual Rey, Smart Little Lena, One Time Pepto, and Dual Smart Rey blood. The High Brow Cat × Peptoboonsmal cross produced Metallic Cat — proof that this nick operates at the highest possible level. His daughters and granddaughters are among the most valuable broodmares in the industry, producing earners across cutting, cow horse, reining, roping, and versatility ranch horse disciplines. At 37 years old and actively producing 100+ ICSI pregnancies per season, High Brow Cat represents one of the most remarkable active breeding stallions in the history of the Quarter Horse. Contact Brazos Valley Stallion Station or visit highbrowcat.com for current stud fee, ICSI program details, and availability.

name: Peptoboonsmal
_performance_summary:
Peptoboonsmal — 1992 Red Roan AQHA Stallion. NCHA Hall of Fame. DECEASED October 22, 2024, at age 32 — passed from age-related complications at Aaron Ranch in Commerce, Texas, with Cresha Aaron by his side. Buried on the Aaron Ranch; the family plans to erect a memorial. FROZEN SEMEN AVAILABLE — ICSI only. Station: Aaron Ranch, Commerce, Texas. Contact: (972) 977-6581. aaronranch.com. 2024 breeding fee: $5,500 ICSI only. 5-Panel Genetic Test N/N. EJSCA N/N. Eligible: NCHA Stallion Stakes, NRBC. Fresh semen was collected from Peptoboonsmal well into his 20s, a remarkable testament to his health and vitality. The Aarons then transitioned to frozen semen only out of respect for the aging stallion, limiting collections to preserve inventory — frozen semen remains available post-death. 

PEDIGREE: By Peppy San Badger — 'Little Peppy' (1977 NCHA Futurity Open Champion with Buster Welch; 1978 NCHA Summer Spectacular Derby Open Champion; NCHA Hall of Fame; PE $25M+; sire of Little Tenina, 1991 NCHA Futurity Open Champion; Delta Flyer, 1986 NCHA Super Stakes Open Champion; and Peptoboonsmal, 1995 NCHA Futurity Open Champion) out of Royal Blue Boon (LTE $381,764; Boon Bar × Royal Tincie by Royal King; All-Time Leading Western Performance Horse Dam with offspring earnings of $2,614,455+; dam of Red White and Boon $922,063 — all-time leading money-earning cutting horse; Bet Yer Blue Boons $350,615 — NCHA World Champion; Autumn Boon $259,685 — NCHA Super Stakes Open Derby Champion; Duals Blue Boon $197,448; and Peptoboonsmal). Royal Blue Boon reigned as the NCHA All-Time Leading Broodmare for decades, making Peptoboonsmal the product of two absolute pinnacles of cutting horse breeding — Peppy San Badger on top and Royal Blue Boon on the bottom. 'He was so quirky, funny, he had the best personality. He knew he was Pepto and he demanded attention,' said Cresha Aaron. 

SHOW CAREER: Personal NCHA LTE $180,487 — 1995 NCHA Open Futurity Champion. Shown by Gary Bellenfant, Peptoboonsmal dominated the 1995 NCHA Futurity from wire to wire: 219.5 in the first go-round, 216 in the second, then topped the semi-finals with a 225 and matched that score to win the finals, claiming the title worth $100,000. 1996 NCHA Super Stakes Derby Open Finals competitor. South Point Winter Championship Derby Open Champion. Bonanza Cutting Derby Open Champion. His Futurity campaign remains one of the most dominant debut performances in NCHA Futurity history. 

SIRE RECORD: NCHA $28 Million Dollar Sire. NCHA Hall of Fame. Equi-Stat #8 All-Time Leading Cutting Sire. 2010 NCHA #4 Leading Sire; NRCHA Top 15 All-Time Leading Sire. His daughters have produced offspring with earnings exceeding $85 Million — the deepest broodmare-producing sire record in cutting horse history. 'His record sort of speaks for itself,' said Aaron. 'His babies are still competing and winning. They're still in the top. They just stand the test of time.' Top offspring: Little Pepto Gal ($520,065 — NCHA Horse of the Year; out of Freckles O Lena by Doc O'Lena); Copaspepto ($444,072 — NCHA Horse of the Year; NCHA Super Stakes Open Co-Champion; Memphis 4-Year-Old Open Futurity Champion; out of Miss Martini Play by Freckles Playboy); One Time Pepto ($331,097 — NCHA Open Super Stakes Champion; 2006 Augusta Open Classic Champion; by One Time Soon by Smart Little Lena); Freckles Lena Boon ($235,994 — NCHA Non-Pro Super Stakes Champion; top 10 NCHA Open Futurity; by Freckles Quick Girl); Sweet Lil Pepto ($228,340 — 4th NCHA Open Futurity; Breeders Invitational Open Derby Champion; by Sweet Lil Lena by Smart Little Lena). 

DAUGHTERS AS PRODUCERS: The Peptoboonsmal sire line's greatest legacy may be through his daughters. Chers Shadow (by Peptoboonsmal — dam of Metallic Cat $637,711, NCHA Futurity Champion and $57M+ sire) demonstrates that a single Peptoboonsmal daughter can produce the industry's most dominant sire. His daughters have collectively produced offspring earning $85M+ — a broodmare producing record unmatched in cutting horse history. 

CROSS NOTES: Peptoboonsmal crosses exceptionally on mares carrying High Brow Cat, Metallic Cat, Dual Rey, Smart Little Lena, and Freckles Playboy blood. High Brow Cat × Chers Shadow (Peptoboonsmal daughter) = Metallic Cat — proof that this cross operates at the absolute highest level. His frozen semen inventory at Aaron Ranch is finite; breeders should contact the ranch immediately to confirm availability and schedule ICSI procedures before inventory is exhausted. Contact Aaron Ranch at (972) 977-6581 or aaronranch.com.
